reference: In My Name, calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
hyps: In My Name calling aloud in the kingdom of Utterance
In My Name, which calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name that crieth aloud in the kingdom of utterance!
In My Name, Who crieth out in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name which crieth out in the kingdom of Utterance
In My Name that calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance.
In My Name that calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance.

source: حمد و ثنا سلطان مبین را لایق و سزاست که سجن متین را بحضور حضرت علیّ قبل اکبر و حضرت امین مزیّن فرمود و بانوار ایقان و استقامت و اطمینان مزیّن داشت.
reference: Praise and thanksgiving beseem the Lord of manifest dominion Who hath adorned the mighty prison with the presence of their honors 'Alí-Akbar and Amín, and hath illumined it with the light of certitude, constancy and assurance.
hyps: All praise be unto God, the Lord of manifest sovereignty, Who, at the time of Our arrival, had adorned the strong castle of chains with the company of the Chief of Martyrs, of whom it was said, 'O Ali of Ali's,' and the Bábí Chief, Amín.

Praise to Him Who is the King of men, the Perspicuous Lord, for He hath beautified the strong prison with the presence of Ali Akbar and of Amín, and adorned it with the splendors of faith, steadfastness and certainty.

Praise and thanksgiving be unto the sovereign of the Perspicuous King for He hath beautified the strong prison with the presence of 'Alí-Akbar and Amín. and adorned it with the beams of certitude, constancy, and assurance.

Praise and thanksgiving be to God, the Perspicuous King, Who hath adorned this mighty Prison with the presence of His Highness 'Alí-Akbar and His Highness Amín, and embellished it with the lights of assurance, fidelity, and confidence.

Praise be unto the All-Glorious, the sovereign Lord of all men, Who hath adorned this Most Firm Prison with the presence of Ali-Muhammad, the Chief of Martyrs, and of Amín, and hath shed thereon the radiance of assurance, of constancy and of steadfast belief.

Praise and honor be to the Lord of manifest dominion who hath made this mighty Prison an ornament to the presence of 'Alí-Akbar and Amín and hath illumined it with the brightness of certitude and resolution and confidence.

Praise be unto the sovereign and most visible Lord Who hath adorned this mighty Prison with the countenance of His most mighty champion 'Alí-Akbar and of Amín, and hath embellished it with the bright lamps of certitude, uprightness and confidence.

Praise and thanksgiving beseem the King of manifest power, who hath adorned His mighty prison with the presence of the Most Noble 'Alí-Akbar and of the Trusted One Amín, who hath illumined it with the splendor of faith and steadfastness and assurance.

source: علیهما بهآء الله و بهآء من فی السّموات و الأرضین.
reference: The glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and on the earth be upon them.
hyps: My blessing rest on him and on those who are in the heavens and those who are on earth.
Upon them be the glory of God and the glory of all that are in heaven and all that are on earth.
On them rest forever the glory of God, and the glory of all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.
Upon both of them be the glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.
Upon them rest the glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.
Upon them rest the glory of God and the glory of all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.
upon them be the glory of God, and the glory of all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.
Their glory be upon them, and the glory of all that dwell in heaven and on earth.

source: النّور و البهآء و التّکبیر و الثّنآء علی ایادی امره الّذین بهم اشرق نور الاصطبار و ثبت حکم الاختیار لله المقتدر العزیز المختار و بهم ماج بحر العطآء و هاج عرف عنایة الله مولی الوری.
reference: Light and glory, greeting and praise be upon the Hands of His Cause, through whom the light of fortitude hath shone forth and the truth hath been established that the authority to choose rests with God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Unconstrained, through whom the ocean of bounty hath surged and the fragrance of the gracious favors of God, the Lord of mankind, hath been diffused.
hyps: His light, His glory, His greetings, His praise rest upon them who have stretched forth the Hand of His Cause—hand that hath shed the radiance of forbearance—the hand that hath established that the commandment is for God, the Omnipotent, the Gracious, the Unrestrained; the hand that hath caused the ocean of bounty to surge and the fragrance of the loving-kindness of God, the Lord of mankind, to breathe.

The splendors of light and glory, of praise and thanksgiving, rest upon the Hands of His Cause—the hands through which the splendors of long suffering have been shed abroad, who have made the unqualified command of God, the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful, the Unrestrained, victorious—through whom the ocean of bounty hath surged, and the fragrance of the loving-kindness of God, the Lord of all men, hath been diffused throughout the world.

The splendours of His light, the brightness of His glory, the outpourings of His blessing and praise, rest upon them whose hands are the instruments of His Revelation, through which the light of forbearance hath shone forth and the law that 'God ordaineth what He willeth, is made firm,' hath been established, the power of Whose might is indomitable, Whose sovereignty is exalted, Who holdeth sway supreme. Through them hath the ocean of bounty surged, and the sweet savour of the grace of God, the Lord of mankind, hath been diffused.

The brightness of His countenance, the radiance of His glory, the exclamation of praise, the benediction on Him that the hands of His Cause are the means whereby the light of steadfastness shineth forth, and the truth that the decree that power belongeth to God, the All-Powerful, the Most Great, the Unrestrained is irrevocable, are through them; and He is the Fountainhead of bounty, and the Symbol of the fragrance of God, the Lord of all men.

Light, glory, salutation, praise be upon the Hands of His Cause, through whom the light of steadfastness hath shone forth, whose rule 'choice is God's, He Who is the Powerful, the All Glorious, the Unconstrained,' hath been established, through whom the ocean of bounty hath surged, and the fragrance of the love of God, the Lord of all men, hath been spread abroad.

Radiance and glory, greeting and praise be unto the hands of His Cause--the hands through which the light of patience hath shone forth and the ruling of 'leave it to God, the Omnipotent, the Almighty, the Unconstrained hath been established, through which the ocean of bounty hath surged and the sweet savors of divine grace have diffused from the Lord of all men.

Light and glory, salutations and praise be upon the hands of His Cause through which the light of fortitude hath shone forth and the decree 'choice lieth with God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Unconstrained' is confirmed, through which the ocean of bounty hath surged and the fragrance of the loving kindness of God, the Lord of all men, hath been wafted.

Light and glory rest upon the Hands of His Revelation, through which the splendor of steadfastness hath been revealed, and the command 'Powerful is the choice of God, the All-Powerful, the Supreme, the Unrestrained' hath been fulfilled, through which the Ocean of bounty hath surged, and the sweet savors of the loving-kindness of God have diffused throughout the world.

source: نسأله تعالی ان یحفظهم بجنوده و یحرسهم بسلطانه و ینصرهم بقدرته الّتی غلبت الأشیآء.
reference: We beseech Him—exalted is He—to shield them through the power of His hosts, to protect them through the potency of His dominion and to aid them through His indomitable strength which prevaileth over all created things.
hyps: We beseech Him—exalted is He—to shield them through His hosts, to protect them through His sovereignty, to aid them through His power that hath overshadowed all created things.
We entreat Him—exalted be He—to guard them through His hosts, and protect them by His sovereignty, and assist them through the power of His transcendent might which overshadoweth all created things.
We beseech Him—exalted be He—to protect them with His hosts, to guard them through His sovereignty, and to aid them through His power that nothing on earth can withstand.
We beseech Him—exalted be He—to protect them through His hosts, to guard them through His sovereignty and to assist them through His irresistible power which hath prevailed over all created things.

We ask Him—glorified be He—to protect them through the hosts of His army, to shield them through the power of His sovereignty and to assist them through His power which prevaileth over all created things.
We beseech Him—exalted be He—to protect them through His hosts, to guard them through His sovereignty, and to assist them through His power which hath prevailed over all things.

We beseech Him—exalted is He—to shield them through the power of His hosts, to guard them by the potency of His sovereignty and to strengthen them through His invincible power which nothing among His creatures can withstand.
We beseech Him—exalted be He—to guard them through His hosts, to protect them through His sovereignty, and to succor them through His transcendent power which hath prevailed over all things.

source: الملک لله فاطر السّمآء و مالک ملکوت الأسمآء.
reference: Sovereignty is God's, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of the Kingdom of Names.
hyps: All dominion belongeth to God, the Creator of the heavens and Lord of the kingdom of names.
Power belongeth to God, Creator of the heavens and Lord of the kingdom of names.
All sovereignty belongeth to God, the Creator of the heavens, the King of the Kingdom of Names.
Mankind and all that therein is must needs bow down before the power of the Almighty God, He that hath created the heaven, the Lord of the kingdom of names.
Majesty belongeth to God, the Creator of the heavens and the King of the Kingdom of Names.
Might and dominion rest with God, the Creator of the heavens and the King of the Kingdom of Names.
The Kingdom is Gods, the Creator of the heavens, and the Possessor of the kingdom of names.
The kingdom is God's, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of the Kingdom of Names.

source: نبأ عظیم میفرماید ای اصحاب ایران.
reference: The Great Announcement proclaimeth: O people of Persia.
hyps: The Great Announcement proclaimeth: O people of Persia!
Great indeed is the tidings He proclaimeth unto you, O people of Persia!
The Great Announcement calleth aloud: O ye inhabitants of Persia.
The Great Announcement saith: O people of Persia.
The Great Announcement saith: O people of Persia.
The Great Announcement saith: O people of Persia.
Great is the announcement which He, Who is the Lord of all nations, hath sent down unto you.
Such is My Great Announcement to the people of Persia.

source: شما مشارق رحمت و مطالع شفقت و محبّت بوده‌اید.
reference: In former times ye have been the symbols of mercy and the embodiments of affection and kindliness.
hyps: Ye have been the incarnations of tender mercies and the personifications of loving-kindness and compassion.
Ye have been the manifestations of compassion and the daysprings of tenderness and love.
In bygone ages ye have been the symbols of mercy and the embodiments of forbearance and love.
Ye were the dawning-places of My mercy, and the daysprings of My loving-kindness and good-will.
Ye have ever been the manifestations of His mercy and the daysprings of gentleness and love.
Ye have been the dawning-places of mercy and the daysprings of affection and love.
Ye were the dawns of mercy, and the daysprings of forbearance and love.
Ye have ever been the manifestations of His tender mercy and the dawning places of His loving kindness.

source: و آفاق وجود بنور خرد و دانش شما منوّر و مزیّن بوده.
reference: The regions of the world were illumined and embellished by the brightness of the light of your knowledge and by the blaze of your erudition.
hyps: The horizons of men's knowledge have been illumined and brightened through the light of Thy wisdom and understanding.
Then the horizons of existence were illumined with the splendors of your wisdom and knowledge.
Through you, the horizons of men's understanding were illumined and brightened with the radiance of your mind and knowledge.
The whole world hath been illumined and embellished through the light of your wisdom and knowledge.
The whole universe has been illumined and adorned with the light of your understanding and knowledge.
Then the world of being was illumined with the light of thine intellect, and was adorned with the ornament of thy knowledge.
All human life would have been illumined and adorned with the radiance of your wisdom and learning.
The world of being was illuminated and embellished by the shining light of thy wisdom and knowledge.

source: آیا چه شد که بدست خود بر هلاکت خود و دوستان خود قیام کردید.
reference: How is it that you have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands.
hyps: What prompted you to arise against yourselves and your friends.
What has come over you that ye have risen up to destroy yourselves and your friends.
How is it that you have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands.
How is it that ye have arisen to destroy yourselves and your loved ones?
How is it that of your own free will you have arisen to destroy yourselves and others who love you.
What is it that ye have done, that ye have arisen to destroy yourselves and your friends with your own hands
What has made you rise up against yourselves and your friends and ready to kill one another.
How can ye have arisen to take your own lives and those of your friends.

source: یا افنانی.
reference: O Afnán, O thou that hast branched from Mine ancient Stock.
hyps: O Afnán, my Branch.
O my Afnán.
O Afnán.
O Afnán, O my Branch, O the Lord of the Chosen Ones, He Who is the Object of the desires of the righteous and the Desire of the whole creation.
O My branch, O My Avan in My Tree.
O Afnán.
O My Avání!
O Afnán mine.

source: علیک بهائی و عنایتی.
reference: My glory and My loving-kindness rest upon thee.
hyps: Upon thee be My glory and My loving kindness.
On thee be My glory and My loving kindness.
Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness.
Upon thee be My glory and My loving kindness.
Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness.
On thee be My glory, and My loving kindness.
Upon thee be My glory and grace.
My glory and My loving kindness rest upon thee.

source: خیمهٴ امر الهی عظیم است.
reference: How vast is the tabernacle of the Cause of God.
hyps: How vast is the Tabernacle of the Revelation of God!
how vast is the tabernacle of divine Revelation.
Great indeed is the tabernacle of the Cause of God.
How vast is the Tabernacle of the Cause of God!
Great is the tent of the command of God.
What a spacious tent is that of the Revelation which the Almighty hath revealed.
How vast is the tabernacle of the Revelation vouchsafed unto thee!
How vast is the tabernacle of the Revelation of God.

source: جمیع احزاب عالم را فراگرفته و خواهد گرفت.
reference: It hath overshadowed all the peoples and kindreds of the earth, and will, ere long, gather together the whole of mankind beneath its shelter.
hyps: It hath absorbed all the peoples and kindreds of the earth, and shall continue to do so.
It hath embraced the kindreds of the earth, and will ere long unite all their peoples.
It hath embraced and will continue to embrace the entire human race.
They have attracted the attention of peoples throughout the world and will continue to attract until the whole of mankind shall be united in one bond.
It hath united diverse peoples, and will assuredly unite all peoples.
He hath drawn to Himself all the kindreds and peoples of the earth, and will in the end unite them all to His own Self.
It hath encompassed all the kindreds of the earth and will ere long gather together the whole of mankind.
It hath embraced, and will continue to embrace, the peoples and kindreds of the earth.

source: روز روز شماست.
reference: Thy day of service is now come.
hyps: Thine existence shall last as long as a day.
Each day of your life is to be regarded as a new day.
Thine own day endureth long.
Your day is your own.
Each day of your lives is the revealer of My glory.
What have ye done in these days that have passed in your presence.
Each day is thy day.
The day that is thine will come.

source: و هزار لوح گواه شما بر نصرت امر قیام نمائید.
reference: Countless Tablets bear the testimony of the bounties vouchsafed unto thee.
hyps: Countless Tablets testifying to the truth of God are waiting for you to reveal their testimony.
A myriad Tablets are available to testify on your behalf, and bear witness unto your victory.
Myriad Tablets testify to the veracity of that which We have revealed unto thee.
Every one of Thy thousands of Tablets which proclaim Thy victory will attest its truth.
Thousands of Tablets testifying to thy righteousness are ready to bear witness unto the triumph of this Revelation.
Countless Tablets attest Your testimony to the triumph that will be vouchsafed unto this Cause.
and thousands of Tablets testify to thy testimony.
Countless Tablets testify to the truth of this revelation. Arise to further its triumph.

source: و بجنود بیان بتسخیر افئده و قلوب اهل عالم مشغول شوید.
reference: Arise for the triumph of My Cause, and, through the power of thine utterance, subdue the hearts of men.
hyps: With the host of Your utterance subdue ye the hearts of men.
Arise ye for My Cause, and with the hosts of utterance subdue the souls and hearts of men.
Gird yourselves for this task through the power of the host of Mine utterance, and subdue the hearts and souls of all that dwell on earth.
Gird yourselves for battle, and through the power of thine utterance subdue the hearts of the peoples of the world.
With the hosts of thine utterance subdue ye the souls of men.
Arise to conquer the hearts and minds of men through the power of the words which thou dost unloose from thine mouth.
Do ye, by the hosts of My utterance, bend the wills and conquer the hearts of the peoples of the earth.
Raise up the hosts of Thy utterance to gain control of the minds and hearts of all the dwellers on earth.

source: باید از شما ظاهر شود آنچه که سبب آسایش و راحت بیچارگان روزگار است.
reference: Thou must show forth that which will ensure the peace and the well-being of the miserable and the downtrodden.
hyps: It is incumbent upon thee to show forth that which will be conducive to the well-being and comfort of those who are sorely afflicted and desolate.
It behooveth thee to show forth that which will be conducive to the well-being and comfort of the poor and afflicted.
That which will redound to the well-being and peace of the helpless is for thee to manifest.
It is incumbent upon thee to show forth that which will assure the well-being and tranquillity of the down-trodden.
It behooveth you to show forth that which will be the cause of the well-being and comfort of the orphan and the indigent.
It behooveth thee to show forth that which will conduce to the well-being and tranquillity of the down-trodden of the earth.
It behooveth thee to show forth that which will be a means for the peace and well-being of the poor.
Out of thee must needs come forth that which will insure the tranquillity and well-being of the down-trodden.

source: کمر همّت را محکم نمائید شاید بندگان از اسیری فارغ شوند و بآزادی رسند.
reference: Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that perchance thou mayest release the captive from his chains, and enable him to attain unto true liberty.
hyps: Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that haply thy people may be released from bondage, and attain unto true liberty.
Tighten your girdles of endeavor that haply the captive may gain his freedom and attain unto true liberty.
Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that perchance thy servants may be set free from the bondage of this world and attain unto true liberty.
Strengthen ye the reins of endeavor, that haply men may be released from their bondage and attain unto true liberty.
Gird up the loins of your endeavor, that perchance the captive ye may set him free and enable him to attain unto true liberty.
Strengthen ye the reins of endeavor, that haply men may rid themselves of the bondage which chaineth them, and attain unto true liberty.
Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that haply they who are in bondage may be delivered from captivity and attain unto liberty.
Gird up the loins of thine endeavor, that haply thou mayest free the captive from his chains, and enable him to attain unto true liberty.

source: امروز نالهٴ عدل بلند و حنین انصاف مرتفع.
reference: Justice is, in this day, bewailing its plight, and Equity groaneth beneath the yoke of oppression.
hyps: Today the voice of justice is raised and the cry of equity is lifted up.
Justice is being stifled in this day, and the voice of equity smothered.
Justice groaneth in this day, and equity lamenteth.
Justice calleth aloud, and Equity is sorely vexed in this day.
Justice calleth aloud in this Day, and equity grieveth.
Today justice is crying out, and fairness groaneth.
Justice hath today raised its voice, and Fairness hath raised its cry.
Justice calleth aloud in this Day, and Equity proclaimeth with a loud voice that which it desireth.

source: دود تیرهٴ ستم عالم و امم را احاطه نموده.
reference: The thick clouds of tyranny have darkened the face of the earth, and enveloped its peoples.
hyps: The thick darkness of oppression hath clouded the heaven of justice.
Dark clouds of punishment have fallen on all mankind.
The thick clouds of tyranny have enwrapped the peoples and nations of the world.
Darkness hath fallen upon both lands, and the peoples thereof.
The thick clouds of tyranny have overshadowed the face of the earth.
The thick smoke of tyranny envelopeth the earth and all its peoples.
Such is the fierce hot breath of tyranny which hath enveloped all nations and peoples.
The dark cloud of tyranny hath enveloped the world and its peoples.

source: از حرکت قلم اعلی روح جدید معانی بامر آمر حقیقی در اجساد الفاظ دمیده شد.
reference: Through the movement of Our Pen of glory We have, at the bidding of the omnipotent Ordainer, breathed a new life into every human frame, and instilled into every word a fresh potency.
hyps: Through the movement of the Pen of Glory, a new spirit was infused into every human frame, through the revelation of His potent and irrevocable decree.
Through the movement of the Pen of the All-Glorious He hath infused a fresh spirit into every word and given it a new significance.
A fresh inspiration has been imparted to every word through the movement of His Pen—a Pen wherewith has been written the decree of Him Who is the Ordainer, the Infallible.
Through the movement of My Pen, a new Spirit hath, as decreed by Him Who is the Ordainer, the Supreme Ordainer, breathed fresh inspiration into each word which My tongue articulateth.
Through the movement of Our Pen of Glory a new soul hath been infused by Him Who is the Ordainer, the Infallible, into every human heart.
Through the movement of His Pen, the Most Sublime Spirit hath, through the command of Him Who is the Unconstrained Ordainer, infused new meanings into every human frame.
Through the movement of the Pen of Glory new ideas were generated, and, through the decree of Him Who is the Ordainer, these ideas have been infused into the bodies of the words.
Through the movement of this Pen the Most Exalted Spirit hath imparted through His behests of His sovereign Will new meanings into the bodies of My words.

source: و آثارش در جمیع اشیای عالم ظاهر و هویدا.
reference: All created things proclaim the evidences of this worldwide regeneration.
hyps: and the evidences thereof shall appear and be manifest in all things in the world.
Wherever Thou seest any of His creatures, there also wilt Thou discover the evidences of His power and glory.
Its evidences appear in all created things.
Through Him the evidences of God's all-pervasive power have been manifested and are clearly discernible throughout the entire creation.
His evidences are visible in all created things.
Its signs are manifest in all created things.
His evidences are apparent and manifest in all created things.
His signs appear in all created things.

source: اینست بشارت اعظم که از قلم مظلوم جاری شده.
reference: This is the most great, the most joyful tidings imparted by the Pen of this Wronged One to mankind.
hyps: This is the most wondrous tidings that have streamed forth from this Wronged One's Pen.
This is the most joyful tidings that have streamed forth from this Wronged One.
This is the Most Great Announcement that hath streamed forth from this Wronged One's Pen.
This is the most great tidings that have streamed forth from this Wronged One's Pen.
This is the most great, this the most joyful tidings which the Pen of this Wronged One hath conveyed to men.
This indeed is that most exalted tidings which have flowed down from Our Wronged Self.
This is the Supreme Announcement that hath streamed forth from this Wronged One's Pen.
This is the supreme tidings that have streamed forth from Our Pen that hath been sorely wronged.

source: بگو ای دوستان ترس از برای چه.
reference: Wherefore fear ye, O My well-beloved ones.
hyps: Fear ye nothing, O friends.
What is it that maketh you so fearful, O ye friends.
Fear ye, O friends, of what fear, say.
Let me say unto you, O My beloved ones, fear what.
Lay not aside fear and trembling, O ye that love Me.
Say: What is it that maketh you afraid, O My friends.
Say: O ye loved ones of God, what is it that can frighten you.
Say, O friends, what can be your fear

source: و بیم از که.
reference: Who is it that can dismay you.
hyps: And whose fear is it that shall be the cause of your safety.
And of whom be ye fearful.
Whom doth He dread
What protection is there against it.
And for whose terror.
By what name is he known.
Wherefore are ye afraid.
Who is it, then, to be feared

source: گلپار‌ه‌های عالم باندک رطوبتی متلاشی شده و میشوند.
reference: A touch of moisture sufficeth to dissolve the hardened clay out of which this perverse generation is molded.
hyps: All the life-giving showers of the world have ceased to fall upon your hearts, and this is grievous for you.
The flowers of the earth turn to dust in a twinkling.
All the flowers of earth wither away, however much they may be watered.
All that the world holds dear may turn to dust and ashes.
And all the sweet savors that used to issue therefrom have been blotted out, and will continue to be effaced.
Every flower in the world is crushed beneath the burden of its own wetness.
the petals of the flowers that bloom in the vale of life fade away and disappear.
All the flowers of the earth are, in the twinkling of an eye, withered away.

source: نفس اجتماع سبب تفریق نفوس موهومه است.
reference: The mere act of your gathering together is enough to scatter the forces of these vain and worthless people.
hyps: The mere fact that they hold a meeting is enough to disperse the gathered multitudes.
The mere act of gathering together should suffice to scatter the forces of these vain and worthless people.
The very act of your assembling together hath scattered these vain souls.
That which causeth the gathering together of men is what driveth away those who have no real existence.
The mere fact of your gathering together is enough to drive away the imaginations of such men.
Your very gathering is enough to drive away these worthless ones.
Every act of reunion amongst them that are destitute of any real faith is the cause of the separation of those persons that are invested with the veritable essence of faith.
For association causeth estrangement among deluded souls.

source: نزاع و جدال شأن درنده‌های ارض.
reference: Strife and conflict befit the beasts of the wild.
hyps: Strife and conflict befit but the beasts of the forest.
Strife and conflict beseem the brutes.
Strife and contention befit the beasts of the wild.
Strife and conflict beseem the beasts of the wilderness.
Contention and strife befit beasts of the wild.
Controversy and strife are meet for beasts and brutes.
Disputes and dissensions beseem the beasts of the forest.
Controversy and strife befit beasts of the earth.

source: بیاری باری شمشیرهای برندهٴ حزب بابی بگفتار نیک و کردار پسندیده بغلاف راجع.
reference: It was through the grace of God and with the aid of seemly words and praiseworthy deeds that the unsheathed swords of the Bábí community were returned to their scabbards.
hyps: This is to inform you that the unfortunate people of Bár, whose swords were rent in two by the Bábís' victorious blades, have been pacified by their gentle speech and praiseworthy conduct, and have returned home.
By the grace of God and the mercy of His loving kindness, the swords of victory have been beaten into ploughshares, and the weapons of hostility changed into peaceful instruments.
At length the swordsmen of the Bábís who were in the company of the Báb made it known to him by kind speech and deed that they were of one mind with Him.
Báríyát, however, were of one heart with those of Bábí, for they admired the kind speech and praiseworthy deeds of the Bábís, and used to retaliate with forbearance.
Biaríy-i-Bárí the victorious swords of the Bábís were charmed by their eloquent speech and pleasing behavior and they returned wrapped in coverings.
The Bábís were victorious swords, whose eloquent tongues and praiseworthy deeds caused the enemy to flee.
With the sword of victory in His hand and kind words and praiseworthy deeds as his cover, He returned.
And the Bábís with their sweet words and praiseworthy deeds won back and converted those swords that had run him down.

source: لازال اخیار بگفتار حدائق وجود را تصرّف نمودند.
reference: Indeed through the power of good words, the righteous have always succeeded in winning command over the meads of the hearts of men.
hyps: From time immemorial men of virtue have used their tongues to influence for good the hearts of mankind.
From the beginning of time the Tongue of Excellence hath been the garden wherein the plants of human excellence have been nurtured.
From eternity the tongue of Him Who is My Well-Beloved hath, in the language of all creation, evoked the fragrance of the Rose Garden of His Revelation.
Through the power of My tongue the garden of life hath been made to flourish.
From eternity to eternity the flowers of praise shed by the tongues of the loved ones of God will continue to fill the garden of His revelation.
The tongues of the well-disposed will everlastingly exert themselves in such wise that the gardens of men's hearts may be filled with fragrance and sweetness.
Verily I say, the language of the righteous hath ever had the power to transfigure the realities of men.
The tongue of every man of virtue hath ever been a haven of delight to those that dwell in the paradises of existence.

source: بگو ای دوستان.
reference: Say, O ye loved ones.
hyps: Say, O My Friends.
O My friends.
Say: O My well-beloved ones.
O My friends.
Say, O My loved ones.
Say: O friends.
Say: O ye My dear ones.
Say: O ye My beloved.

source: حکمت را از دست مدهید.
reference: Do not forsake prudence.
hyps: Let not your wisdom be lost to you.
Be careful lest haply ye deal unwisely.
Let him hold fast to Wisdom.
Cast not away wisdom from your grasp.
Leave not your wisdom in your hands,
Cast ye not away wisdom.
Bestow on Him Thy wisdom.
Let not your hearts grow careless of wisdom.

source: نصائح قلم اعلی را بگوش هوش بشنوید عموم اهل عالم باید از ضرّ دست و زبان شما آسوده باشند.
reference: Incline your hearts to the counsels given by the Most Exalted Pen and beware lest your hands or tongues cause harm unto anyone among mankind.
hyps: Give ear unto the counsels given by Our Most Exalted Pen and beware lest your hands or your tongues inflict harm upon anyone among mankind.
Give ear unto the counsels uttered by My Pen of Glory and abstain ye henceforth from all hurtful acts and words.
Give ear unto the counsels given by the Most Exalted Pen, and beware lest ye inflict harm upon any one through your hands or tongues.
Give ear to the counsels of Our Pen of Glory, for all the dwellers upon earth must be free from the harm which thy hands or thy tongue can inflict.
Let ye listen with thine inner ear unto the counsels given by Our Pen of Glory, for both thou and all the peoples of the earth will suffer harm through thy hands and thy tongue.
Hearken ye to the counsels given by My Pen of Glory with thine inner ear, for all the peoples of the world must be well safeguarded from the harm which thy hands and thy tongue may inflict upon them.
Incline your hearts to the counsels given by Our Most Exalted Pen, and take heed that ye cause no harm through your acts or your tongues to any one among God's creatures.
Give ear to the counsels of Our Pen of Glory, for every one on earth must be protected against the harm which thy hands and tongue can inflict.

source: در کتاب اقدس در ذکر ارض طاء نازل شده آنچه که سبب انتباه عالمیانست.
reference: Referring to the land of Tá Tihrán We have revealed in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas that which will admonish mankind.
hyps: Concerning the land of Tá, these words have been revealed in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas: which will be food for thought unto men.
In the Book of God We have revealed regarding the Land of Tá so much that it would be a warning unto everyone who reflecteth in his heart.
In the Kitab-i-Aqdas, there hath been revealed concerning this land Tah that which will serve to awaken the minds of mankind.
In the Kitab-i-Aqdas there hath been revealed concerning the Land of Tá a passage that will call the heedless to attention.
The following hath been revealed concerning the Land of Tá Tihrán in the Kitab-i-Aqdas and hath been made known to warn men.
In the Kitab-i-Aqdas mention hath been made of the land of Tá Tihrán.
In the Kitáb-i-Aqdas We have revealed concerning the Land of Tá tabulations which will awaken mankind.
In the Kitáb-i-Aqdas mention hath been made of the Land of Tá Tihrán which is intended as a warning unto men.

source: ظالمهای عالم حقوق امم را غصب نموده‌اند و بتمام قدرت و قوّت بمشتهیات نفوس خود مشغول بوده و هستند.
reference: They that perpetrate tyranny in the world have usurped the rights of the peoples and kindreds of the earth and are sedulously pursuing their selfish inclinations.
hyps: The tyrants of the world have seized the heritage which appertaineth unto all the nations of the earth, and have been and are busying themselves, wholly to their own liking, with the exertion of their power.

Such of the oppressors of the world as have usurped the rights of other peoples and nations, and whose eyes are shut to the interests of the masses of their subjects, have ever sought and are now seeking to further their own selfish inclinations.
The tyrants of the earth have usurped the birthright of others, and they pursue what they desire.

Injustice is rife in the land. The oppressors have transgressed against the rights of all nations, and have been and still are pursuing with all their might and main, to satisfy their own base desires.
The oppressors of the earth have usurped the rights of every nation and are at work seeking to satisfy their own passions.
The oppressors of the world have invaded the territories of other nations and are busying themselves with seeking to gratify their own desires.
The tyrants of the world have withheld the rights of all nations and peoples and are fully intent on pursuing, and will continue to pursue, their own selfish inclinations.
The tyrants of the world have usurped the rights and properties of other nations, and are to this day engaged, as much as layeth in them, in gratifying the lusts of their own passions.

source: از ظالم ارض یاء ظاهر شد آنچه که عیون ملأ اعلی خون گریست.
reference: The tyrant of the land of Yá Yazd, committed that which hath caused the Concourse on High to shed tears of blood.
hyps: Such cruelties were inflicted by that oppressor of the land Yá Hámíd, whose deeds have caused the Concourse on High to weep sore.
Behold how at the hand of the tyrant who bore the Yá Mírzá the Báb had to suffer that the eyes of the Concourse on high were made to weep with tears of blood.

The tyrant of that land named Yahyá caused his sons to be brought out, and he tore them from each other's embraces, and ordered them to be slain, while the tears of the Concourse on High streamed down and fell upon them.
In this land of Ya'zíd an implacable tyrant, there befell that which hath caused the Concourse on high to weep with a weeping that is bitter and sore.
Then the tyrant of that land committed what caused the Concourse on High to weep.
The tyrant of the land of Ya Ha-Mu'lixir showed forth what caused the eyes of the Concourse on high to flow with tears.
Then from that sultán who was the letter Ya, 'the apparent,' there appeared that which hath caused the Concourse on high to shed tears of blood.
Behold how the oppressor hath risen up against the land of Ya-Húd and shed the blood of the holy ones before the eyes of all who dwell on high.

source: یا ایّها الشّارب رحیق بیانی و النّاظر الی افق ظهوری.
reference: O thou who hast quaffed from the wine of Mine utterance and hast fixed thy gaze upon the horizon of My Revelation.
hyps: O thou who hast quaffed the choice wine of My utterance, and fixed thy gaze upon the horizon of My Revelation.
O thou who hast quaffed the wine of My words and fixed thine eyes upon the horizon of My Revelation.
O thou who hast partaken of the choice wine of My utterance, and fixed thine eyes upon the horizon of My Revelation.
O thou who hast quaffed My words which are like unto the choicest wine, who hast fixed thy gaze upon the horizon of My Revelation.
Thou who hast quaffed the wine of Mine utterance, and settest thine eyes upon the horizon of My Revelation.
O thou who hast drunk of the choice wine of Mine utterance, and fixed thine eyes on the horizon of My Revelation!
O thou that hast quaffed the choice wine of Mine utterance and fixed thine eyes upon the horizon of My Revelation.
Thou who hast quaffed the choice wine of My utterance, thou that hast fixed thy gaze upon the horizon of My Revelation.

source: آیا چه شده که اهل ایران مع اسبقیّتشان در علوم و فنون حال پست‌تر از جمیع احزاب عالم مشاهده میشوند.
reference: How strange that the people of Persia, who were unrivalled in sciences and arts, should have sunk to the lowest level of degradation among the kindreds of the earth.
hyps: What has happened that the people of Persia—once the world's most learned and civilized nation—are today the most wretched and degraded of all its peoples?
How strange that the people of Persia—who stand out so strikingly for their learning and culture—should have become the most abject of all peoples on earth.
How strange that the people of Persia, who rank first in sciences and arts, should be in this age the most abject of all peoples.
How is it that the people of Persia, who once excelled all others in science and art, should be lower even than the beasts of the field.
How strange that the people of Persia, who were pre-eminent in sciences and arts, should now be the most pitiable of all the nations of the world.
How strange that the people of Persia, despite their being preeminent in science and technology, should be lower than the lowliest of God's creatures.
How has it come about that the people of Persia, who are so distinguished for their scientific attainments, are today the most degraded of all the peoples on earth.
How strange that a nation preeminent in culture and science should have fallen to the level of the lowliest among the peoples of the world.

source: در این یوم مبارک منیر خود را از فیوضات فیّاض محروم منمائید.
reference: In this blessed, this glorious Day, deprive not yourselves of the liberal effusions of bounty which the Lord of abounding grace hath vouchsafed unto you.
hyps: This Day, this blessed, this resplendent Day, deprive not yourselves of the outpourings of His grace.
In this blessed and shining Day, deprive not yourselves of the grace of the Lord of grace.
In this blessed and sunshiny Day deprive not yourselves of the gracious favors vouchsafed unto you.
On this most blessed and resplendent Day deprive not yourselves of the bounty with which God, the Most Bountiful, hath enriched you.
In this blessed and resplendent Day withhold not yourselves from the grace-giving bounties of Him Who is the Lord of all bounty.
In this most blessed, this all-enlightening Day, deprive not yourselves of the copious blessings with which God, in His plenteousness, hath bountifully favored you.
On this blessed and glorious Day deprive not yourselves of the bounty vouchsafed through the grace of a munificent Lord.
In this blessed, this glorious Day deprive not yourselves of the grace of Him Who bestoweth bounties.

source: امروز از سحاب رحمت رحمانی امطار حکمت و بیان نازل.
reference: In this Day showers of wisdom and utterance are pouring down from the clouds of divine mercy.
hyps: Today showers of wisdom and utterance have rained down out of the clouds of divine mercy.
In this Day the clouds of divine mercy have poured down upon mankind showers of wisdom and utterance.
In this day the clouds of divine mercy have rained their bounty upon men through Him Who is the Dayspring of wisdom and utterance.
In this Day showers of divine wisdom have poured down from the clouds of heaven, and are being vouchsafed unto mankind.
In this day showers of wisdom and utterance are pouring down from the clouds of the mercy of the Merciful One.
In this Day showers of divine wisdom and utterance have rained down from the clouds of the mercy of God.
This day from the clouds of Divine mercy showers of wisdom and utterance are being poured.
In this day showers of divine wisdom and utterance are descending from the clouds of God's mercy.

source: طوبی لمن انصف فی الأمر و ویل للظّالمین.
reference: Well is it with them who judge His Cause with fairness, and woe betide the unjust.
hyps: Blessed be he that judgeth equitably My Cause, and woe betide such as act unjustly.
Blessed that one who judgeth the Cause with equity. Woe unto them that act unjustly.
Happy is he that judgeth My Cause with fairness, and woe betide the transgressors.
Blessed those who judge this Revelation with fairness, and woe betide the transgressors.
Blessed is he who judge this Cause with justice, and woe betide them that act unjustly.
Happy those who judge My Cause with equity, and woe betide every unjust oppressor thereof.
Blessed are those who judge His Cause with fairness, and woe betide every unjust one.
Blessed the man that judgeth His Cause equitably, and woe betide the unjust.

source: امروز هر آگاهی گواهی میدهد بر اینکه بیاناتی که از قلم مظلوم نازل شده سبب اعظم است از برای ارتفاع عالم و ارتقاء امم.
reference: Every man of insight will, in this day, readily admit that the counsels which the Pen of this Wronged One hath revealed constitute the supreme animating power for the advancement of the world and the exaltation of its peoples.
hyps: Every enlightened mind testifieth in this day that the words which have streamed forth from this Wronged One constitute the mightiest instrument for the promotion of the world and the exaltation of its peoples.

This day every man of insight will readily bear witness that the words which have been revealed by this wronged One constitute the highest instrument for the elevation of the world and the exaltation of its peoples.

In this day every man of insight will readily admit that the words which have streamed forth from this Wronged One constitute the greatest means for the exaltation of the world and the upraising of its peoples.

Every well-informed person will, in this Day, readily admit that the counsels uttered by the Pen of this Wronged One are verily the most effective means for the upliftment of mankind and the exaltation of nations.

In this day whoso is endued with understanding will readily admit that whatsoever hath streamed forth from the Pen of this Wronged One is the most potent instrument for the exaltation of mankind and the advancement of the nations.

Every man endued with insight beareth witness to this truth that the utterances which have gone forth from the Pen of this Wronged One constitute the greatest instrument for the exaltation of the world and the advancement of its peoples.

Everyone who understandeth this Cause will testify that the counsels which the Pen of this Wronged One hath revealed are the most potent means for the advancement and exaltation of the world and the nations.

Every man of insight will testify in this Day that these utterances which have streamed forth from the Pen of this Wronged One constitute the supreme instrument for the exaltation of the world and the advancement of its peoples.

source: بگو ای قوم بقوّت ملکوتی بر نصرت خود قیام نمائید که شاید ارض از اصنام ظنون و اوهام که فی‌الحقیقه سبب و علّت خسارت و ذلّت عباد بیچاره‌اند پاک و طاهر گردد.
reference: Arise, O people, and, by the power of God's might, resolve to gain the victory over your own selves, that haply the whole earth may be freed and sanctified from its servitude to the gods of its idle fancies—gods that have inflicted such loss upon, and are responsible for the misery of their wretched worshippers.
hyps: Rise up, O people, and through the power of God which is in you, struggle against your selfish desires, that perchance your land may be freed from its idols of ignorance and vain imaginings, which in truth have caused and provoked the loss and humiliation of this hapless people.

Gird yourselves up for your own victory, O people, through the power of the Kingdom, that haply the land may be rid of the idols of its vain imaginings and fancies, which have caused the people to slip and fall into grievous loss and abasement.

Rise up, O people, and through the power of His might assist Him Who is the King of the Kingdoms to triumph over His enemies, that haply the land may be cleansed and sanctified from the idols of men's fancies, which are in truth a cause and a reason for loss and shame unto such as are in dire need.

Arise, O people, and, through the power of God's sovereign might, seek ye to gain ascendancy over your own selves, that haply the land may be cleansed and sanctified from the idols of vain imaginings which are the prime cause and reason of the people's loss and abasement.

Arise, O people, and fortify yourselves against your own transgressions, that haply the land may be cleansed of its idols of superstition and vain fancy, which, though professedly designed for the good of humanity, have been the cause of loss and wretchedness to all mankind.

Arise, O people, to conquer the kingdom of thine own being through the power of God, that haply the land may be cleansed and sanctified from the idols of its vain imaginings and superstitions—those idols which have truly brought ruin and disgrace upon the helpless souls who bow before them.

Strive, O people, to arise by the power of God's might for His victorious cause, that haply the world may be freed and sanctified from the idols of its vain imaginings and idle fancies—a thing, verily, which would remove from God's creatures the signs of loss and abasement.

Arise, O people, through the power of His Might, for your own deliverance, that haply ye may blot out all idle fancies and vain imaginings, which are, verily, a cause and instrument of loss and abasement unto men, and may render this land free from them.

source: این اصنام حائلند و خلق را از علوّ و صعود.
reference: These idols form the obstacle that impedeth man in his efforts to advance in the path of perfection.
hyps: They that have set up these idols form obstacles to peoples and kindreds attaining unto heights of glory and distinction.
These idols lie in the way and hinder man's progress in life.
Idols are obstacles that impede men's progress towards spiritual advancement and hinder their souls from ascending unto the realm of God.
These idols have come in between Us and the people, and debarred them from advancement and development.
These idols form obstacles which obstruct the progress of man on his path to advancement and elevation.
These idols form the obstruction which preventeth men from attaining unto advancement and spiritual progress.
These idols are the cause of the people's being deprived of that advancement and progress which would enable them to scale the heights of perfection.
These idols lie across the path which leadeth to advancement and progress.

source: مانع امید آنکه ید اقتدار مدد فرماید و ناس را از ذلّت کبری برهاند.
reference: We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance to mankind and deliver it from its state of grievous abasement.
hyps: We cherish the vain hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance and deliver men out of their state of grievous abasement.
We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its aid to mankind and deliver it from its state of woeful abasement.
We cherish the hope that He may extend His gracious aid unto men, and deliver them out of their state of grievous abasement.
Our hope is that the Hand of divine power may lend aid and rescue mankind from its state of grievous abasement.
We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance unto men, and deliver them from their state of grievous abasement.
Our hope is that the Hand of Omnipotence may render assistance and deliver mankind out of its state of grievous abasement.
We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance to man and deliver him from his state of grievous abasement.
We cherish the hope that the Hand of divine power may lend its assistance, and deliver mankind from its state of grievous abasement.

source: در یکی از الواح نازل یا حزب الله.
reference: In one of the Tablets these words have been revealed: O people of God.
hyps: In one of Our Tablets We have revealed: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets We have revealed: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets, We have revealed: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets We have revealed these words addressed unto the people of God: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets We have revealed: O people of God!
In one of Our Tablets We have revealed: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets We have revealed: O people of God.
In one of Our Tablets these words have been revealed: O people of God.

source: بخود مشغول نباشید در فکر اصلاح عالم و تهذیب امم باشید.
reference: Do not busy yourselves in your own concerns. let your thoughts be fixed upon that which will rehabilitate the fortunes of mankind and sanctify the hearts and souls of men.
hyps: Cease to busy yourselves with your own concerns. occupy your hearts with efforts for the betterment of the world and the spiritual purification of its peoples.
Let not your concern be for yourselves but rather think of establishing the world order and edifying its peoples.
Do not busy yourselves in your own concerns. ponder rather on that which will conduce to the reconstruction and reformation of the world, and to the regeneration and purification of its peoples.
Do not preoccupy yourselves with your own concerns, busy yourselves with the reformation of the world and the regeneration of its peoples.
Be not busy about yourselves. turn your thoughts towards the reconstruction of the world and the regeneration of its peoples.
Lose not yourselves in your own concerns, busy yourselves with the betterment of mankind and the reformation of nations.
Let not your concern be confined to yourselves, but rather fix your thoughts upon that which would edify mankind, and reform its ways.
Let not your thoughts be absorbed by your own concerns but rather be intent on the reconstruction of the world and the regeneration of its peoples.

source: اصلاح عالم از اعمال طیّبهٴ طاهره و اخلاق راضیهٴ مرضیّه بوده.
reference: This can best be achieved through pure and holy deeds, through a virtuous life and a goodly behavior.
hyps: The reconstruction of the world can never be achieved except through the deeds of the righteous, the pure, the goodly and the upright.
To reconstruct the world, it hath ever been, through the deeds that are pure and stainless, through the virtues that are acceptable and well pleasing to God.
What would have been required to reconstruct the world would have been pure and holy deeds, upright and pleasing behavior.
the reformation of the world hath been achieved through the works that were pure and stainless, through deeds that were pleasing and acceptable.
The reconstruction of the world dependeth upon goodly deeds and stainless acts and praiseworthy character and pure conduct.
The reformation of the world hath depended upon righteous and sanctifying deeds and a praiseworthy and acceptable character.
the reformation of the world hath ever depended on pure and holy deeds and upon praiseworthy and commendable qualities.
The reconstruction of the world must be achieved through pious deeds and a saintly life.

source: ناصر امر اعمالست و معینش اخلاق.
reference: Valiant acts will ensure the triumph of this Cause, and a saintly character will reinforce its power.
hyps: The helper of deeds is valor; the supporter of virtue is a goodly character.
To aid its cause is to further its works; and to assist its interests is to strengthen its character.
Valiant actions will insure the triumph of this Cause, while sterling character will reinforce its power.
His deeds will ensure victory for His Cause, and his character will strengthen it.
It is valor that winneth battles, and piety that secureth victory.
His works are the helper of His Cause, and virtue is the succorer of His Faith.
Valiant acts will ensure the victory of virtue and high resolve will strengthen its power.
Aiding deeds is the duty of piety and virtuous conduct.

source: بتقوی تمسّک نمائید هذا ما حکم به المظلوم و اختاره المختار.
reference: This, verily, is the commandment which this Wronged One hath given unto you, and the first choice of His unrestrained Will for every one of you.
hyps: Covetousness is strongly condemned. Thus hath it been decreed by this Wronged One, and thus hath it been chosen by Him Who acteth according to His own choice
Let Him Who is God, through His might and power, be your Guide, let His fear be your fear, this is what this Wronged One hath commanded, what He, in His supreme authority, hath chosen for Himself.
Covetousness have I forbidden you, and for this hath this Wronged One prescribed, and to this doth He Himself firmly adhere.
God, beareth Me witness that it behooveth you to cleave tenaciously unto piety. Thus hath the Wronged One commanded, and in this hath He irrevocably ordained for Himself.
Let Him Who feareth God be your standard and pattern. Such is the injunction given by this Wronged One, and such the choice of His unconditioned Will.
This commandment have I received from Him Who suffered grievously at the hand of men. this have I chosen as My own choice.
Let Him Who is the Fear of God, take ye hold. This is that which this Wronged One hath prescribed, and chosen for Himself.
This practice, We have directed in Our decree, is firmly established through the operation of divine power.

source: ای دوستان.
reference: O friends.
hyps: O friends.
O friends.
O ye friends of God.
O Friends.
O friends.
O friends.
O friends.
O My friends!

source: سزاوار آنکه در این بهار جانفزا از باران نیسان یزدانی تازه و خرّم شوید.
reference: It behooveth you to refresh and revive your souls through the gracious favors which in this Divine, this soul-stirring Springtime are being showered upon you.
hyps: It behooveth you to refresh and revive your souls through the gracious favors which have been showered upon you in this, the most gracious, this glorious and soul-stirring Springtime.
It behooveth you to refresh your hearts through this soul-stirring Springtime which hath been sent down from God, the Lord of creation.
It behooveth you to refresh and strengthen your souls through the sweet dew of divine grace which in this alluring springtime is being poured out upon you.
Behold how fair it is that ye should revive and freshen your souls in this refulgent Springtime through the gracious favors of the divine breeze which is blowing.
It behooveth you to refresh your souls through this invigorating Spring, by the grace of the celestial rain which is vouchsafed unto you.

Fain would it be that ye may, this very springtime, revive and flourish through the gracious outpourings of the divine bounty, even as the fresh and verdant shoots which the rain of God hath caused to spring forth.
It behooveth you to refresh and revive yourselves in this Divine, this reviving Springtime through the gracious favors which have descended upon you from the heaven of God, the Eternal.
It behooveth you to refresh and revive your souls through this invigorating, heavenly dew that now raineth upon you.

source: خورشید بزرگی پرتو افکنده و ابر بخشش سایه گسترده.
reference: The Daystar of His great glory hath shed its radiance upon you, and the clouds of His limitless grace have overshadowed you.
hyps: That great luminary is shining with the rays of the sun, and that cloud of grace hath overshadowed us all with its shadow.
The sun of grace hath shed its splendor upon you, and the cloud of bounty hath overshadowed you.
Great is the Sun, whose radiance is shed abroad; mighty is the Rain that bringeth forth life from dead earth.
May the sun of His glory shine brightly upon you, and may the clouds of His bounteousness overshadow you.
Great is the light which the sun hath shed upon you, and bountiful the shadow which the clouds have cast over you.
A bright sun gave light and the clouds poured down rain.
The sun of His glory hath shed upon you its divine radiance, and the clouds of His bounty have overshadowed you.
May the Sun of Grandeur shed His rays, may the clouds of Bounty cast their shadow.

source: بابهره کسی که خود را بی‌بهره نساخت و دوست را در این جامه بشناخت.
reference: How high the reward of him that hath not deprived himself of so great a bounty, nor failed to recognize the beauty of his Best-Beloved in this, His new attire.
hyps: Woe to him that is bereft, who hath bereft himself of this blessed knowledge, and failed to recognize his best of friends in this vesture of glory.

How unfortunate is he who fails to recognize his true and only Báb, the Well-Bred One Who, at the present time, hath been made manifest, and Who is the Best of Companions to those that drink in this living water.
How great the loss of the one who hath refused to be fruitful and hath failed to recognize His Beloved in this, the Chalice of Divine Revelation.
Fie on the ungrateful one who hath refused to drink from this heavenly cup that He Who is the Well-Beloved hath given him.
Happy he that hath not defiled himself, who hath entered into the wedding feast in this, the new raiment.
Blind is he who hath refused to open his eyes for him who is His God-given Eye, Whom He hath chosen as His Friend and companion.
Blessed be he who hath not bereft himself of this bounteous favor and hath recognized his true friend in this new-crowned King.
Blessed is the man that hath been quickened by such grace, who hath recognized his own dear Friend in this most sublime Revelation.

source: بگو اهریمنان در کمین‌گاهان ایستاده‌اند آگاه باشید.
reference: Watch over yourselves, for the Evil One is lying in wait, ready to entrap you.
hyps: Beware lest Ahrimán, lying in wait and watching you, should waylay you in the paths of wickedness.
Watch over yourselves, for the Evil One is lying in wait, ready to catch you unawares.
Be mindful that Evil Ones have been lying in wait to ensnare you.
Be on your guard lest those who have maliciously plotted against Me take you unawares.
Beware of the deceitful devices which the Evil One hath laid for you.
Watch, for the Evil One is lying in wait, ready to entrap you.
Beware lest the Evil One layeth a trap for you.
Take heed that the Evil One layeth many a snare for you.

source: و بروشنائی نام بینا از تیرگیها خود را آزاد نمائید.
reference: Gird yourselves against his wicked devices, and, led by the light of the name of the All-Seeing God, make your escape from the darkness that surroundeth you.
hyps: Rise up, that the radiance of His Name may dispel the darkness out of which ye are born.
From darkness to light is the change that will transform your life.
Arise, and cast away your dross, that the radiance of the Name of the All-Seeing God may shine out in its glory.
Arise then, ye followers of the lamp of divine guidance, and shake off the slumber that bindeth you, and rid yourselves from the darkness that hath encompassed your understanding.
With the radiance of the name of God, deliver yourselves from the darkness that hath compassed about you.
By the light of His Name, the All-Seeing, make ye yourselves free from the darkness that surroundeth you.
And through the brightness of the light called Insight, deliver your souls from the darkness of blindness.
Illumine your faces with the name of the All-Seeing God, that ye may be freed from the darkness which hath enveloped you.

source: عالم‌بین باشید نه خودبین.
reference: Let your vision be world-embracing, rather than confined to your own self.
hyps: Be the light of the world, not of your own selves.
Let your vision be world-embracing, rather than confined to your own self.
Strive to discover the universal truth rather than your own.
Have your eyes fixed upon Him Who is the Manifestation of God amongst men, rather than upon the limited perceptions of your own selves.
Be ye other-centered, not self-centered.
Let your vision be world-embracing rather than confined to your own self.
Be ye of wide, not of petty, vision.
Let your sight be unto men and not unto your own selves.

source: اهریمنان نفوسی هستند که حائل و مانعند مابین عباد و ارتفاع و ارتقاء مقاماتشان.
reference: The Evil One is he that hindereth the rise and obstructeth the spiritual progress of the children of men.
hyps: Their task is to prevent men from drawing nigh unto God, and to hinder them from attaining His exalted station.
The Evil One is he that causeth obstruction, that impedeth the path between men and the attainment of heights and ascent thereof.
The Evil One is he who standeth in the way of men, and hindereth them from attaining unto the heights and stations they aspire to achieve.
The Evil One is that force which interposeth itself between men and the Lord, and hindereth them from advancing in His Path.
Ahriman are they who are hindrances and barriers to men, who prevent their advancement and keep them back from the heights to which they should soar.
These obstructers and impediments to the advance of man are the demons of hell; they are they whose actions are contrary to the Will of God.
Such men are Evil Spirits whose function is to obstruct the progress of God's servants and hold them back in a low estate.

These are they who obstruct the way of the children of men, hindering them from achieving advancement, and keeping back from them the station which their merits and qualifications should entitle them to hold.

source: امروز بر کلّ لازم و واجبست تمسّک نمایند بآنچه که سبب سموّ و علوّ دولت عادله و ملّت است.
reference: It is incumbent upon every man, in this Day, to hold fast unto whatsoever will promote the interests, and exalt the station, of all nations and just governments.
hyps: It is incumbent upon everyone in this Day to firmly adhere unto that which will be conducive to the advancement and exaltation of just governments and of their peoples.
It is incumbent upon every one in this Day to hold fast unto whatsoever will be conducive to the exaltation and development of the just government and of its people.
It is incumbent upon everyone in this Day to cleave to that which will exalt and uplift just governments and their peoples.
It is incumbent upon everyone in this day to cleave unto that which will exalt and raise up both the just government and its people.
It devolveth on every one in this Day to hold fast unto whatsoever will be conducive to the exaltation and advancement of this just Government and this people.
It is incumbent upon everyone, in this day, to hold fast unto that which would contribute to the exaltation and elevation of just governments and peoples.
It is incumbent upon every one, in this Day, to hold fast unto whatsoever will exalt and advance both the just Government and its people.
It is incumbent upon everyone in this Day to cling unto that which will conduce to the advancement and uprearing of the just government and its people.

source: قلم اعلی در هر یک از آیات ابواب محبّت و اتّحاد باز نموده.
reference: Through each and every one of the verses which the Pen of the Most High hath revealed, the doors of love and unity have been unlocked and flung open to the face of men.
hyps: Through every one of the verses revealed by the Pen of Glory We have unlocked the door of God's love to every heart.
Our Pen of Glory hath unravelled, one by one, each of these verses which speak of the doors of love and unity.
The Pen of Glory hath, in each one of these utterances, unlocked for thee the portals of concord and love.
The Pen of the Most High hath, in every one of these verses, flung open before thee the portals of loving-kindness and concord.
Through each of the verses which this Pen of Glory hath revealed, the doors of love and unity have been unlocked.
In every single verse the Pen of the Most High hath unlocked the doors of love and of unity.
He Who is the Pen of the Most High hath unriddled each one of these veils of separation and division.
Our Pen of Glory hath, in every one of Our verses, unlocked the doors that lead to love and unity.

source: قلنا و قولنا الحقّ عاشروا مع الأدیان کلّها بالرّوح و الرّیحان.
reference: We have erewhile declared—and Our Word is the truth—: Consort with the followers of all religions in a spirit of friendliness and fellowship.
hyps: We have said, and Our saying is the truth: Consort with all faiths, whether they be Jews, Christians, Zoroastrians, Hindus, Buddhists, or others in true fellowship and friendship.
We have said, and Our Word is the truth: Consort with all denominations in a spirit of friendliness and fellowship.
We have said—and Our word is the truth—be ye the associates of all religions with spiritual fragrance and sweetness.
We have said, and Our Word is the truth: Be friendly with all religions, nay, cherish them with affection and radiance.
We have already said—and Our words are the truth—be ye the friends of all religions; associate with all men in humility and reverence.
We have said, and Our word is the truth, associate with all religions with spirit and fragrance.
We have said—and Our word is the truth: Associate kindly with followers of all religions.
We have said and still say the truth: Consort with other religions in a spirit that is friendly and gentle.

source: از این بیان آنچه سبب اجتناب و علّت اختلاف و تفریق بود از میان برخاست.
reference: Whatsoever hath led the children of men to shun one another, and hath caused dissensions and divisions amongst them, hath, through the revelation of these words, been nullified and abolished.
hyps: Out of this exhortation arose what hath led to avoidance, and caused dissension and estrangement.
By virtue of these statements whatsoever had led men to turn aside one from another hath been dispelled, and whatsoever was the cause of dissension, difference and estrangement hath been removed.
Through these words there hath been removed that which was a cause of shyness, and a means of dissension and separation.
Through this utterance whatever had been an obstacle to unity or a cause of separation and estrangement was removed.
Whatsoever hath been said hath failed to effect harmony amongst you, and hath led you to turn aside from God.
Through the elucidations which I have made above, whatsoever led to repudiation, and was the cause of conflict and dispersion hath passed away.
Through the words of this Bayán all that had been a cause of estrangement, or led to contention or division hath ceased to prevail amongst them.
From this utterance whatsoever hath been the cause of aversion, or led to contention or dissension, hath been removed out of men's midst.

source: و در ارتقاء وجود و ارتفاع نفوس نازل شده آنچه که باب اعظم است از برای تربیت اهل عالم.
reference: From the heaven of God's Will, and for the purpose of ennobling the world of being and of elevating the minds and souls of men, hath been sent down that which is the most effective instrument for the education of the whole human race.
hyps: That which hath been revealed in this Day for the advancement of human existence, for the elevation of souls, is indeed the chief instrumentality for the education of the peoples of the world.

It hath been sent down to elevate men's existence and to exalt their souls; that which is superior to all other means for the education of the world's peoples is that the Almighty should manifest His presence among them.

In its exaltation of human endeavor and in its stimulation to high resolves and actions there hath been sent down that which standeth out preeminent above all else for the education of the peoples of the world.
In that which hath been revealed for the advancement of life and the upliftment of souls nothing whatever is greater than this supreme Bab which is set up for the education of mankind.
What hath been revealed for the advancement of civilization and the development of human souls is the instrument which should ensure the education of all mankind.
What hath been sent down for the purpose of elevating the station of man and of purifying his soul is the Bab's most precious gift to mankind.
That which hath been revealed for the advancement of man and the exaltation of souls is more efficacious than anything else whatsoever to edify all the peoples of the world.
For the advancement of human life, and the upraising of human souls, there hath descended that which is the foremost instrument for the education of the peoples of the world.

source: آنچه از لسان و قلم ملل اولی از قبل ظاهر فی‌الحقیقه سلطان آن در این ظهور اعظم از سماء مشیّت مالک قدم نازل.
reference: The highest essence and most perfect expression of whatsoever the peoples of old have either said or written hath, through this most potent Revelation, been sent down from the heaven of the Will of the All-Possessing, the Ever-Abiding God.
hyps: Whatsoever hath, down to this day, gone forth from the mouths and pens of the people of old doth in reality derive its ultimate origin from Him Who is the Lord of all, Who is revealed in this Most Great Revelation, outshining, in every way, the heaven of the will of the King of Preexistent Glory.

That which the Tongue and Pen of the original peoples have aforetime uttered was in truth an indication of the power of Him Who is their King, now come down from the heaven of God's Will—the Ancient King—from this most great Revelation.
Such utterances as have been uttered by the Prophets of old ere this Revelation were but echoes of what now from this supreme Source hath descended unto men.

That which the tongues and pens of the early peoples have uttered aforetime, if true, must be regarded as emanating directly from Him Who is the sovereign Lord of the kingdom of Will of the Eternal King; nay, all that hath been voiced and written in past times concerning this Most Great Revelation can be regarded as descending from the heaven of His sovereign purpose and intent.

Whatever the Tongues and Pens of the Peoples of old have uttered in days gone by have indeed proven to be but the dawning light, ere the Revelation of this wondrous Day, of the Sovereign Will that moveth within the Heaven of Him Who is the Ancient King.

That which was voiced by the tongues and pen of the first generation of people was in reality but an echo of what in this most weighty Revelation hath been sent down from the heaven of His Will, the Everlasting King.

Whatever was said of old by those who were the Exponents of the religions of other nations hath been fully revealed in this Most Great Revelation—the king of all kings, the sovereign law-giver, the sovereign Ordainer, hath come down from the heaven of God's most potent Will, the God of ancient times.

Whatsoever hath been uttered by tongues and pens in former times is now, in this most great Revelation, overshadowed by Him Who is the King of all nations, Who is enthroned on the loftiest heights of the Will of the Eternal King, Whose power none can dispute.

source: از قبل فرموده‌اند حبّ الوطن من الایمان.
reference: Of old it hath been revealed: Love of one's country is an element of the Faith of God.
hyps: Of old, He hath said: Love of one's country is an element of faith.
He hath also said: Love of one's country is part of faith.
In olden times He hath said: Patriotism is a part of faith.
He saith—may He speak the truth—unto them that love their country: Love of one's country is part of one's belief.
Formerly they said, Patriotism is part of religion.
He hath written previously: Love for ones country is one of the fundamentals of Faith.
He, of yore, hath stated: Love of one's country is part of one's faith.
Of old it hath been revealed that love for one's country is part of one's faith.

source: و لسان عظمت در یوم ظهور فرموده لیس الفخر لمن یحبّ الوطن بل لمن یحبّ العالم.
reference: The Tongue of Grandeur hath, however, in the day of His manifestation proclaimed: It is not his to boast who loveth his country, but it is his who loveth the world.
hyps: And yet the Tongue of Grandeur hath proclaimed on the Day of His Revelation: No boast for him that love his country, but for him that love the world.
On the Day of Revelation He hath said: Let it not be pride for him that loveth his country, but let it be pride for him that loveth the world.
In the Day of His Revelation the Tongue of Grandeur proclaimed: Let not man vaunt himself; let him rather magnify the Name of his God, the Lord of all worlds.
The Tongue of Grandeur hath revealed in the Day of His Manifestation: Let not man vaunt himself of love to his country, but rather of love to all mankind.
On the Day of Revelation, the Tongue of Grandeur hath uttered these words: It is not for man to glory but for him who love the world
The Tongue of Grandeur hath said on that Day: The glory is not for him that loveth his country but for him that loveth the world.
The Tongue of Grandeur hath in the Day of Revelation said: The more laudable is he who loveth all mankind rather than his native land.
The Tongue of Grandeur hath, in the day of His Revelation, proclaimed: It is not for him to glory that loveth his country, rather for him who loveth the world.

source: باین کلمات عالیات طیور افئده را پرواز جدید آموخت و تحدید و تقلید را از کتاب محو نمود.
reference: Through the power released by these exalted words He hath lent a fresh impulse and set a new direction to the birds of men's hearts, and hath obliterated every trace of restriction and limitation from God's holy Book.
hyps: By the breathings of these exalted words He has imparted to every bird of the human heart new wings for flight and banished all limitation from the Book.
Through these sublime words He hath taught men to soar in the realm of the spirit, above the limitations of time and place.
Through these sublime words He taught the birds of men's hearts to soar on new wings, and wiped out every trace of limitation and imitation from their inner books.
These sublime words have taught a new flight to the birds of men's hearts, and abolished all limitations and restrictions from the Book.
With these sublime words he has given new wings to the birds of men's hearts and wiped out all limitations and restrictions from the Book.

Through these sublime words He has taught men to take flight and soar in the atmosphere of the divine purpose, and to free themselves from all attachment to the limitations and restrictions of this life.
By these sublime words He hath caused the birds of men's hearts to soar on new wings, and hath effaced every trace of limitation and imitation from His Book.
With these exalted words He taught anew the birds of men's hearts to soar and eradicated every trace of limitation and imitation from His Book.

source: این مظلوم حزب الله را از فساد و نزاع منع فرمود و باعمال طیّبه و اخلاق مرضیّهٴ روحانیّه دعوت نمود.
reference: This Wronged One hath forbidden the people of God to engage in contention or conflict and hath exhorted them to righteous deeds and praiseworthy character.
hyps: This Wronged One hath prohibited the people of God from engaging in discord and conflict, and bidden them perform deeds that are upright and acceptable in the sight of God.
This Wronged One hath forbidden this people to engage in strife and dissension and hath exhorted them to deeds that are upright and to behavior that is praiseworthy in the sight of God.
This Wronged One hath enjoined upon the people of God to abstain from sedition and strife and hath exhortated them to deeds that are upright and praiseworthy and spiritually meritorious.
This Wronged One hath forbidden His people to engage in strife or conflict, and bade them practice goodly deeds and exemplary character.
This Wronged One hath forbidden the people of God to engage in dissension or conflict, and hath invited them unto godly acts and praiseworthy character.
This Victim of oppression hath forbidden the people of God to engage in strife and conflict, and summoned them to goodly deeds and praiseworthy and spiritual behavior.
This Wronged One hath forbidden the people of God to engage in sedition or contention, and exhorted them to righteous deeds and praiseworthy character.
This Wronged One hath forbidden His people God to engage in sedition and discord, and hath exhorted them unto righteous deeds and excellent character.

source: امروز جنودی که ناصر امرند اعمال و اخلاقست.
reference: In this day the hosts that can ensure the victory of the Cause are those of goodly conduct and saintly character.
hyps: Ye, in this day, must needs be a people well ordered in your conduct, who will become the hosts aiding this Revelation.
The hosts which can ensure the triumph of this Revelation are none other than the hosts of praiseworthy deeds and upright character.
Today the host that can ensure victory for this Cause is the host of deeds and virtues.
In this day the hosts that can assist thee are thine own deeds and character.
In this Day the hosts that can assist Our Cause are those of righteousness and upright character.
The hosts which will aid thee in thy warfare are goodly deeds and a stainless character.
In this Day they who are the most potent auxiliaries to the Cause of God are goodly deeds and praiseworthy conduct.
The hosts that will triumphantly support His Revelation are none other than upright conduct and a godly character.

source: طوبی لمن تمسّک بهما و ویل للمعرضین.
reference: Blessed are they who firmly adhere unto them and woe betide such as turn away therefrom.
hyps: Blessed are they that have laid fast hold thereon, and woe betide them that have turned aside therefrom.
Blessed is he that hath cleaved unto them and woe betide the froward.
Blessed those that follow them. Woe betide the froward.
Well is it with him who cleaveth fast unto it and woe betide them that have turned aside therefrom.
Well is it with him who cleaveth fast unto them, and woe betide him that hath turned away therefrom.
