Well is it with him that followeth this precept and woe betide the froward.
Happy are they who hold fast unto these two words, and woe betide him that breaketh away from them.
Happy the man that cleaveth fast unto them, and woe betide him who hath turned aside.

source: شما را بادب وصیّت مینمایم و اوست در مقام اوّل سیّد اخلاق.
reference: I admonish you to observe courtesy, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.
hyps: My primary duty towards you is to teach you courtesy, for above all else this is the prince of virtues.
I admonish you to be courteous. and first among the excellencies is kindness.
To this I would exhort you, and first among all virtues is piety.
I enjoin on you courtesy which above all things is the prince of virtues.
To you I exhort to observe courteous behavior, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.
I admonish you to observe courtesy, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.
To you I exhort to observe courtesy, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.
I exhort you to observe courtesy, for above all else it is the prince of virtues.

source: طوبی از برای نفسی که بنور ادب منوّر و بطراز راستی مزیّن گشت.
reference: Well is it with him who is illumined with the light of courtesy and is attired with the vesture of uprightness.
hyps: Well is it with him who hath been illumined with the light of courtesy and adorned with the ornament of uprightness.
Great indeed is the blessedness of him who is illumined with the radiance of courtesy and adorned with the adornment of truth.
Blessed is the man that hath been illumined with the light of courtesy, and attired with the raiment of uprightness.
Blessed is the man who hath been illumined with the light of manners and attired with the vesture of virtue.
Happy the man that hath been illumined with the light of propriety, and adorned with the vesture of integrity.
Great indeed is the blessedness that awaiteth him who hath been illumined with the splendors of courtesy, and been adorned with the ornament of righteousness.
Blessed is that soul who shineth with the radiance of courtesy and is arrayed with the vesture of uprightness.
Blessed is the man that hath been illumined with the light of courtesy, and been adorned with the ornament of probity.

source: دارای ادب دارای مقام بزرگست.
reference: Whoso is endued with courtesy hath indeed attained a sublime station.
hyps: Those who are possessed of courtesy enjoy an enviable position amongst men.
He that is endued with courtesy hath attained a noble station.
He that is endued with courtesy holdeth a high rank.
Those who observe courtesy achieve distinction.
He who observeth courtesy will assuredly attain to distinction and high rank.
He who is endued with courtesy excelleth in station.
Whoso is endued with courtesy can never fail to attain a high station.
The ornament of courtesy adorneth a lofty station.

source: امید آنکه این مظلوم و کلّ بآن فائز و بآن متمسّک و بآن متشبّث و بآن ناظر باشیم.
reference: It is hoped that this Wronged One and everyone else may be enabled to acquire it, hold fast unto it, observe it, and fix our gaze upon it.
hyps: We cherish the hope that this Wronged One may, through the operation of its laws, achieve His Purpose, firmly cling to it, hold fast unto it, and set our gaze upon it.
We cherish the hope that thou and all others will attain unto it and will firmly cleave unto it, and will cling unto it, and set thine heart upon it.
We fain would hope that this Wronged One may be endowed with it, and that all men may be enabled to acquire it, and cleave steadfastly unto it, and lay fast hold thereon, and fix their gaze thereon.
We cherish the hope that thou and every one else will be made aware thereof, and will hold fast unto it, and cleave tenaciously to it, and set thy gaze steadfastly upon it.
Our hope is that this Wronged One and all believers may be endued with this light, cleave to it, hold fast unto it, and gaze upon it with fixed regard.
It is Our hope that thou, this Wronged One, and all men may attain unto it, and cleave to it, and hold fast unto it, and set Our eyes thereupon.
We cherish the hope that this Wronged One, along with every one else, will achieve, cleave fast unto it, adhere to it and fix his gaze thereupon.
We cherish the hope that this Wronged One and everyone else may be enabled to acquire it, observe it, hold fast unto it, and fix our gaze upon it.

source: اینست حکم محکم که از قلم اسم اعظم جاری و نازل گشته.
reference: This is a binding command which hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
hyps: This is indeed a weighty command which hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This is the binding injunction that hath streamed down from Our Most Great Name.
This is the binding injunction which hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This is the binding commandment that hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This is the binding law which hath been sent down by the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This, verily, is the binding commandment which hath streamed forth and descended from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This is the binding ordinance which hath streamed forth from the Pen of the Most Great Name.
This binding commandment is but a drop of water compared to what hath streamed forth out of the Pen of Him Who is the Most Great Name.

source: امروز روز ظهور لآلی استقامتست از معدن انسانی.
reference: This is the day when the gems of constancy that lie hid in the mine of men's inner selves should be made manifest.
hyps: This is the Day when the gem of constancy must be revealed by the Mine of Man.
This is the Day when the gems of constancy which lie hid within the mine of man's inmost soul are to be unveiled to men's eyes.
This is the Day whereon the pearls of constancy should shine forth out of the mine of human hearts.
This day is the Day in which the gem of constancy should be manifest.
This Day is the Day when the gems of constancy should be disclosed out of the mine of man.
This is the day wherein the gems of constancy are revealed, one and all, from the mine of man.
This is the Day when the pearls of constancy that lie hid within the mine of men should be revealed.
This Day is the Day for the revelation of the pearls of constancy out of the mine of man.

source: یا حزب العدل.
reference: O people of Justice.
hyps: O people of Justice!
O concourse of justice.
O people that follow justice.
O people of Justice.
O people of Justice.
O people of Justice.
O followers of justice!
O people of Justice.

source: باید بمثابهٴ نور روشن باشید و مانند نار سدره مشتعل.
reference: Be as brilliant as the light and as splendid as the fire that blazed in the Burning Bush.
hyps: Be as bright as light and like a glowing fire.
It behooveth you to shine forth with the brightness of the sun and to blaze like the fire that burneth within the bush.
Ye must shine like the light and burn bright like the fire of the Burning Bush.
Be shining as the sun, flaming as the fire that blazed in the Burning Bush.
Ye must shine out as the sun and blaze like the flaming Bush.
I would that ye might shine forth like unto a lamp, and become as glowing brands.
Ye must shine forth like unto the sun, blaze out with the consuming fire which blazed within the Burning Bush.
Let your light shine like unto the sun, and your flame blaze up like unto the fire that burnt within the Burning Bush.

source: این نار محبّت احزاب مختلفه را در یک بساط جمع نماید و نار بغضا سبب و علّت تفریق و جدالست.
reference: The brightness of the fire of your love will no doubt fuse and unify the contending peoples and kindreds of the earth, whilst the fierceness of the flame of enmity and hatred cannot but result in strife and ruin.
hyps: This fire of affection will gather together the kindreds and peoples that have been dispersed, while the flame of hatred will be the cause and instrument of their estrangement and discord.
This fire will gather together the divided communities on one carpet, while the fire of antipathy leads to discord and conflict.
The fire of love will gather together the kindreds that differ, but the fire of hatred causes strife and division.
This fire of love must gather together the divers nations upon one carpet, while this flame of hatred will only lead to separation and conflict
This fire of love will draw together the kindreds now divided on earth, while that of hatred will only spread dissension and strife among men.
This fire of love will unite the scattered kindreds upon His Self and the fire of hatred will serve as a pretext for quarrels and dissensions among them.
This fire of love unites the kindreds that differ one from another, while that of hatred causeth estrangement, contention and dissension among peoples.
The fire of this love will unify and weld together all sects that are now estranged and divided, while the fire of hatred will merely provoke contention and conflict among them.

source: نسأل الله ان یحفظ عباده من شرّ اعدائه.
reference: We beseech God that He may shield His creatures from the evil designs of His enemies.
hyps: We ask God to guard His servants from the mischief of his enemies.
We ask God to protect His servants from the mischief of his enemies.

reference: In the year sixty He Who heralded the light of Divine Guidance—may all creation be a sacrifice unto Him—arose to announce a fresh revelation of the Divine Spirit, and was followed, twenty years later, by Him through Whose coming the world was made the recipient of this promised glory, this wondrous favor.
hyps: For in the year sixty, Jesus Christ, exalted be His name—martyred for our sakes—gave unto men the Gospel of the new Spirit and in the eightieth year He enabled the world to attain unto that Light which was to come and to be invested with that wondrous Spirit.

In the year sixty A.H., that harbinger of divine good news—may the life of all else be a sacrifice unto Him—announced unto men the appearance of yet another Spirit, Who was to come after Him, and six years later, at the age of eighty, He attained unto Him Whom all nations have been waiting, in whose advent the earth had rejoiced, and in Whose glory the soul of every man hath soared.

It was in the year sixty after the birth of Him Who heralded this Revelation—may all else but Him be His sacrifice—that He announced a new and fresh Message to the world, and in the year eighty—the year in which, according to the best authorities, He entered His sepulchre—He attained unto the glory of the new Light and the wondrous Spirit.

For He Who heralded His coming—may all else be a sacrifice unto Him—had, in the year sixty, announced Him Who was to come after Him, and in the year eighty all the peoples of the world attained unto this new light and wondrous Spirit.

source: ولکن این الطّالب و این السّائل.
reference: But where are to be found earnest seekers and inquiring minds.
hyps: Where are to be found these inquiring hearts, these seeking minds
And yet where are to be found thy questioner and thine inquirer.
Where is to be found such a seeker, such a questioner.
What have they done?
Where are to be found those who seek it for themselves, and those who ask to be instructed therein.
Where, then, are to be found thy questions and thy doubts.
Of what value, then, are questions and answers.
Who is the seeker. Who is the questioner.

source: و این العادل و این المنصف.
reference: Whither are gone the equitable and the fair-minded.
hyps: Where are to be found the equitable and the fair-minded.
Where is he to be found who will administer justice, and he who is inclined to fairness
Where are to be found this equanimity, this justice.
Where is He to be found Who will exercise justice or fairness
where is he to be found who will judge fairly and equitably between you.
Where are to be found these fair-minded men, these just arbiters of mankind?
Where are to be found this equitable one, this fair-minded soul.
Where are to be found the fair-minded, the equitable.

source: حال هر یوم نار ظلمی مشتعل و سیف اعتسافی مسلول.
reference: At present no day passeth without the fire of a fresh tyranny blazing fiercely, or the sword of a new aggression being unsheathed.
hyps: Behold how every day new fires of tyranny blaze high and fresh swords of aggression are whetted.
In this day, each moment new fires of tyranny blaze up, and fresh swords of aggression are unsheathed.
Every day new tribulations are kindled, and fresh swords are sharpened for His back.
Now every day fresh fire of tyranny blazeth, and sword of wrong is unsheathed.
Every day, now, a new fire of tyranny is kindled, and a fresh sword of oppression unsheathed.
Every day there kindleth anew the fire of a new tyranny, and bladeth new the sword of a fresh violence.
Today the fire of oppression burneth fiercely, and the sword of aggression gleameth keenly before our eyes.
At present, each day a fresh fire of tyranny blazeth high, and a new sword of oppression is unsheathed.

source: بزرگان ایران و نجبای عظام باخلاق سبعی فخر مینمایند حیرت اندر حیرت آمد زین قصص.
reference: The great and the noble in Persia glory in acts of such savagery that one is lost in amazement at the tales thereof.
hyps: High dignitaries boast of seven virtues; marvel on marvel, what stories men tell!
In Persia's highest circles the proudest bear a record sevenfold— In this marvel-struck land, behold a tale.
The noblest of Persia and the most distinguished of its leaders pride themselves on being the seven who were of the race of the beast; and yet wonder on wonder comes.
The noblemen of Persia and the magnates, those high in honor, glory in these seven vices; bewildered am I at this bewilderment of theirs.
The leaders of Persia and the noblest of her statesmen take pride in sevenfold qualities; bewildered am I at this bewildering tale.
In Persia's foremost seats and mighty palaces the seven virtues are vaunted, yet wonder upon wonder abideth within wonder.
Of old the nobles of Persia were proud to have seven virtuous qualities. bewildering wonder befell bewildering wonder at these tales.
The nobles of Persia and other eminent persons take pride in these seven vices; amazed am I at the marvels of these stories.

source: این مظلوم در لیالی و ایّام بشکر و حمد مالک انام مشغول چه که مشاهده شد نصائح و مواعظ تأثیر نموده و اخلاق و اطوار این حزب بدرجهٴ قبول فائز.
reference: Day and night this Wronged One yieldeth thanks and praise unto the Lord of men, for it is witnessed that the words of counsel and exhortation We uttered have proved effective and that this people hath evinced such character and conduct as are acceptable in Our sight.
hyps: This Wronged One hath been, in the daytime and in the night-season, occupied with thanksgiving and praise to God, the Lord of men, for that thou hast observed that Our admonitions have wrought an impression on thee, and that the conduct and character of this people have attained unto a state of acceptability.

This Victim hath in the daytime and in the night-season given thanks and praise unto Him Who is the Lord of all men, for it hath been observed that the admonitions and exhortations He uttered exerted a salutary influence on this people and their behavior became acceptable in Our sight.

This Wronged One hath, night and day, yielded thanks unto and rendered praise to Him Who is the Lord of all men, for it hath been observed that these counsels and admonitions have produced an impression, and the conduct and behavior of this people have attained unto acceptance in His sight.

This Wronged One hath, night and day, occupied Himself with giving thanks and praise to the Lord of all men, for it hath been witnessed that His counsels and admonitions have produced some effect, and that this people hath acquired, in a measure, the qualities and behavior which are acceptable unto God.

This Wronged One hath, day and night, with thanksgiving and praise unto the Lord of men, occupied Himself, for this community have been influenced by Our admonitions, and their conduct and behavior hath reached a stage of acceptance in Our sight.

This Victim is, during the day and night, occupied in rendering thanks unto God, the Lord of all men, for that these counsels and exhortations have proved so efficacious that the character and conduct of this people have attained the degree of acceptability in the sight of God.

This Wronged One passeth His nights and days in thanksgiving and praise to the Lord of men, inasmuch as it hath been observed that Our admonitions and counsels have produced a good effect, and that this people have shown forth such conduct and behavior as was pleasing unto God.

This Wronged One hath busied Himself night and day in giving thanks and praise unto the Lord of all men, for it hath been witnessed that the exhortations of this people have had influence, and their characters and conduct have attained such a degree of excellence as to merit acceptance.

source: چه که ظاهر شد آنچه که سبب روشنی چشم عالم است و آن شفاعت دوستان از دشمنان نزد امرا بوده.
reference: This is affirmed by virtue of the event which hath truly cheered the eye of the world, and is none other than the intercession of the friends with the high authorities in favor of their enemies.
hyps: For it appeared that which was the brightening of the eye of the world, and the intercession of friends with those in authority for enemies.
for it appeared unto the world that which hath clarified the eyes thereof, inasmuch as our friends were interceding with the authorities on behalf of our enemies.
For it appeareth that the thing which causeth the eye of the world to be opened is the intercession of My friends amongst My foes.
For We have now manifested before your eyes that which would brighten the sight of the world, the intercession of Our beloved on behalf of Our enemies.

For We have been made to witness that which is like unto the dawn of light unto the world, inasmuch as Our loved ones have been able to procure the pardon of Our adversaries at the hands of the rulers.
For there happened something which lit up the eyes of the world, and that was the intercession of the friends before the authorities on behalf of their enemies.
Such hath been the intercession of Our Friends on Our behalf before those invested with authority that the eye of the world hath been cheered.

Such a light hath shone forth that its radiance can be likened unto the shining eye of Him Who is the Focal-Point of the universe, the intercession of friends on behalf of the wrong-doer with those invested with authority.

source: کردار نیک گواه راستی گفتار است.
reference: Indeed one's righteous deeds testify to the truth of one's words.
hyps: Righteousness is the best witness of sincerity.
A good action is the best proof of sincerity.
A good deed testifieth to the truthfulness of a man's words.
Good deeds are the best witnesses of one's faith.
Righteous deeds are the proof of sincerity in speech.
A righteous act is the true witness of a man's character.
A praiseworthy action is indeed an eloquent witness for the truthfulness of His Words.
Good works are the true evidences of true speech.

source: امید آنکه اخیار بروشنی کردار گیتی را روشن نمایند نسأل الله تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّد الکلّ علی الاستقامة علی حبّه و امره فی ایّامه.
reference: We cherish the hope that men of piety may illumine the world through the radiant light of their conduct, and We entreat the Almighty—glorified and exalted is He—to grant that everyone may in this Day remain steadfast in His love and stand firm in His Cause.
hyps: We cherish the hope that mankind will illuminate the world through the radiance of its deeds. We beg God—glorified and exalted is He—to assist every one to remain steadfast in His love and in His Cause.
We cherish the hope that they may illuminate and glorify their days through righteous deeds. and We pray God—exalted be He—to enable all men to steadfastly adhere to His Faith and His Cause.
We cherish the hope that man will brighten up the world through his deeds, and We ask God—blessed and glorified be He—to assist everyone to become steadfast in His Love and Cause in His days.
We cherish the hope that men of valor will, through the shining light of their deeds, illuminate the world.

It is Our hope that through the radiance of the behavior of its people Persia may be illumined. We entreat God—blessed and glorified be He—to aid everyone to cleave steadfastly to His Cause and His Faith at all times and under all conditions.

We fain would hope that men will illumine their conduct with the light of God's holy Precepts, and will shed their radiance upon the earth. We beseech God—glorified and exalted be He—to aid all men to steadfastly observe His Precepts in His days.

We cherish the hope that the light of right conduct may illumine the path of humanity. We entreat God—blessed and glorified be He—to aid all men to remain steadfast in the love of His Cause and in His Faith, in these days.

We cherish the hope that mankind may illumine the earth through the radiance of their goodly deeds, and We pray God—glorified and exalted be He—to strengthen all men to act uprightly, and love Him and His Faith in these days.

source: انّه ولیّ المخلصین و العاملین.
reference: He is, in truth, the Protector of those who are wholly devoted to Him and observe His precepts.
hyps: He is the Protector of those who are wholly devoted to Him and observe His precepts.
Verily He is the Protector of the sincere, the doers.
He is indeed the Friend of them that are wholly devoted to Him and observe His precepts.
He it is Who is the Protector of all who are wholly devoted to Him, and observe His precepts.
He, verily, is the Friend of the sincere among His servants, and those who perform righteous deeds.
He, verily, is the Protector of those who are wholly devoted to Him, who observe His precepts.
Verily He is the Protector of those that walk in His path, that perform His commandments, and fulfill His trust.
He is, verily, the Protector of such as are wholly devoted to Him and practice His Will.

source: قلم اعلی عالمها ظاهر نموده و ابصار را روشنی حقیقی بخشیده.
reference: Countless are the realms which Our Pen of Glory hath revealed and manifold the eyes to which it hath imparted true enlightenment.
hyps: Through this Pen We have made manifest to men the Supreme Manifestation of God in the world, and bestowed upon them spiritual eyes through which they can recognize His Person and nature.
He Who is the Pen of Glory hath now revealed His Message, and illumined the eyes of men with the light of eternal Truth.
Our Pen of Glory hath revealed itself unto the world, and illumined all eyes with true illumination.
Our Pen of Glory hath shed its radiance upon the world, and illumined the sight of men with a true illumination.
Behold, Our Pen of glory hath traced across the surface of the world the figures of these verses, and shed upon its people the radiance of its truth.
Through this pen of glory We have illumined the world, and shed upon the eyes of men true enlightenment.
He hath caused His exalted Pen to reveal its glory, and illumined mankind's vision with a perfect and living light.
He Who is the Pen of Glory hath manifested Himself unto the peoples of the world, and shed upon their eyes the living light of His Reality.

source: ولکن اکثری از اهل ایران لازال از بیانات نافعه و علوم و فنون مبارکه محروم بوده‌اند.
reference: Yet most of the people in Persia continue to be deprived of the benefits of profitable counsels and remain sorely lacking in useful sciences and arts.
hyps: A majority, however, have never benefited from these profitable exhortations, nor acquired the sciences and arts which would profit mankind.
Most of the people in Persia have continued to be bereft of the edifying counsels that have been revealed and deprived of the blessed sciences and arts.
Many Persians have, for this reason, continued to be deprived of the benefits which could accrue from profitable counsels and remain bereft of sciences and arts of universal application.
Many in Persia have continued to be deprived of beneficial counsels and of sciences and arts which would profit them.
Most of the people in Persia have continued to remain deprived of the bounty of these profitable utterances, of these excellent sciences and arts.
Yet most people in Persia have remained deprived of these invaluable counsels, and of so many other sciences and arts that would profit men.
Most of the people of Persia, however, have consistently refused to profit by such beneficial counsels, or benefit from so excellent a knowledge and science.
Yet most of the people in Persia have, at all times, remained deprived of profitable counsels and of the blessings of divine sciences and arts.

source: یوم قبل مخصوص از برای یکی از اولیا این کلمهٴ علیا از قلم اعلی نازل که شاید اهل اعراض باقبال فائز گردند و بغوامض مسائل اصول الهیّه پی‌برند و آگاه شوند.
reference: Formerly these sublime words were especially revealed by the Pen of Glory in honor of one of the faithful, that perchance those that have gone astray may embrace the Truth and become acquainted with the subtleties of the Law of God.
hyps: Formerly, especially for one of His loved ones, these sublime words were revealed from Our Supreme Pen, that haply the froward might attain unto acceptance, and be made cognizant of the manifold mysteries pertaining to God and His holy laws.

These sublime words were specially revealed for the purpose of one of Our loved ones some days ago, that haply those who have strayed away from Us may be led to turn unto Us, and may comprehend and become aware of intricate theological questions.

Yesterday especially hath this sublime utterance, this supreme and holy Word been revealed for one of Our loved ones, that haply the perverse may turn to God, and be led out of the crooked paths which lead far from God, and discover and comprehend the fundamentals of divine Faith.

In days gone by these exalted words were revealed especially for one of the faithful by the Pen of Glory, that perchance those who have strayed might be brought home to God and become acquainted with the principles of the Faith.

Of old Our Pen of Glory hath revealed these most exalted words to one of the faithful for the purpose that perchance they who have gone astray may return unto Him, and become cognizant of the subtleties of the divine law.

This sublime word was specially revealed yesterday for one of Our loved ones by Our Pen of Glory that haply such as are far from Us may turn unto Us, and be brought to perceive and apprehend the most abstruse problems related to the fundamental verities of God.

Yesterday, particularly for one of the faithful, these sublime words were sent down by the Pen of Glory that haply the perverse may turn unto God, and may become familiar with the subtle questions of the divine Law and be made aware thereof.

This exalted word hath specially been revealed by Our Pen of Glory for one of Our loved ones, that haply they who have gone astray may embrace the truth, and become acquainted with the mysteries of the divine Faith and be made cognizant thereof.

source: معرضین و منکرین بچهار کلمه متمسّک اوّل کلمهٴ فضرب الرّقاب و ثانی حرق کتب و ثالث اجتناب از ملل اخری و رابع فنای احزاب.
reference: The unbelievers and the faithless have set their minds on four things: first, the shedding of blood. second, the burning of books. third, the shunning of the followers of other religions. fourth, the extermination of other communities and groups.
hyps: The unbelievers and the faithless cling unto four principles: first, the shedding of blood; second, the burning of books; third, the shunning of foreign peoples, and fourth, wholesale massacre.

The fainthearted, the deniers of God, have firmly fixed themselves on four beliefs. The first belief is that men's necks are to be broken. the second, that the Books of other religions should be burnt. the third, that we must keep aloof from other nations and peoples. the fourth, that all tribes except our own shall perish.

Whosoever denieth Him or turneth away therefrom should firmly hold fast unto these four things. First, shedding of blood; secondly, destruction of books; thirdly, repudiation of peoples other than one's own; fourthly, extermination of all other religions.

To what four propositions have the repudiators and gainsayers adhered. The first is, that he who taketh away the lives of men is a victim. the second, that he who burneth books is innocent. the third, that he who escheweth intercourse with other nations is right. the fourth, that the destruction of communities is not to be feared.

Those who turn away and deny Him have clung to four things. The first is the shedding of blood, the second the destruction of books, the third avoidance of foreign peoples and nations, and the fourth extermination of groups and classes of men.

To what four things did the rebellious and faithless cleave? The first was the shedding of blood; the second, the burning of books; the third, aversion from other nations; the fourth, the extermination of kindreds.

To the perverse and the deniers He hath attached four things, first the shedding of blood, secondly the burning of books, thirdly avoidance of other nations and peoples, and fourthly the extermination of communities.
To what four things have they clung? First, to the shedding of blood; secondly, to the destruction of books; thirdly, the shunning of other nations; fourthly, the extermination of other communities.

source: حال از فضل و اقتدار کلمهٴ الهی این چهار سدّ عظیم از میان برداشته شد و این چهار امر مبین از لوح محو گشت و صفات سبعی را بصفات روحانی تبدیل نمود.
reference: Now however, through the strengthening grace and potency of the Word of God these four barriers have been demolished, these clear injunctions have been obliterated from the Tablet and brutal dispositions have been transmuted into spiritual attributes.
hyps: Now, through the grace and power of the Word of God these four impediments have been removed out of men's hearts, these four clear precepts have been blotted out of the Tablet of Divine Law, and have been changed into spiritual attributes.

Now through the power and potency of the Word of God these four formidable obstacles have been removed out of the way, these clear evidences blotted out of the Tablet, and the Sevenfold attribute converted to the Spiritual.

Now, by virtue of the divine power and influence of His Word, these four mighty ramparts have been demolished, and their place has been made level with the dust. This shining and evident testimony which was graven on this Tablet has been effaced. and, by exchanging the names of the seven attributes for those of the spiritual qualities, they have substituted new names for these,

Now through the grace and power of the Word of God these four mighty barriers have been removed out of the way and these clear ordinances blotted out of the Tablet, and instead thereof those seven qualities were exchanged for spiritual attributes.

Thanks be to God, through His divine potency and might, these four formidable barriers have been removed, and the four ordinances which were recorded in the Tablet have now been obliterated, and the former qualities have been exchanged for spiritual attributes.

Through the grace and power of God's word these four formidable obstacles have now been removed, and the four clearly defined prohibitions recorded in the Tablet have been erased, to be supplanted by seven spiritual attributes.

Through His grace and power, however, the Word of God hath removed these mighty obstructions that have been interposed between the soul and its Lord, hath obliterated from the pages of history these manifest signs of materialism, and hath replaced the attributes of these seven men with spiritual attributes.

Now through the gracious power of the Word of God these four formidable obstacles have been removed, these clear and weighty matters have been blotted out from off the Tablets, and He hath changed His seven attributes for spiritual ones.

source: جلّت ارادته و جلّت قدرته و عظم سلطانه.
reference: Exalted is His purpose. glorified is His power. magnified is His dominion.
hyps: Glorified is His purpose. glorified is His power. exalted is His sovereignty
His purpose be glorified, and His might be exalted, and His sovereignty be magnified.
Exalted is His Will! Glorified is His Power! Magnified be His sovereignty.
Glorified be His purpose, exalted His power, magnified is His sovereignty.
Exalted be His intent. glorified be His power. magnified be His sovereignty.
Far be it from His glory to be fettered by the limitations imposed by men's imaginings.
Magnified is His purpose. glorified is His power, and great is the extent of His sovereignty.
Exalted be His intent. exalted be His power. great is His sovereignty.

source: حال از حقّ جلّ جلاله بطلبید و میطلبیم که حزب شیعه را هدایت فرماید و از صفات نالائقه نجات بخشد.
reference: Now let us beseech God—praised be His glory—to graciously guide aright the followers of the Shí'ih sect and to purge them of unseemly conduct.
hyps: Now pray ye unto God, exalted be His glory, that He will guide aright the Shí'ites and shield them from unworthy conduct.
Beseech now thou God—exalted be His glory—to guide aright the followers of Shí'ih Islám, and save them from unseemly conduct.
Now pray ye to God—glorified be His Name—and We pray that He may guide the followers of Shí'ih Islám, and protect them against unseemly conduct.
Now thou hast besought God—glorified be His Name—and We beseech Him to guide the followers of the Shí'ih sect, and to rescue them from unseemly behavior.
Now ask ye of the one true God—exalted be His glory—to guide aright the followers of Shí'ih Islám, and protect them from unseemly conduct.
Now implore ye God, exalted be His glory, that He may graciously direct the steps of this people, and spare them the consequences of their unseemly conduct.
Now ask thou the one true God—glorified be He—to guide aright the Shí'ites and to deliver them from the corrupting influence of their misdeeds.
Now implore ye God glorious is His glory that He may guide the followers of this religion and graciously shield them against unseemly conduct.

source: از لسان هر یک از آن حزب در هر یوم لعنتها مذکور و ملعون با عین حلقی از غذاهای یومیّهٴ آن حزبست.
reference: From the lips of the members of this sect foul imprecations fall unceasingly, while they invoke the word Mal'ún accursed—uttered with a guttural sound of the letter 'ayn—as their daily relish.
hyps: Every day and every hour the tongue of each of these people pronounceth the imprecation of curses upon his neighbor, who, in return, hurleth back upon him the same calumny.
From the tongue of each one of that sect the imprecation pronounced against him is uttered every day, and in lieu of his daily food he is tormented with a worm of his own tongue.

Every one of them, each day and night, would repeat aloud their imprecations against Him, and would denounce Him by calling Him, in the presence of all, by names so foul and revolting that no man can bear to hear them.
From the tongue of each one of those people every day a malediction fell, calling down on him who would eat of the food that was set before him the curse, with which he was himself accursed.
From the mouth of each one of these people, every day they utter curses, and they eat with their tongues.

From the mouth of each one of that people every day a malediction hath been uttered, and accursed is he who is slain with the same blow dealt to the neck with which they daily kill some of that people.
Every day, out of the mouths of these people, their malediction hath been uttered, and with their tongues they curse him who is to be cursed in that very place where they partake of their daily food.

From the tongue of each one of that sect every day his imprecation was uttered, and he who received it was the object of derision and laughter to all those who were wont to take their meals at his table.

source: تسمع حنین بهائک و صریخه فی اللّیالی و الأیّام و تعلم انّه ما اراد لنفسه امراً بل اراد تقدیس نفوس عبادک و نجاتهم عن نار الضّغینة و البغضآء الّتی احاطتهم فی کلّ الأحیان.
reference: Thou hearest the sighing of Him Who is Thy Light Bahá, hearkenest unto His lamentations in the daytime and in the night season and knowest that He desireth naught for Himself but rather seeketh to sanctify the souls of Thy servants and to deliver them from the fire with which they are beset at all times.
hyps: Thou hearest His cry and the voice of His lamentation which He calleth day and night, and knowest that He seeketh naught for Himself, but desireth rather to purify the souls of Thy servants and to deliver them out of the fire wherewith they are encompassed on every side.

Thou beholdest Him who is Thy Light, Who crieth by day and by night and testifiest to the truth of His utterance when He saith: I have not desired anything for Myself, but wish to purify the souls of Thy servants from the fire that hath compassed them on every side and which is stoked by hatred and enmity.

Thou hearest Him Who is Thy Baha lamenting and groaning day and night, and art well aware that He desireth naught for Himself, but wisheth to exalt the souls of Thy servants, and save them from the fire with which they are beset on all sides.

Thou hearest the lamentations of Him Who is Thy Glory, and beholdest His groaning in the daytime and in the night season, and knowest that He hath not desired any good thing for Himself, but rather hath sought to purify the souls of Thy servants and deliver them from the fire of hatred and malice which continually compasseth them on every side.

Thou hearest the groaning of my voice and its lamentation in the daytime and in the night-season, and knowest that He Who is Thy Light Bahá hath had no thought for Himself, but sought to purify the souls of Thy servants, and deliver them out of the fire which continually threateneth them.

Thou hearest the sighing of Him Who is Thy Glory, and his bitter lamentation day and night, and art well aware that He seeketh naught for Himself, but rather desireth to sanctify the souls of Thy servants and deliver them out of the fire of envy and hatred that continually surroundeth them on all sides.

Thou hearest His lamentations and bewailings, in the daytime and in the night-season, and knowest that He seeketh naught for Himself, but desireth to sanctify the souls of Thy servants and to deliver them out of the fire that hath encompassed them in every moment of Their life.

Thou hearest His lamentations and the voice of His wailing in the daytime and night season, and knowest that He hath desired naught for Himself, but hath wished to exalt the souls of Thy servants and deliver them from the fire wherewith they are encompassed on every side.

source: ای ربّ.
reference: O Lord.
hyps: O my Lord.
O Lord.
O Lord!
O my Lord.
My Lord.
O Lord.
O Lord.
O my Lord.

source: قد ارتفعت ایادی المقرّبین الی سمآء جودک و المخلصین الی هوآء عطائک.
reference: The hands of Thy well-favored servants are raised towards the heaven of Thy bounty and those of Thy sincere lovers are lifted up to the sublime heights of Thy generosity.
hyps: The hands of Thy favored ones have been raised towards the heaven of Thy bounty, and those of Thy sincere servants have been stretched out unto the realm of Thy bounteousness.
The hands of Thy favored servants are raised towards the heaven of Thy bounty, and those of Thy sincere lovers are lifted up unto the loftiest heights of Thy generosity.

We that enjoy near access to Thy presence have upraised our hands towards the heaven of Thy bounty, and they who are wholly devoted to Thee have stretched forth their hands unto the sublime heights of Thy generosity.
The hands of Thy well-favoured servants are stretched out towards the heaven of Thy generosity, and those of Thy sincere lovers are lifted up to the atmosphere of Thy bounty.

The hands of Thy servants who have near access to Thee have sought in their hearts the heaven of Thy bounteousness, and those of Thy sincere lovers have uplifted themselves towards the atmosphere of Thy favor.
The hands of Thy well-favoured servants are raised up toward the heaven of Thy bounty, and those of Thy sincere lovers are lifted to the sublimities of Thy generosity.
The hands of Thy loved ones are stretched out unto the heaven of Thy bounty, and those of Thy sincere servants are uplifted towards the atmosphere of Thy generosity.
The hands of Thy favoured ones have been raised to the heaven of Thy bounty, and those of the sincere servants towards the atmosphere of Thy favor.

source: اسألک ان لا تخیّبها عمّا ارادوا من بحر عطائک و سمآء فضلک و شمس جودک.
reference: Disappoint them not, I entreat Thee, in that which they seek from the ocean of Thy favor and from the heaven of Thy grace and the daystar of Thy bounty.
hyps: Disappoint them not, I implore Thee, in what they seek from the ocean of Thy bounty, and from the heaven of Thy grace and from the sun of Thy generosity.
Disappoint them not, I beseech Thee, in their hope to attain unto the ocean of Thy bounty, and the heaven of Thy grace and the daystar of Thy generosity.
Disappoint them not, I pray Thee, in that which they seek from the ocean of Thy bounty, and the heaven of Thy grace, and the Daystar of Thy bounteousness.

reference: The distinguishing feature that marketh the preeminent character of this Supreme Revelation consisteth in that We have, on the one hand, blotted out from the pages of God's holy Book whatsoever hath been the cause of strife, of malice and mischief amongst the children of men, and have, on the other, laid down the essential prerequisites of concord, of understanding, of complete and enduring unity.

hyps: For he who attaineth this station hath attained unto the light of true belief, whilst he that falleth short therefrom hath been denoted and described in the Book of God as one of the followers of idle fancies and vain imaginings.

Were any man to reach this station he would verily attain unto the light of the essential unity of God and would become illumined thereby; for all else except this hath been recorded and described in the Book of God as followers of vain fancy and of idle imagination.

Whoso attaineth this station hath attained the light of Divine unity and is enlightened therefrom, while those who have failed to reach it are reckoned in the Book of God among them that follow vain imaginings and are steeped in fancies.

For whosoever attaineth this station hath attained unto the light of true unity, and is illumined therefrom, whilst all others are recorded and inscribed as followers of vain imaginings and imaginations.

Whoso attaineth this station hath been enabled to appreciate the light of divine unity, but those who follow their idle fancies and imaginings must be numbered with those whose beliefs have been set down in the Holy Writ of God as the followers of vain imaginings and fancies.

If any one attaineth this station he will have attained the light of true belief, and become its bearer, and will not be numbered, according to what hath been recorded and described in the Book of God, with those who follow idle fancies and vain imaginings.

For he who attaineth this station hath attained to the light of the essential Unity and becometh its illuminator, and he who is bereft thereof is reckoned in the Book of God among the followers of vain imaginings.

Should any one succeed in apprehending the purport of this theme, he would certainly have attained unto the light of the unity of God in its inmost reality, and would be shining with that light, while all others except him are reckoned among them that have adopted idle fancies and vain imaginations.

reference: Righteous men of learning who dedicate themselves to the guidance of others and are freed and well guarded from the promptings of a base and covetous nature are, in the sight of Him Who is the Desire of the world, stars of the heaven of true knowledge.
hyps: Eminent spiritual leaders who are dedicated to guiding people and have guarded their hearts against corrupt instincts will be regarded as stars of the heaven of true understanding in the sight of Him Who is the Desire of all men.

Righteous divines who are busied with the guidance of God's servants, and are safe and secure from the whisperings of the corrupt desires of the heart—these are accounted among the stars of the heaven of divine knowledge, before the desired one of all men.

Righteous divines, who are occupied with the guidance of men and are preserved and protected from the insinuations of that base desire which is as a mother to man, these, in the sight of Him Who is the Desire of the dwellers on earth, are accounted as stars of the heaven of knowledge.

Righteous divines who devote themselves to the guidance of men and are preserved and protected from the temptations of the evil inclination are, in the estimation of Him Who is the Desire of the dwellers on earth, like unto stars of the heaven of knowledge.

They whose guidance is sought are the true scholars whose lives are a defense against their corrupt desires. to them who seek the knowledge of the heavens is given a place at the feet of Him Who is the Desire of all men.

Righteous divines whose sole aim is the guidance of mankind, who are safe and secure from the suggestions of their base and covetous inclinations—these truly are counted in the sight of Him Who is the Desire of the worlds as stars of the heaven of knowledge.

Righteous divines who are occupied with the guidance of men, who protect and shield themselves from the insinuations of the evil prompting of their desires, these, in the estimation of Him Who is the Desire of the world, are even as stars of the heaven of divine knowledge.

source: و ذلک لا یمکن لأحد ابداً الّا لمن طهّر قلبه عن کلّ ما خلق بین السّموات و الأرضین و انقطع بکلّه الی الله الملک العزیز الجمیل.
reference: And none can ever achieve this except he who hath purged his heart from whatsoever is created between heaven and earth, and hath entirely detached himself from all but God, the sovereign Lord, the Almighty, the Gracious.
hyps: None can ever achieve this except he who hath purified his heart from whatsoever hath been created between heaven and earth, and rid himself, wholly, of all attachment to any one but God, the King, the Mighty, the Beneficent.

This is something which absolutely no one can do except those whose hearts are purified from every created thing that is between heaven and earth, and who have detached themselves utterly from all except God, the King, the Mighty, the Benevolent.

None other but He can do this, unless his heart be cleansed from whatsoever hath been created between heaven and earth, and he be rid of all attachment to any one except God, the All-Possessing, the All-Glorious, the Most Beautiful.

It is impossible for anyone to achieve it unless his heart is cleansed of all that hath been created between heaven and earth, and he rid himself entirely of every attachment but to God, the Lord of all men, the All-Glorious, the Beneficent.

None can achieve this except he that hath cleansed his heart of all that which hath been created in the heavens and on the earth, and who hath detached himself wholly from all except God, the King, the All-Glorious, the Compassionate.

To none, however, is it possible except through God Himself, the King of men, Who is alone able to purify the heart from all earthly cares and concerns, and to make it utterly detached from any one but Him, Whose Kingdom is supreme and all-glorious.

Such a state can be attained by none, unless his heart hath been purged from every attachment that bindeth him to any one among all the creatures that live between heaven and earth, and his entire being hath been detached from all except God, the sovereign Lord of all, the Almighty, the All-Glorious.

None can ever achieve this except he who hath cleansed his heart from whatsoever is created between heaven and earth, and detached his entire being from any one but God, the Sovereign, the Gracious, the All-Bountiful.

source: قم علی الأمر و قل تالله.
reference: Arise thou to serve the Cause and say: I swear by the righteousness of God.
hyps: Arise thou to proclaim it, and say: By God.
Arise thou for My Cause, and say: By the righteousness of God!
Arise thou to serve My Cause, and say: By God.
Arise thou to serve My Cause, and say: By the righteousness of God.
Arise thou to serve this Cause and exclaim before Him Who is the Lord of all worlds: I swear by God.
Arise thou for this Cause, and say: 'By the righteousness of God.
Arise thou to serve His Cause, and say: God is My witness.
Arise thou to serve His Cause, and say: God is My witness.

source: انّ هذا لنقطة الأولی قد ظهر فی قمیصه الأخری باسمه الأبهی.
reference: Verily this is the Primal Point, arrayed in His new attire and manifested in His glorious Name.
hyps: This is He Who hath appeared in another Dispensation, wearing a fresh raiment and bearing a new Name.
This same Manifestation, who is the Primal Point, hath appeared in the form of His Most Mighty Self in His Other Robe, as the bearer of His sublime Name.
Verily, this is the Primal Point Who hath appeared in His Other Self, in His robe of glory, bearing His Most Great Name.
Verily this is the Primal Point that hath appeared in His Other Self, attired in a fresh Robe, bearing His Most Glorious Name.
This, verily, is the Primal Point that hath appeared in His new raiment, in His name, the All-Glorious.
Indeed He is the Primal Point, and hath appeared in His own garment, wearing upon it His name, the All-Glorious.
This Point is none other than Him Who hath appeared in the form of a man in this Day, invested with the name and attributes of His own Self.
Verily this is the Primal Point that hath appeared in His Other Garment bearing the name of His All-Glorious Self.

source: و اذاً فی هذا الأفق یشهد و یری.
reference: He at present beholdeth everything from this Horizon.
hyps: From that heaven, therefore, He witnesseth and beareth Me company.
and He witnesseth to its truth.
He testifieth to this in that same Horizon.
From this Spot His light is, verily, shed forth and beareth witness unto its truth.
He testifieth, therefore, unto this truth, and beareth witness thereof.
Thus shall it witness and behold.
and he witnesseth to this on this day.
Unto this verity beareth witness the sun that shineth above that horizon.

source: و انّه علی کلّ شیء محیط.
reference: Indeed He is supreme over all things.
hyps: Indeed His dominion is over all things.
In truth He is supreme over all things.
He, verily, is supreme over all things.
Indeed He embraceth all things.
Indeed He is supreme over all things.
He, verily, hath power over all things.
Indeed His knowledge embraceth all things.
His power can assuredly accomplish whatsoever He willeth.

source: و انّه لهو المذکور فی الملإ الأعلی بالنّبإ العظیم و فی ممالک البقآء بجمال القدیم و لدی العرش بهذا الاسم الّذی منه زلّت اقدام العارفین.
reference: Amongst the Concourse on High He is known as the Most Great Announcement and in the Realms of Eternity as the Ancient Beauty, and before the Throne by this Name which hath caused the footsteps of them that are endued with understanding to slip.
hyps: In the Concourse on High He is extolled as the Great Announcement, in the realms of eternity as the Ancient Beauty, and before His throne as Him Who holdeth within His grasp the Pen that hath caused the footsteps of all them that have recognized Him to slip.

His name hath been revealed unto the Concourse on High as the Great Announcement, and in the Realms of Immortality as the Ancient Beauty, and before Our Throne by this Name which hath caused the footsteps of every man of understanding to slip.

He, verily, is the One mentioned in the Concourse on High as the Mighty Announcement, Who in the Realms of Eternity hath been designated as the Ancient Beauty, while before the throne He is recognized through this Name that hath caused the footsteps of all men endued with understanding to slip.

He is mentioned in the Concourse on high as the Great Annunciation, and in the Realms of eternity as the Ancient Beauty, and before Our Throne by this Name which hath caused the footsteps of the wise to slip.

He it is Who hath been mentioned in the Concourse on high as the Most Great Announcement, and in the Realms of Eternity as the Ancient Beauty, and before My Throne by this Name, the hearing of which hath caused the footsteps of every man of understanding to slip.

He it is Who hath been mentioned in the Concourse on high as the Great Announcement, Who is called in the realms of eternity the Ancient Beauty, and in the presence of His Throne He is known under this Name which hath caused the footsteps of the cognizant to slip.

He, verily, is the One Who is named in the Company of Glory the Most Great Announcement, Who in the Realms of eternity is described as the Ancient Beauty, and Who before Our throne is known by this Name that hath caused the footsteps of the well-informed to slip.

In the Concourse on high He is described as the Great Announcement, while in the Realms of Immortality He is designated as the Ancient Beauty. Upon this Name, the Name of God Himself, dependeth the fall of every man endued with perception.

source: قد تمّت حجّة الله فی هذا الظّهور لکلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض من قبل ان ینزل آیة من سمآء قدس رفیع و من دونه قد نزل معادل ما نزل فی البیان.
reference: In this Revelation even before a single verse was sent down from the realm of holiness and sublimity, the supreme testimony of God had been fulfilled for all the inmates of heaven and the dwellers on earth. moreover, We have revealed the equivalent of whatsoever was sent down in the Dispensation of the Bayán.
hyps: The testimony of God hath been fulfilled, prior to any revelation being sent down from the realm of holiness, for this Revelation, unto every one that is in heaven and on earth, hath been made manifest. As to what hath been revealed in the Dispensation of the Bayán, its equivalent hath been sent down.

God hath, in this Revelation, fulfilled His testimony unto all that are in heaven and all that are on earth, ere one single verse was sent down from the holy heaven, and exalted is He above all things, inasmuch as a thing equal to what hath been sent down in the Dispensation of the Bayán hath already been revealed.

In this Revelation the testimony of God hath been fulfilled unto all that are in the heavens and on earth, ere even a sign was sent down from heaven, and before it was revealed, there was revealed what equalled the revelation made in the Dispensation of the Bayán.

In this Revelation the testimony of God hath been fulfilled unto all that are in heaven and on earth, ere a sign was sent down from the holy and exalted heaven, and likewise for that which was revealed in the Dispensation of the Bayán.

The testimony of God hath been fulfilled in this Revelation to all that are in heaven and on earth before one verse had descended from the realm of holiness and sublimity; nay, we have revealed the equivalent of whatsoever was sent down in the Dispensation of the Bayán.

The testimony of God hath in this Revelation attained its consummation for every one that is in heaven and on earth, ere a single verse was sent down from the holy and exalted Heaven or anything else besides it.

The testimony of God hath been fulfilled through this Revelation unto all that are in heaven and on earth ere a single verse was sent down from the realm of holiness and grandeur, and more hath been revealed than had been set forth in the Bayán.

God hath completed His testimony in this Revelation unto all who are in heaven and on earth, ere a single letter was revealed from the realm of holiness and sublimity, and beyond it—beyond it We have revealed the equivalent of what was sent down in the Dispensation of the Bayán.

source: خافوا عن الله و لا تبطلوا اعمالکم و لا تکوننّ من الغافلین.
reference: Fear ye God and suffer not your deeds to be rendered vain and be not of them that are sunk in heedlessness.
hyps: Fear ye God, and suffer not your deeds to be rendered vain, and be not of those that have gone astray.
Fear ye God and suffer not your deeds to prove vain, nor be of them that have gone astray.
Fear ye God, and bring not in vain your works, and be not of them that have gone astray.
Fear ye God, and suffer not your deeds to become vain, nor be of those who have strayed afar from Him.
Fear ye God and suffer not your actions to become vain, neither be of those who are heedless.
Fear ye God, and render your deeds fruitless not, and be not of them that have gone astray.
Fear ye God and suffer not your deeds to be rendered vain and be not of them that have strayed away from Him.
Fear ye God, that haply your works may not be rendered vain and ye may not be reckoned among the heedless ones.

source: ان افتحوا عیونکم لتشهدوا جمال القدم من هذا المنظر المشرق المنیر.
reference: Open your eyes that ye may behold the Ancient Beauty from this shining and luminous station.
hyps: Open your eyes that ye may behold the Beauty of the Ancient King from this radiant and luminous seat.
Open ye your eyes that ye may behold this Ancient Beauty from this shining, this luminous Spot.
Open your eyes that ye may behold the Ancient Beauty gazed on by this shining and luminous countenance.
Open your eyes that ye may behold the Beauty of the Ancient of Days from this resplendent and radiant Spot.
Uncover your eyes that ye may behold the Ancient Beauty as He revealeth His beauty unto you from this shining and luminous Horizon.
Open your eyes that ye may behold the Beauty of God, in this bright and beaming Countenance.
Cast ye your eyes wide open that ye may behold this Source of everlasting joy, this Dayspring of celestial glory, this Dawning-Place of incomparable beauty.
Let your eyes be opened that ye may behold this Ancient Beauty that shineth above His radiant and resplendent Countenance.

source: قد نزل هیکل الموعود علی غمام الحمرآء و عن یمینه جنود الوحی و عن یساره ملائکة الالهام و قضی الأمر من لدی الله المقتدر القدیر.
reference: The Promised One Himself hath come down from heaven, seated upon the crimson cloud with the hosts of revelation on His right, and the angels of inspiration on His left, and the Decree hath been fulfilled at the behest of God, the Omnipotent, the Almighty.
hyps: He Who was promised unto mankind hath appeared upon a crimson cloud, with the hosts of revelation on His right hand, and the angels of inspiration on His left.

There hath descended upon Him Who is the Promised One the Crimson Cloud, on His right flank the hosts of revelation, and on His left flank the angels of inspiration, as decreed by God, the Omnipotent, the Powerful.

He Who was promised unto men is come, riding on the crimson cloud, with the hosts of revelation on His right hand and the angels of inspiration on His left, and the decree hath been fulfilled at the behest of God, the Potent, the Powerful.

He Who was foretold hath come down from heaven on a ruddy cloud, His right hand is occupied with the hosts of revelation, His left with the angels of inspiration, and the decree is fulfilled at the behest of God, the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful.

The Promised One Himself hath descended from heaven, seated upon the Crimson Cloud, with the hosts of revelation on His right hand, and the angels of inspiration on His left, and the decree of God hath been fulfilled, at His behest, Who is the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

He Who was promised unto mankind hath descended from Heaven on a crimson cloud, with the hosts of revelation on His right hand, and the angels of inspiration on His left. The decree hath been irrevocably settled by God, the Omnipotent, the Powerful.

The Promised One Jesus Christ hath descended from heaven upon a crimson cloud, with the hosts of Revelation on His right hand, and the angels of inspiration on His left, and the decree hath been fulfilled at the behest of God, the Most Powerful, the All-Powerful.

He Who was promised unto mankind hath descended from heaven upon a crimson cloud, with hosts of celestial beings on His right and left hand, and all sovereignty is fixedly ordained by God, the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful.

source: و بذلک زلّت کلّ الأقدام الّا من عصمه الله بفضله و جعله من الّذین عرفوا الله بنفسه ثمّ انقطعوا عن العالمین.
reference: Thereupon the footsteps of everyone have slipped except such as God hath protected through His tender mercy and numbered with those who have recognized Him through His Own Self and detached themselves from all that pertaineth to the world.
hyps: Thereupon, all men's footsteps slipped except those whom God had protected through His grace and made part of those who have recognized Him through His own Self and detached themselves wholly from the world and its peoples.

Thereupon all men's steps slipped except such as were kept safe by God through His grace, who have been numbered among them that have recognized God through His own Self and detached themselves from the world and all that is therein.

Through its potency, all other footsteps have slipped except those which God hath protected through His grace, and caused to be numbered with such men as recognize God with their own understanding, who then rid themselves of all attachment to worldly things.

Thereupon every foot slipped, except those that God had delivered through His grace, and caused to be reckoned among those who have recognized Him through His own Self, and rid themselves of all attachment to any one of His creatures.

All men have slipped, except such as were preserved by God through His bounty, and whom He caused to be reckoned among them that know Him by His own Self, and who, then, rid themselves of attachment to any one of His creatures.

Through this all have slipped except those whom God hath safeguarded through His grace and made of them those who recognize Him through their own selves and then rid themselves of attachment to any one of His creatures.

Through Him the footsteps of everyone have slipped except those whom God hath kept safe through His grace and made to be of them that have recognized God by His own Self and then rid themselves of all attachment unto the world and its people.

Thereupon every foot slipped except those whom God will protect through His mercy, whom He hath caused to recognize Him through His own Self, and whom He hath caused to be detached from all that pertaineth to any of Thy creatures.

source: اسمع کلمات ربّک طهّر صدرک عن کلّ الاشارات لیتجلّی علیه انوار شمس ذکر اسم ربّک و یکون من الموقنین.
reference: Hearken thou unto the Words of thy Lord and purify thy heart from every illusion so that the effulgent light of the remembrance of thy Lord may shed its radiance upon it, and it may attain the station of certitude.
hyps: Give ear to the words uttered by thy Lord, cleanse thine heart from every suggestion that is not derived from Him, that His light may be diffused upon it, through the utterance of thy tongue, and that thou mayest become of those who truly believe in Him.

Incline thine ears to the Words of thy Lord, cleanse thine heart from all vain suggestions that the splendors of the daystar of the remembrance of thy Lord may shed their radiance thereon, and that he may be reckoned with them who have truly recognized Him.

Give ear unto the words of thy Lord. Purify thy heart from all idle fancies that the splendors of the Sun of the remembrance of Him Who is the Lord of all might may shine brightly upon it, and enable it to recognize the truth.

Hearken thou unto the words of thy Lord, cleanse thy heart from all vain suggestions that the splendor of the Daystar of remembrance of thy Lord may shine forth, and cause thee to be of them who truly believe.
Hearken thou unto the words of thy Lord, and purify thy heart from all idle fancies, that the light of remembrance of thy Lord may shine brightly within it and that thy heart may be well assured.

Give ear unto the words of thy Lord. Purify thy heart from every trace of doubt, that the effulgent light of remembrance of thy Lord may illuminate it, and it be among those who are well assured of His truth.
Hearken thou unto the words of thy Lord, purify thy heart from all idle fancies so that the light of remembrance of thy Lord may shine forth therein and enable thee to be of them that truly believe.

Hearken thou unto the Words of thy Lord, and purify thy heart from every suggestion, that the glory of the Sun of the mention of thy Lord may shed its radiance upon it and it may become of them that believe with steadfast faith.

source: ثمّ اعلم بأن حضر بین یدینا کتابک و شهدنا ما فیه و کنّا من الشّاهدین.
reference: Know thou moreover that thy letter reached Our presence and We perceived and perused its contents.
hyps: Know thou also that thy book hath been delivered unto Us, and We perused its contents, and We were of those who testify to its truth.
Know thou moreover that thy book hath been brought before Us, and We perused its contents, and We are of those who bear witness unto its truth.
Know thou moreover that thy book was delivered unto Us, and We perused its contents, and were of those who read it.
Know thou also that thy Book reached Our Presence, and We perused its contents, and were amongst those who observed it.
Know thou, moreover, that thy Book hath reached Our presence, and We have perused its contents, and are one of those who ponder it in their hearts.
Know thou moreover that thy book hath reached Our presence, and We have perused it, and of this We were truly witnesses.
Know thou moreover that thy Book hath been produced before Us, that We have perused it and been well aware of its contents.
Know thou moreover that thy Book hath been received by Us, and We perused its contents, and were satisfied thereof.

source: و عرفنا ما فیه من مسائل الّتی سألت عنها و انّا کنّا مجیبین.
reference: We noted the questions thou hast asked and will readily answer thee.
hyps: We perused the questions thou hast proposed therein, and will readily answer thee.
We recognized therein the matters about which thou hadst sought our advice, and We were ready to answer thee.
We have perused the questions thou hast asked Us and We will readily answer thy queries.
We have noted thy questions concerning matters which thou hast asked Us about, and We shall readily answer thee.
We recognized therein the questions thou hadst asked Us, and We were ready to answer thee.
We perused therein the questions thou hadst asked Us, and were prepared to answer thee.
And We discovered therein questions which thou hast asked Us, and to these We shall answer.
We perused all that thou hast asked concerning certain problems and were ready to answer thee.

source: و لکلّ نفس الیوم یلزم بأن یسأل عن الله فیما یحتاج به و انّ ربّک یجیبه بآیات بدع مبین.
reference: It behooveth everyone in this Day to ask God that which he desireth, and thy Lord will heed his petition with wondrous and undeniable verses.
hyps: To everyone is today prescribed the questioning of God concerning that which he needeth, and thy Lord will certainly answer him through clear tokens.

To each one of them should, under these circumstances, turn unto God with prayer that He may reveal to him the truth concerning the verse which he hath failed to understand, and to this thy Lord will assuredly succor him, in accordance with the method laid down in the Book.
Let everyone inquire of God at this Day about that for which he standeth in need; verily, thy Lord will respond unto him with clear signs and perspicuous utterances.
Unto everyone it is incumbent to seek from God that which he desireth, and thy Lord will respond with clear tokens and signs.
It behooveth everyone on this Day to make inquiry concerning God, concerning what they stand in need of, for thy Lord will answer every such question with clear and weighty verses.
It behooveth everyone in this Day to supplicate God regarding that which he needeth, for thy Lord will assuredly answer him through clear and weighty tokens.
For everyone today it is incumbent to ask God for whatever he needeth. and thy Lord shall answer him with clear and manifest signs.
To every one, it behooveth this Day to ask God about whatsoever is requisite, for verily thy Lord will respond unto him with clear tokens.

source: و امّا ما سألت فی المعاد.
reference: Thou hast asked regarding the subject of the return.
hyps: And now concerning thy question regarding the subject of Return.
And now concerning thy question regarding the subject of the Return.
And now concerning thy question regarding the theme of the return.
Thou hast asked Me regarding the subject of the Return.
Thou hast asked Me about the subject of the Return.
And now concerning thy question regarding the subject of the return.
Now regarding thy question about the Resurrection.
Thou hast also inquired concerning the significance of the term Return.

source: فاعلم بأنّ العود مثل البدء.
reference: Know thou that the end is like unto the beginning.
hyps: Know thou that return shall be even as the beginning.
Know thou that the end of time is the beginning of time.
Know thou that return is even as the beginning.
Know thou that the return is identical with the origin.
Know thou that both beginnings and endings are but names, for every ending is itself a beginning.
Know thou that the latter end resembleth the beginning.
Know thou that both beginning and end are the same.
Know thou that return is even as the beginning.

source: کما انت تشهد البدء کذلک فاشهد العود و کن من الشّاهدین.
reference: Even as thou dost consider the beginning, similarly shouldst thou consider the end, and be of them that truly perceive.
hyps: As thou dost consider the beginning, likewise reflect upon the end, and be of them who perceive.
As thou art well aware that which was originated must be resolved into the same.
As thou dost witness to His first appearance, likewise testify thou unto His return, and be of them that truly behold Him.
Just as thou dost witness to the beginning, so shouldst thou testify to its return, and be of them that perceive.
As thou dost witness the beginning to be true, in like manner shouldst thou acknowledge the end, and be of them that perceive.
As thou dost witness His beginning, so must thou witness His return, and be of those who behold Him with open eyes.
Even as thou witnessest the beginning, similarly be thou aware of the end, and be of them that truly perceive.
Even as thou beholdest the beginning, so shalt thou behold the return, and to this be thou of those who testifieth.

source: بل فاشهد البدء نفس العود و کذلک بالعکس لتکون علی بصیرة منیر.
reference: Nay, rather consider the beginning as the end itself, and so conversely, that thou mayest acquire a clear perception.
hyps: Nay, be aware that the beginning itself is the end, and so is the end the beginning.
Yea, rather proclaim thou that the Beginning is itself the End, and so likewise with the Reverse, that thou mayest be endued with insight.
Nay, rather consider the beginning as identical with the end. And likewise in the opposite sense, that thou mayest be endued with a luminous insight.
Nay, more; consider the beginning itself as an end, and the very opposite of thy notion.
Nay more, thou dost thyself bear witness unto this reality, for to have been first in beginning must make thee first in end, if thine eyes be clear.
Nay, regard thou the beginning to be identical with the end itself. Thus it is that the reverse shall prove true, so that thine eyes may be opened.
Nay, know thou that this very beginning is its own end, and its end is its own beginning.
Nay, rather, witness that the Beginning is even as the End itself, and likewise the reverse will prove true, so that thine insight may be enlightened.

source: ثمّ اعلم بأنّ کلّ الأشیآء فی کلّ حین تبدأ و تعود بأمر ربّک المقتدر القدیر.
reference: Know thou moreover that every created thing is continually brought forth and returned at the bidding of thy Lord, the God of power and might.
hyps: Know thou moreover that all created things are continually brought forth and returned at the bidding of thy Lord, the Sovereign, the Omnipotent, the Almighty.
Know thou moreover that all things, every moment of thy life, are born anew and return to Thee through the irresistible decree of thy Lord, the Almighty, the Most Powerful.
Know thou, moreover, that whatsoever existeth will be created anew, at the bidding of thy Lord, the Almighty, the Most Powerful, and will return to Him.

Know thou moreover that every created thing liveth at whatever moment it beginneth to live, and dieth at whatever moment it beginneth to die, through the potency of a mere word uttered by Thy Lord, the Potent, the Powerful.
Know thou moreover that every created thing is continually brought forth and returned through the operation of the Will of thy Lord, the All-Powerful, the Most Powerful.
Know thou moreover that all things in this world have been created and will pass away, at the behest of thy Lord, the Lord of strength and of might.

Know thou moreover that at each instant of time all things come into being anew before thy face, and return unto Thee, through the operation of Thy decree—the operation of Him Who is the Almighty, the Most Powerful.
Know thou that all things exist and shall again be brought forth, at every new hour, through the operation of the Will of thy Lord, the Omnipotent, the Most Powerful.

source: و امّا عود الّذی هو مقصود الله فی الواحه المقدّس المنیع و اخبر به عباده هو عود الممکنات فی یوم القیامة.
reference: As to the Return, as God hath purposed in His sacred and exalted Tablets wherein He hath made this theme known unto His servants. by this is meant the return of all created things in the Day of Resurrection,
hyps: As to the Return—the object of God in His holy Tablets and exalted Writings, and that which He hath announced unto men—is the return of all created things in the Day of Resurrection.

Concerning this Return which God hath purposed in His most holy and sublime Tablets and concerning which He hath informed His servants, it referreth to the return of all created things in the Day of Resurrection.

With regard to return, which is the Object of God in His holy and exalted Tablets wherein He hath informed His servants of this theme, it referreth unto the return of all created things in the Day of Resurrection.

Concerning return, which God hath purposed in His holy and exalted Tablets and hath announced unto His servants. This return referreth to the restoration, on the Day of Resurrection, of all created things.
But the return referred to by God in His holy and exalted Tablets and by Whom He hath made known to His servants is the return which shall take place on the Day of Resurrection.

The return of which God hath spoken in His most holy and exalted Tablets, and regarding which He hath given warning unto His servants, is nothing else except the return of all created things upon the Day of Resurrection.

Concerning the return mentioned by God in His Most Holy and Exalted Tablets, which He hath announced unto men, this return referreth to the resurrection of all created things on the Day of Resurrection.
But the Return which God desireth as set forth in His holy and most exalted Tablets, which He hath announced unto His servants, is the return of the entire creation on the Day of Resurrection.

source: و هذا اصل العود کما شهدت فی ایّام الله و کنت من الشّاهدین
reference: and this is indeed the essence of the Return as thou hast witnessed in God's own days and thou art of them that testify to this truth.
hyps: this principle of return, as thou hast witnessed in former times.
Such shall be the return, as thou hast observed, in the day of God, and thou art of those who truly perceive it.
This is the principle of Transmigration of Souls as thou hast thyself witnessed in these days of God, and thou art of them that bear witness to it.
This is the essence of the Return, as thou hast witnessed in the days of God, and unto this thou wert a witness.
This principle of return hath been established, as thou hast witnessed in these days of God, and art of them who perceive it.
This, verily, is the fundamental truth regarding the nature of the Return.
This indeed is the essence of return, as thou hast witnessed in the days of God, and thou art one of them that truly witnesseth to it
This is the essence of the Return, as thou hast witnessed in the days of God, and to which thou hast borne thy testimony.

source: و انّه لو یعید کلّ الأسمآء فی اسم و کلّ النّفوس فی نفس لیقدر.
reference: Verily God is fully capable of causing all names to appear in one name, and all souls in one soul.
hyps: He truly is capable of calling to life again every name through a name, and of bringing back all beings through a single Being.
He can cause to be produced through one single name all names that exist, and through each individual person He can create all persons.
Were He so to desire, every name would be able to embody all names, and every person to express all persons.
Verily, it would be within His power to cause all names to be repeated in every name, and all souls to be reborn through every soul.
He it is Who can restore again every name unto one name, and every soul unto its own soul.
God, verily, hath the power to cause every name to be repeated through a single name and every soul through one person.

Were He to reconstitute the entire creation and call it by a new name, or raise up a fresh generation of beings and confer on each individual among them a new identity, He would be fully capable of achieving His purpose.
He verily hath the power to cause all names to appear in one Name, and all souls in one Soul.

source: و انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر.

He is indeed the Strong, the Potent.

and that this return will be according to His command.

reference: Indeed He is the One Who doeth and ordaineth all things.

He is the Doer, the Supreme Ordainer.
