source: و انّک لا تشهد فی الرّجع و العود الّا ما حقّق به هذان و هو کلمة ربّک العزیز العلیم.
reference: Moreover, thou shouldst not perceive the fulfillment of the Return and the Resurrection save in the Word of thy Lord, the Almighty, the All Knowing.
hyps: In neither the one nor the other case wilt thou witness any reality save the Word of thy Lord, the Almighty, the All Knowing.
Thou dost not perceive either the Resurrection or the Return except inasmuch as thy Lord hath decreed it through His wondrous word, His inviolable Faith, His all-encompassing knowledge.

Thou shalt not behold in them the fulfillment of the promises of return and restoration until after all that hath been divinely ordained—namely the Word of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the All-Knowing, hath been realized.
And thou shalt not witness the fulfillment of these predictions until the word of thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing, hath been fulfilled.
As to the resurrection and return, thou shalt behold naught thereof save that which these two have fulfilled, namely the Word of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the All-Knowing.
No testimony canst thou bear regarding the Resurrection and the Return except that which is warranted by both, to wit, the Word of thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.
And to none is given the right to witness the process of this return but He through Whom it hath been fulfilled, namely the word of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the All-Wise.
The signs of His return and appearance are but the realization of the Word of thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

source: مثلاً انّه لو یأخذ کفّاً من الطّین و یقول هذا لهو الّذی اتّبعتموه من قبل هذا لحقّ بمثل وجوده و لیس لأحد ان یعترض علیه.
reference: For instance, were He to take a handful of earth and declare it to be the One Whom ye have been following in the past, it would undoubtedly be just and true, even as His real Person, and to none is given the right to question His authority.
hyps: Were He to, for instance, take a handful of clay, and assert that it was He Whom ye have been following, such a claim would be borne out by the same token which attesteth His own Reality, while no man hath the right to question His authority.
If, for instance, he should take a handful of earth and proclaim it to be that One Whom ye have been following, it would truly be so in very deed, and none hath the right to question His authority.

Were He to take up a handful of earth and declare it to be that very Being after Whom ye have been seeking, His word would, in that instance, be as one in existence with Him Himself, and none hath power to question His authority.
It would be, for example, fully justified, if it were to take up a handful of earth and declare it to be the Person Whom ye have been following.

For example, if He should take a handful of earth and declare it to be the One Whom ye have been seeking, it would be the truth, as true as His own Self, and unto none is given the right to gainsay His authority.

Were He to take hold of a handful of clay and cry out: This is the One Whom ye have followed heretofore, such a claim would be as valid as His own Person and none but God hath the right to question it.

For instance, if He were to take a handful of earth and declare it to be the One whom ye have been following all along, such a claim would be as good as His own person, and would deserve the obedience of every one of you.

For example, if He were to take a handful of clay and say that this very thing was the One after Whom ye have been seeking, it would be true, even as His own being is true, and none can question His right to make such an assertion.

source: و انّک لا تنظر فی هذا المقام الی الحدود و الاشارات بل فانظر بما حقّق به الأمر و کن من المتفرّسین.
reference: Moreover, in this station take thou heed not to turn thy gaze unto limitations and allusions, but rather unto that whereby the Revelation itself hath been fulfilled and be of them that are discerning.
hyps: Regard, in this station, neither His limitations nor His allusions, but rather fix thine eyes upon that whereby He hath fulfilled His promise and be of them who comprehend and ponder in their hearts.
However, here again one must not refer to indications and allusions but rather to that which the Báb Himself has clearly and explicitly revealed.

In such passages the reader should not fix his attention on the outer meanings or allusions, but rather on that through which these allusions have been conveyed, and be thou of them that comprehend this truth.
Consider thou, however, in this connection neither the limitations nor the hints that have been recorded therein but rather what they have achieved and be of those who discern.

In this station, neither the limits nor indications can be seen. rather it behooveth thee to fix thy gaze upon that through which the truth of the matter hath been established, and be thou of the discerning.

In this station gaze not upon the restrictions and allusions of men but rather fix thy gaze upon that whereby the purpose of the Revelation hath been fulfilled, and be thou of those who are discerning.
Consider thou this station, wherein there is naught for thee to search except the signs which the Pen hath left behind, whereby thou mayest unravel the mystery of His Revelation.
Consider attentively this passage and be not heedless thereof; ponder upon what hath been achieved through it and be of them that observe closely.

source: اذاً نصرّح لک ببیان واضح مبین لتطّلع بما اردت من مولاک القدیم.

reference: Were God to pronounce the lowliest of creatures among the faithful to be the First One to believe in the Bayán, thou shouldst have no misgivings about it and must be of them that truly believe.
hyps: If God decreed that amongst them that have believed on God the lowliest of creatures should be numbered with those who were the first to embrace the Faith of the Bayán, thou must not doubt this, but be of them that believe it.

If the Lord God should pronounce the lowest of His creatures, among them that have believed on God, to be the Prime Minister, thou must not doubt it for one moment, but must believe in the truth of it with all thine heart and soul.

Were God to proclaim unto the lowliest among His creatures that hath believed in God that He is the First One to embrace the Faith of the Bayán, thou shouldst not question this, nor be of those who doubt its truthfulness.

Were God to pronounce any one of the least among those who believe in Him to be the First One to embrace the Faith, thou shouldst assuredly not entertain any doubt concerning this, but rather be of them that truly believe it.
Were God to pronounce the lowest of all creatures among them that have believed on God to be the First One to believe in the Bayán, thou must have no doubt thereof and be assured thereof.

Were God to pronounce the lowliest among all men who have believed on God to be the First One to embrace the Faith of the Bayán, thou shouldst have no misgivings about it, and be thou well assured thereof.

Were God to pronounce the lowliest of His creatures among the faithful to be the First One to believe in the Bayán, thou wouldst have no cause for doubt concerning this, nor couldst thou fail to regard it as true.

Should God pronounce the meanest among men, and they who believe in Him to be the very first to embrace the Bayán, thou must, assuredly, not question this, nor hesitate therein, but rather believe it with all thine heart.

source: و لا تنظر الی الحدود و الأسمآء فی هذا المقام بل بما حقّق به اوّل من آمن و هو الایمان بالله و عرفان نفسه و الایقان بأمره المبرم الحکیم.
reference: In this station look not upon human limitations and names but rather upon that whereby the rank of the First One to believe is vindicated, which is faith in God, and recognition of His Being and assurance in the fulfillment of His irresistible and binding command.
hyps: In this connection neither the limitations nor the names which have been imposed upon Him should be regarded, but rather for that whereby the believer in the former Revelation was vindicated, and that through which faith in God, knowledge of His Essence and certitude concerning His inviolable and most wise Ordinance were established.

Neither should any regard be had in this station unto limitations and names, but rather that whereby the chief amongst the faithful, the First One to embrace the truth, was characterized, which consisteth in belief in God, in knowledge of His Essence, and in certitude concerning His irresistible and wise Ordinance.

Regard not, however, the boundaries and names associated with this station but rather regard that whereby the faithful were first enabled to recognize its splendors, and which is none other than belief in God, knowledge of His Being, and certitude in His inviolable, all-wise Revelation.

What should attract our attention in this instance is not the limitations imposed on man or the names and attributes of God, but rather the principles whereby the believer's first step hath been determined, principles that consist in belief in God, in recognition of His nature, and in assurance regarding His irrevocable and infallible Cause.

The restrictions which apply to other passages in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas and the limitations on its use have, in this instance, been revealed for a specific purpose. These restrictions do not apply when reading its text. Nor are they relevant when considering its spirit and significance. What mattereth is faith in God and recognition of His Self, His Essence, and assurance in His unassailable, all-powerful and infallible Cause.

Not the limitations and names are to be considered in this station but rather that whereby the first One to believe was made perfect, that is faith in God, knowledge of His Self, and certitude in the Faith of His irresistible and all-compelling Will.

In such a Cause neither the limitations of men nor the names they bear can in any way be allowed to obstruct thy vision. Rather should the standard for judging every one who hath appeared in this Dispensation be whether he hath enabled the First One to attain the station of true faith in God, of recognition of His Being, and of certitude concerning the import of His irresistible, His all-compelling Revelation.

Consider not in this regard the limits and names of things, but rather the fact that it is through this very Revelation that the believer hath first recognized the Truth of God, apprehended His Reality, and acknowledged the power of His all-compelling and wise command.

Consider thou the Revelation of Him Who is the Focus of the Bayán—glorified be His glory.
Consider the Revelation of this Point of the Bayán—exalted is His glory.

source: هل ینبغی لأحد ان یعترض و یقول هذا عجمیّ و هو عربیّ او هذا سمّی بالحسین و هو کان محمّداً فی الاسم.
reference: Doth it beseem a man to dispute with Him by saying that this man is from Persia, the Other from Arabia, or this one was called Husayn while the Other bore the name of Muhammad
hyps: If one should refuse to accept this Revelation, saying that He is a foreigner and I am an Arab, or that He hath been named after Husayn while His real name is Muhammad, what could have been gained thereby
To what purpose should any one protest and say that this one is a foreigner, while that one is an Arab, or that this one hath been called Husayn while he was originally Muhammad?
Can anyone challenge Him and say that this one hath been called after Husayn while he was really Muhammad or that this other hath been named after Khidr while he actually bore the name Mihdí
Would it beseem any man to protest against this and say, The one is a foreigner, the other a native-born, or that one was called Husayn, the other Muhammad.
To what purpose is it if anyone oppose Him saying This man is an aboriginal, the other a foreigner. or This man was called Husayn, while he was actually Muhammad
Can any one cavil at Him saying, This man was named Husayn, but His real name is Muhammad. Or This was a Persian but His Arabic title is Abú-Ghafr.

It would surely be improper for anyone to contend that this one was called Husayn while his true name was Muhammad, or to maintain that this man who is described in the tablet as a Persian, was really an Arab.
How can it, then, befit anyone to protest and say, This one hath been named after Husayn while he is Muhammad, or that this one was called 'Alí while his original name was Sultán.

reference: Surely no man of intelligence and insight would ever pay attention unto limitations or names, but rather unto that with which Muhammad was invested, which was none other than the Cause of God.
hyps: They will not regard the limits or names but rather will contemplate that whereby Muhammad was invested, and this is none other than the Cause of God.
He will not regard limits nor names but rather that whereby Muhammad was invested, which is the command of God.

They would, indeed, regard it as utterly absurd to imagine that any man's station can be regarded as identical with the station of Muhammad, for Muhammad was but a mere sign and symbol of the Will of God.
The former will neither look at limits nor names but rather will regard that which was upon Muhammad, and this is the Cause of God.
He will not look to the limitations and names, but rather at that which Muhammad had unto Him, which was nothing but the Cause of God.
Let no man consider what are limits or names, but rather let him regard that which Muhammad possessed—this is the Faith of God.
Neither will anyone regard the limits which have been prescribed for Him, nor His titles, but will regard rather that whereby Muhammad was invested, and this, verily, is the Revelation of God.
Not for any law or creed will any be prepared to look, but rather for that which was upon Muhammad, and this is the Cause of God.

Such a man will likewise regard Husayn in that which be hath held fast to the Cause of God, the Potent, the All-Glorious, the Omniscient, the All-Wise.

thus will he regard Husayn, as possessed of the power of the Revelation of God, the Omnipotent, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

reference: And since the First One to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was invested with command similar to that with which Muhammad, the Messenger of God, was invested, therefore the Báb pronounced him to be the latter, namely His return and resurrection.
hyps: Now since the first person to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was invested with the same powers as Muhammad, the Messenger of God had declared him to be His own Self and His return and resurrection.

And since those who first believed in God among the people of the Bayán were in the same state of belief as Muhammad, the Apostle of God, therefore He decreed that the first believer should be regarded as the Apostle Muhammad Himself, and as His Return and Resurrection.

Since the first one to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was in the same state of servitude as Muhammad, the Apostle of God, therefore did He pronounce that this soul was His self, His return, and His re-appearance.

As He Who was the first to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was on the same plane as Muhammad, the Apostle of God, 'Abdu'l-Baha decreed that He was His Manifestation, His return, His recurrence.

And since the First One to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was treated in accordance with the treatment accorded unto Muhammad, the Apostle of God, He ruled that he too was He Himself and that he was a returnee and a repeater.

Since the believer in the Bayán was at one time identical with Muhammad, the Apostle of God, He pronounced him to be the same Person, and declared Him to be that very Muhammad who had gone and returned.
Since the first person to believe in God according to the Bayán was the same as Muhammad, the Apostle of God, He pronounced that the Báb was the return and resurrection of Muhammad.
Since the first person to believe in God in the Dispensation of the Bayán was as Muhammad the Messenger of God was, therefore He pronounced that He was His Apostle and His Return and Resurrection.

source: ثمّ اعلم بأنّه فی یوم الظّهور لو یحکم علی ورقة من الأوراق کلّ الأسمآء من اسمائه الحسنی لیس لأحد ان یقول لم و بم و من قال فقد کفر بالله و کان من المنکرین.
reference: Know thou moreover that in the Day of Revelation were He to pronounce one of the leaves to be the manifestation of all His excellent titles, unto no one is given the right to utter why or wherefore, and should one do so he would be regarded as a disbeliever in God and be numbered with such as have repudiated His Truth.
hyps: Know thou moreover that should, on the Day of His Revelation, He pronounce but one letter of all the letters in His Name He, for every one of His most excellent titles, is empowered to pronounce to be of such and such a letter, no one is to question Him or ask the reason, and he that doeth so hath disbelieved in God and is of the faithless.

Know thou moreover that should He, in the Day of Revelation and Revelation He is God, the Revealer decree to any leaf among leaves all the goodly titles associated with His Person, none hath the right to question His decree, or ask why or wherefore; should anyone challenge it, he would have disbelieved in God and would be numbered with such as repudiate His truth.

Know thou moreover that if in the Day of Revelation He pronounce one leaf of His Book to be possessed of all the attributes which may be attributed unto Him, to no one is given the right to question His verdict and to ask why and how, for whoever raiseth such questions hath repudiated the Word of God and is reckoned among the rebellious.

Know thou moreover that if, on the Day of His Revelation, He deigns to pronounce a leaf of My Book to be one of His Most Excellent Titles, no man should question or demand its reason and cause, for he who does so would have repudiated God and become of those that have denied Him.

Know thou moreover that, on the Day of His Revelation, should He ordain one of the leaves of His Book to be invested with the potency of all His most excellent titles, it would then be unlawful for any soul to ask why this had been decreed or to inquire whether there was any reason to explain this act, for were he to challenge its validity, he would have repudiated God's authority and be accounted among the faithless.

Know thou moreover that were any one among His noble titles to be made to depend upon the weight of a leaf in the Day of Revelation, unto none is given the right to ask why or wherefore, and should any one voice his query, he would be regarded as a disbeliever in God and would be numbered with the faithless.

Know thou moreover that were He to pronounce one of His leaves to be every one of His most excellent names, unto none is given the right to say why, or wherefore, or where, and he who should utter such words would have repudiated God and become a denier of Him.

Know thou moreover that if on the day of His Revelation He pronounce a leaf of those in existence to be all that He loveth, none hath the right to question either the motive or the propriety of such an act. whoever should challenge it would be regarded as a denier of God and an imposter.

Beware, beware lest thou behave like unto the people of the Bayán.
Beware! Beware that thou be not like unto the people of the Bayán.

source: لأنّ اکثرهم قد ضلّوا و اضلّوا و نسوا عهد الله و میثاقه و اشرکوا بالله الواحد الفرد الخبیر.
reference: For indeed they erred grievously, misguided the people, ignored the Covenant of God and His Testament and joined partners with Him, the One, the Incomparable, the All Knowing.
hyps: For most of them have gone astray, and led others to go astray, and forgotten the Covenant of God and His Testament, and joined partners with Him, the One, the Incomparable, the Omniscient.
For most of them erred grievously, and guided others to err, and forgot the Covenant of God and His Testament, and joined partners with Him, the One, the Incomparable, the All-Informed.
For most of them have erred grievously, misled the people, forgotten the Covenant of God and His Testament, and joined partners with God, the One, the Incomparable, the All-Informed.
For most have erred grievously, misguiding many others, forsaken the Covenant of God and His Testament, and joined partners with Him, the One, the Incomparable, the All Knowing.
For indeed they erred grievously, led others astray, forgot the Covenant of God, violated His Testament, and joined partners with Him, the Incomparable, the All Knowing.
For most of them have erred grievously, led others to err, have forgotten the Covenant of God and His Testament and have joined partners with God, the One, the Incomparable, the All-Informed.
most of them have gone astray and led others astray, and forgotten the Covenant of God and His Testament, and joined partners with Him, Who is the One, the Incomparable, the All-Informed.
For most of them have erred grievously, have caused others to err, have broken the Covenant of God and His Testament and joined partners with Him, the One, the Incomparable, the All-Informed.

source: و ما عرفوا نقطة البیان لأنّهم لو عرفوه بنفسه ما کفروا بظهوره فی هذا الهیکل المشرق المنیر.
reference: Verily they failed to recognize the Point of the Bayán, for had they recognized Him they would not have rejected His manifestation in this luminous and resplendent Being.
hyps: They have failed to recognize the Point of the Bayán, for had they done so they would never have repudiated His manifestation in this shining and luminous Tabernacle.

Nor hath any one been able to comprehend the significance of the Point of the Bayán, for were they to recognize Him as the Manifestation of God, such a man would assuredly never repudiate His manifestation in this luminous and resplendent Body.
And they failed to recognize the Point of the Bayán, for had they recognized Him alone, they would not have disbelieved in His manifestation in this Resplendent and Luminous Being.

The people have failed to recognize the Point of the Bayán, for had they recognized Him through His own Self, they would never have repudiated His Revelation manifested within this resplendent, this glorious Temple.
They have failed to recognize the Point of the Bayán, for if they had recognized Him, they would not have repudiated His Manifestation within this resplendent and luminous Form.
Neither did they recognize Him Who is the Point of the Bayán, for had they recognized Him, they would, of necessity, have acknowledged His manifestation within this luminous and resplendent Body.
Neither have they recognized the Point of the Bayán for had they known Him, they would not have repudiated His manifestation in this shining and luminous temple.
How could they know the Point of the Bayán, since were they to have recognized Him in His own Person, they would not have repudiated His Manifestation in this resplendent and luminous Tabernacle.

source: و انّهم لمّا کانوا ناظراً الی الأسمآء فلمّا بدّل اسمه الأعلی بالأبهی عمت عیونهم.
reference: And since they fixed their eyes on names, therefore when He replaced His Name the Most Exalted by the Most Glorious their eyes were dimmed.
hyps: As these men were fixedly intent upon names, when He transformed His most exalted name into the Most Glorious their sight was dimmed.
When they beheld His Name, they that dwelt in the world of names were stricken dumb, for when He changed His Most Exalted Name into the Most Glorious, blindness befell their eyes.
For as soon as He changed His name from Al 'Abha to Al 'Ala', their sight was darkened.
As they were gazing on His names, however, when He changed His name from 'Abdu'l Bahá to Abdu'l Baha their eyes became dim.
And since these persons were inclined toward names, therefore, when he substituted for the name Most Exalted the more beauteous one Most Mighty their eyes were blinded.
And since they were looking upon names, when He changed His Most Exalted Name to the Most Effulgent, their eyes were blinded.
and since they looked toward Names, therefore when His Most Exalted Name was changed into the All-Glorious Their eyes were dimmed.
When they who were fixtly intent on names heard that He Who was the Most Exalted had changed His name from 'Alí Muhammad to Baha'u'llah, they became blinded in their sight.

source: و ما عرفوه فی تلک الأیّام و کانوا من الخاسرین.
reference: They have failed to recognize Him in these days and are reckoned with those that perish.
hyps: What an utter failure they were who failed to recognize Him at that time.
What could they ever gain by it, and they were of the lost!
They recognized it not in those days, and were accounted among the lost.
How can ye fail to know Me when I am face to face with you, and be reckoned with those who have gone astray.
In those days no man recognized them, but rather treated them as losers.
They have erred grievously in this day and are accounted among the lost.
Behold how they have utterly failed to recognize Him in these days, and shall remain among the lost.
How could they be aware of such a Revelation when it dawned upon them, and yet fail to recognize Him Who was its Manifestation.

source: و انّهم لو عرفوا نفسه بنفسه و بما ظهر من عنده ما انکروه فی هذا الاسم المبارک البدیع الّذی جعله الله سیف امره بین السّموات و الأرضین.
reference: Indeed, had they known Him through His own Self or by virtue of that which He hath revealed, they would not have repudiated Him when He appeared in this glorious and incomparable Name, which God hath ordained to be the Sword of His Revelation between heaven and earth
hyps: They themselves, had they known Him, and been acquainted with what He hath manifested, would never have denied Him in this Name that the Lord hath ordained to be the Sword of His Revelation betwixt earth and heaven.

Were they to recognize Him through His own Self and what hath been manifested by Him, they would not repudiate His truth in this Most Great, this Peerless Name—which God hath made to be the Sword of His Revelation betwixt earth and heaven.

Had they recognized Him with their own souls, and were conscious of that which hath been revealed by Him, they would certainly have rejected this Name, this Most Great, this Peerless Remembrance, Whom God hath made to be the Sword of His Revelation betwixt earth and heaven.

If men be but willing to recognize Him in His Own Self, and will acknowledge whatever He hath manifested through His Revelation, it would never be possible for them to deny Him when revealed under this name, this most exalted and wondrous title, which God hath ordained to be the Sword of His Revelation unto all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth.

If men of understanding had recognized His nature through His own Self or through whatever He hath manifested, they would have never denied Him when He appeared in this Name—this Blessed, this incomparable Name Which God hath made to be the Sword of His Revelation unto all who are in heaven and on earth.

Could they have recognized Him when He manifested His Divine Essence, or discovered any falsehood in the things that were revealed by Him—things which are vouched for by the testimony of this Name—this glorious, this wondrous Name which God hath made to be the Sword of His Revelation unto all that are in heaven and on earth.

Were men to discover His identity through Him Who is His manifestation, and recognize the truth of that which He hath revealed Himself, they would assuredly not repudiate His claim to be the embodiment of this Name—a most excellent, an incomparable Name—which God hath ordained to be the Sword of His Revelation unto all who are in heaven and on earth.

It would assuredly be untrue to maintain that had He manifested Himself directly to the peoples of the world, and proclaimed His Revelation through no other instrumentality, they would have rejected Him when He appeared in this Name—the Most Holy, the Incomparable—which God hath ordained to be the Sword of His Revelation between heaven and earth.

source: و یفصّل به بین الحقّ و الباطل من یومئذ الی یوم الّذی یقوم النّاس لربّ العالمین
reference: and through which truth is separated from error, even from now until the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.
hyps: It will distinguish truth from falsehood, from this day until the Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all worlds
Through this light differences will be resolved between truth and falsehood from the day after tomorrow until the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.
And He distinguishes thereby right from wrong even from this day until the Day when men shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.
In this day He distinguisheth between truth and error, and will continue so to do until the judgment of the Day whereon mankind shall stand before God, the Lord of all worlds.
By it the faithful will be distinguished from the faithless even unto the Day when men shall stand before the Lord of the worlds,
through which from this day until the Day when mankind shall appear before the Lord of Lords shall be distinctly revealed the Righteous and the Unjust.
Through it will be clarified to every man the meaning of truth and falsehood, even from this day until the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all worlds.
Through it shall be separated, from this day hence until the Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all worlds, between truth and falsehood.

source: ثمّ اعلم بأنّ یوم الظّهور یعود کلّ الأشیآء عمّا سوی الله و کلّها فی صقع واحدة ولو کان من اعلاها او ادناها.
reference: Know thou moreover that in the Day of His Manifestation all things besides God shall be brought forth and placed equally, irrespective of their rank being high or low.
hyps: Know thou moreover that on the Day of His Revelation whatsoever existeth besides God will have been reduced to nothingness, and all will be raised up in one single plane, whether high or low.
Know thou that in the Day of God all created things shall have been deprived save Him, God, and every one of them shall be exalted to one station, whether he be the most sublime or the most lowly.
Know thou moreover that the Day of Revelation is the Day whereon all created things have been created to worship naught else but God, and have been exalted to the heights of oneness before Him.

Know thou moreover that on the Day of His Revelation all things except God will have been created anew, and will have attained the station wherein each one of them will be but a degree above or below all else, whether it be the highest or the lowest.
Know thou moreover that on the Day of Revelation all created things except God shall be made one, and shall attain unto the same station, though some may be nearer to Him than others.
Know thou moreover that on the Day of Revelation all things besides God shall become as one thing, however high or low they may be.
Know thou moreover that on the day of the Revelation of God all things except His Self shall be made to revert to their primal state, and to be placed in one common condition whether high or low.
Know thou moreover that on the Day of Reckoning all created things besides God shall be reduced to one level, though they may be diverse in rank, whether high or low.

source: و هذا العود لن یعرفه احد الّا بعد امر الله.
reference: The Day of Return is inscrutable unto all men until after the divine Revelation hath been fulfilled.
hyps: And this Return none can apprehend except after the revelation of God.
No man can tell it until after His Revelation.
No man can know when this Return will come, until after Gods Revelation.
No one can tell when that return will come; no one except God knows it.
As to this Return, none can appreciate its greatness except after God hath revealed it through His command.
No one can know the nature of this return except He to Whom God shall reveal it.
Neither can any one reckon it save after the Revelation of God.
This latter coming of the Promised One is not to be disclosed until after the Revelation of God.

source: و انّه لهو الآمر فیما یرید.
reference: He is in truth the One Who ordaineth whatsoever He willeth.
hyps: He, verily, ordaineth that which He desireth.
Potent is He to ordain what He desireth.
Verily He ordaineth that which He willeth.
He is, verily, sovereign over all that He desireth to ordain.
He is in truth the Ordainer of whatsoever He pleaseth.
He, verily, exerciseth His authority in whatsoever He willeth.
His command is irrevocable in whatsoever He pleaseth.
He, verily, ordaineth whatsoever He chooseth to ordain.

source: و بعد القآء کلمة الله علی الممکنات من سمع و اجاب انّه من اعلی الخلق ولو یکون من الّذین یحملون الرّماد.
reference: When the Word of God is revealed unto all created things whoso then giveth ear and heedeth the Call is, indeed, reckoned among the most distinguished souls, though he be a carrier of ashes.
hyps: And when He cast His Word among all created things whoso heard it and obeyed its behests was verily reckoned amongst the most honored in God's estimation, though he be one who beareth ashes on his back.
And when the Word of God was revealed unto all created things, he that giveth ear and obeyeth thereunto is accounted as one of the most exalted amongst men, though he be but a carrier of ashes.

And when He uttered the Word of God unto all created things whoso hearkeneth and respondeth to Him, he indeed is reckoned among the noblest of men, though he be of those that bear the ashes of the dead.

Whoso giveth ear unto the Word of God that hath been sent down to all beings, and followeth it, is verily reckoned among the choicest among men, though he be one who carrieth upon his back the dust of men.
and afterwards He revealed His Word unto all created things; and he that giveth ear and heedeth shall, verily, be of the superior strata of creation, though he be one who beareth iniquity.
But whoso giveth ear unto the Word of God, and acteth thereon, he, verily, is reckoned among the highest of God's creatures, though he be one who beareth ashes on his head.
If any one hearken to the Word of God that hath descended upon all created things, and respond thereunto, he, verily, is accounted among the most excellent, though he be a carrier of ashes.
Verily, after God had spoken a word unto men, whoso will hear Him and respond to His Call will be of those who are raised again, though he may have been wrapped in ashes.

source: و من اعرض هو من ادنی العباد ولو یکون عند النّاس ولیّاً و یکون عنده کتب السّموات و الأرضین.
reference: And he who turneth away is accounted as the lowliest of His servants, though he be a ruler amongst men and the possessor of all the books that are in the heavens and on earth.
hyps: If he turn aside, he shall be numbered with the lowliest of God's creatures, though he be a viceroy amongst mankind and all the books that are in heaven and on earth be at his command.
And he that turneth aside is accounted amongst the lowliest of His servants, though he be regarded among men as a prince who holdeth in his possession the books of earth and heaven.
And he that turneth aside is reckoned with the lowliest of servants, though he be a prince and possess all the books that are in heaven and on earth.
And if he turn away, he is of those lowest among men, though he be invested by the people with power and be possessed of all the books that are in the heavens and on earth.

Should anyone turn aside from Him, though he be but a lowly servant, and though he may be a prince amongst men, and the possessor of all the books that are in heaven and on earth, it shall avail him not.
Whoso turneth aside from Thee, though he be the abasest among Thy servants, shall be reckoned in Thy sight with him whose books are all the things that are in the heavens and on earth.

And he who turneth away from them, though it be but for one moment, shall be regarded as the lowliest of My servants, though he should be invested with the highest earthly authority, and possess all the books that are in heaven and on earth.
Whoso turneth away from Me is accounted among My servants, be he ever so high in degree, be his authority great among men and his books as numerous as those in heaven and on earth.

source: فانظر بعین الله فیما نزّلناه لک و ارسلناه الیک و لا تنظر الی الخلق و ما عندهم.
reference: It behooveth thee to look with divine insight upon the things We have revealed and sent unto thee and not towards the people and that which is current amongst them.
hyps: Consider what We have revealed unto thee and sent unto thy hands, and behold not the creatures and the things current amongst them.
Look thou upon what We have revealed for thee and entrusted unto thee, and turn away thine eyes from the people and the things they possess.

Gird up the loins of thine understanding, and, with thine eyes fixed upon Him Who is the Object of our adoration, scrutinize that which We have revealed for thee, and sent unto thee, and gaze not on the people nor on their possessions.
Regard, then, that which We have revealed for thee and sent unto thee, and turn away thine eyes from the people and all that they possess.
See with the eye of God that which He hath sent down unto thee, and revealed unto thee, and regard not the peoples of the world and all that they possess.

Look at whatever We have revealed to thee, that hath been sent down unto thee through Our Messengers, and gaze upon that which We have caused to be carried unto thee, and set thine eyes on naught else except God, the Creator of all things, and the Lord of all mankind.
Look thou with the eyes of God at what We have sent down for thee, and bestowed upon thee, and gaze not on the people and that which they possess.
Look thou, then, with the eye of God at that which We have sent down for thee, and commissioned Our Messengers to deliver unto thee, and turn not aside to the creatures and the things they possess.

source: و انّ مثلهم الیوم کمثل عمیّ یمشی فی ظلّ الشّمس و یسأل ما هی و هل هی اشرقت ینفی و ینکر و لا یکون من المستشعرین.
reference: They are in this day like unto a blind man who, while moving in the sunshine, demandeth: Where is the sun Is it shining He would deny and dispute the truth, and would not be of them that perceive.
hyps: Indeed they resemble one who is blind, walking in the sunshine, asking what it is, and whether it hath arisen or not, repudiating and denying, and failing to perceive.

Indeed they are like unto a blind man who roveeth about in the sunshine calling it darkness, asserting that no light hath ever dawned upon it, who strays and wanders without being aware of the reality.

They are indeed, in this day, like unto one who is blind, who striveth to walk in the sunshine, and asketh what the Sun is, whether it hath arisen or not. This blind man will, assuredly, repudiate and deny the truth of that which his eyes refuse to recognize.
Indeed they resemble, in this day, a blind man who roveth about under the sun, questioning whether it existeth at all, or hath shone forth or not.
Indeed they be likened unto this blind man that walketh in the sunshine, asking himself whether the Sun shineth, repudiating the truth, denying it and not being of those who perceive.
Their condition is such that they are as a blind man who walks in broad daylight but still claims to be groping his way in darkness, and denieth that the sun has ever shone.

Indeed they are today like unto a blind man who straggleth on, in the sunshine, in utter ignorance, seeking to know what the sun is, or whether it hath appeared, denying and doubting all the while, and failing to apprehend the truth.

They who reject Our Message have truly been compared to him that walketh in the sunshine, and asketh: Where is the Sun and hath it arisen? They will repudiate the Truth and refuse to acknowledge its glory, and shall remain of those who understand not.

source: لن یعرف الشّمس و لن یعرف ما حال بینه و بینها.
reference: Never shall he be able to discern the sun or to understand that which hath intervened between him and it.
hyps: Neither will he be able to discern the Sun nor to apprehend the thing which hath come in between them.
He will neither see the Sun, nor understand what hath come between Him and the Sun.
Neither will he be able to tell either whether it will ever return, or what hath come between him and the sun.
He shall be powerless to discern its light, nor know what hath come in between him and it.
How can anyone perceive the light when he is deprived of sight or imagine what could have intervened between him and it.
He shall never know what hath happened between him and it.
He will never be able to discern its radiance nor know what hath intervened between Him and it.
This people will never perceive the sun, nor discover what hath come in between him and it.

source: و یصیح فی نفسه و یعترض و یکون من المعرضین.
reference: He would object within himself, voice protests, and would be among the rebellious.
hyps: It will cause him to exclaim within himself, to question its veracity and to denounce it as untrue.
Thereupon he would raise an outcry within himself, object to it, and join the rebellious.
He shall cry out within himself, shall dispute, and be of them that have gone astray.
He will protest in his heart, refuse to accept it and be reckoned with the froward.
Such an one would be filled with anguish, would voice his protest and be numbered with the froward.
He will raise up within himself objections, he will protest, and be accounted among the froward.
and should object to it within himself, and repudiate this truth and be reckoned among such as have turned aside.
It maketh him to burst forth in anger within himself, and to protest against Him, and to be of such as have repudiated His truth.

source: هذا شأن هذا الخلق.
reference: Such is the state of this people.
hyps: Such is the state of this people.
Such is the state of this people.
Such is the conduct of this people.
This is its state.
Such is the plight of this people.
This, indeed, is the condition of this people.
Such is the state of this people.
Such is the state of this people.

source: دعهم بأنفسهم و قل لکم ما اردتم.
reference: Leave them unto themselves, saying: Unto you be that which ye desire
hyps: Leave them unto themselves and proclaim ye that which ye desire.
Let them be unto themselves, and ye proclaim that which ye desire.
Leave them unto themselves, and declare unto them that which ye desire.
Leave them unto themselves, and say: Unto you befit that which ye desire.
Abandon them unto themselves and say to yourselves what ye desire.
Leave them unto themselves, and say to them that which ye have desired.
Let them alone unto themselves, but say ye to yourselves what ye will.
Leave them unto themselves, and say: Unto you be what ye desire.

source: و لنا ما نرید فسحقاً للقوم المشرکین.
reference: and unto us that which we desire. Wretched indeed is the plight of the ungodly.
hyps: and for us what we desire.
and to Us is assigned what We desire, verily for people that join partners with God.
and for Us is whatsoever We desire.
And unto Us shall be given whatsoever We wish. truly this is for the faithless.
And for us is what We desire—indeed to the ungodly is this true.
We have Our own abode, and this indeed We wish for the perverse.
and unto us what We desire, truly for the infidels.
and unto us shall be that which we desire, verily for the ungodly people.

source: ثمّ اعلم بأنّ ظهور القبل حکم العود و الحیوة علی الأرواح فی یوم القیامة ولو انّ لکلّ شیء عود و رجع.
reference: Know thou moreover that the former Manifestation affirmed that the return and rising of the spirits would occur on the Day of Resurrection, while in truth there is a return and resurrection for every created thing.
hyps: Know thou moreover that the former Manifestation decreed that the return and resurrection should take place on the Day of Resurrection, but this hath reference to the soul of man.
Know thou moreover that the former Revelation enjoined upon every one to recognize, on the Day of Resurrection, that God hath decreed the return and life for the souls of men.

Know thou moreover that the former Revelation hath ordained that when the trumpet shall sound, life shall be breathed into every soul, though it must needs be true for every created thing that there is a return and resumption.
Know thou moreover that the former Revelation laid down that all spirits will be gathered together in the Day of Resurrection, but each thing hath its own return and resurrection.

Know thou moreover that the former Revelation ordained that after death men should live again, and be raised from the dead on the Day of Resurrection, although for every created thing there shall certainly come a time of revival and return.

Know thou moreover that the former Manifestation was in the capacity of Raiser of the spirits and Bestower upon them life on the Day of Resurrection, for all shall return, albeit each according to his own measure.
Know thou moreover that the former Revelation hath decreed the return and resurrection of the souls on the Day of Resurrection, while for everything else there shall be a resurrection and a return.

Know thou moreover that the former Dispensation hath enjoined upon mankind that every soul should return to life on the Day of Resurrection, and be recalled to existence in the unseen world, inasmuch as all things shall have a return and a resurrection.

source: ولکن انّا لا نحبّ بأن نذکر ما لا ذکر فی البیان لئلّا یرفع ضجیج المبغضین.
reference: However We do not wish to mention aught that is not set forth in the Bayán, lest perchance the people of malice raise a great outcry.
hyps: We have no wish to recount herein matters which are not recorded in the Bayán, lest perchance the clamor of the malicious be raised.
We, however, are loath to mention that which is absent from the Bayán, lest a clamor be raised by those who bear enmity towards Us.
We do not desire, however, to recount such tales as have nothing whatever to do with the Bayán, lest We be made the target for the malevolent calumnies of Our adversaries.
However We are loath to mention them, for should We do so the voice of the complainant will be raised.
We, however, do not wish to dwell on matters which are not mentioned in the Bayán, lest We awaken the clamor of Our adversaries.
However We do not wish to dwell on topics which have nothing to do with the Bayán lest there be raised a clamour amongst the enemies of God.
However We do not desire to mention therein that which is not related in the Bayán, lest the people of hatred raise a clamor.
We have no wish, however, to mention here anything that was not recorded in the Bayán, lest there be raised by the disaffected the clamor of the people who have wronged Us.

source: فیا لیت یرفع ما حال بین النّاس و بارئهم لیشهدوا سلطنة الله و عظمته و یشربوا من معین الکوثر و السّلسبیل و یترشّح علیهم بحور المعانی و یطهّرهم عن رجس کلّ مشرک مریب.
reference: O would that that which interveneth between the children of men and their Creator were dispelled that they might be enabled to behold God's invincible sovereignty and dominion, quaff from the wellspring of His heavenly streams, be sprinkled with the outpourings of the ocean of true understanding and be purged from the defilements of the ungodly and the suspicious.
hyps: O would that the thing which interveneth between the children of men and their Creator were banished from their sight, so that they may perceive the omnipotence of God and behold His grandeur, and may quaff from the wellspring of heavenly streams and fountains, and be sprinkled with showers of divine mysteries, and be cleansed of the stain of every doubting infidel.

Oh that the veil which cloudeth the vision of men were rent asunder, that they might behold the sovereignty of God and His great glory, and drink deep from the wellspring of living waters, and be sprinkled with the showers of heavenly wisdom, and be cleansed of the defilement of every doubt and denial.

I wish that what interveneth between the children of men and their Creator might be removed that they may testify to the sovereignty of God and His majesty, and quaff from the spring of the waters of truth and knowledge, and be sprinkled with the outflowing waters of divine wisdom, and be cleansed from the filthiness of every doubting infidel.

O would that that which interveneth between God and His creatures were dispelled, that men might perceive the Kingdom of God and its greatness, and quaff from the springhead of His manifold grace and wisdom, and be sprinkled with the showers of His wondrous utterance, and be cleansed from all contamination from the defilement of every doubter and denier.

Oh, would that the things which intervene between men and their Creator were removed, that they might witness the power of His Godship and His great glory, drink from the springs of His wellspring and His flowing river, be sprinkled with the waters of the fountain of mysteries and be cleansed of the defilement of every doubter and infidel.

O would that every obstacle interposing itself between the children of men and their Creator were removed, that they might behold His sovereignty and magnificence, drink from the clear and life-giving springs of knowledge and truth, and be sprinkled with the outpourings of the ocean of Divine mysteries and cleansed of the defilement of the doubt of every infidel.

Oh, that interposing barriers be removed between the children of men and their Creator, that they may behold the power and might of God, and quaff from the clear running spring of His heavenly waters, and may be sprinkled with the showers of spiritual meanings, and be cleansed from the taints of doubt and disbelief.

O would that what interveneth between the children of men and their Creator were removed, that they might testify to the sovereignty of God and His greatness, drink of the springs of clear water and soft flowing streams, wash from them the dross of vain conjecture and doubt, and be cleansed from the defilement of the unbeliever and the suspicious.

source: و امّا ما سألت من العوالم.
reference: As to thy question concerning the worlds of God.
hyps: As to thy question concerning the worlds which have existed before this world was created.
And now concerning thy question regarding the worlds beyond this life.
And now concerning thy question regarding the worlds of God.
Thou hast also asked Me regarding the nature of the worlds above the physical world.
As to thy question regarding the state of the denizens of other worlds.
As to thy question regarding the nature of the worlds which lie beyond the earth.
As for thine other question regarding the worlds beyond this world.
Thou hast, furthermore, inquired regarding other worlds beside this world.

source: فاعلم بأنّ لله عوالم لا نهایة بما لا نهایة لها.
reference: Know thou of a truth that the worlds of God are countless in their number, and infinite in their range.
hyps: Know thou that these worlds have no limits, neither do they admit of any termination.
Know thou of a certainty that the worlds of God are infinite, inasmuch as His potentialities are endless.
Know thou of a truth that for every world such as these there are myriad other worlds without end, inasmuch as God's own reality is of infinite greatness.
Know thou that the worlds of God are countless in their number, for they are infinite in their ranges.
Know thou that the worlds of God are as countless as the leaves of the Bible, or the stars of heaven.
Know thou that God hath a knowledge which none can equal, nor unto which any one can attain.
Know thou for a certainty that God hath created a multitude of worlds without end, inasmuch as the potentialities of the worlds of God are limitless.
Know thou that God hath countless worlds without end, because His world itself is immeasurable.

source: و ما احاط بها احد الّا نفسه العلیم الحکیم.
reference: None can reckon or comprehend them except God, the All Knowing, the All Wise.
hyps: and none can be aware thereof except God, the All Knowing, the All Wise.
None can reckon its measure except Him Who is the All Knowing, the All Wise.
None can reckon or comprehend it except God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
None can reckon its possibilities save God, the All Knowing, the All Wise.
None can ever hope to fathom its mysteries except Him Who is the All Knowing, the All Wise.
No one can claim to have fathomed its mysteries, except Him Who is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
Who can claim to have known its limits, save God, the Omniscient, the All-Wise.
None can reckon its worth except God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

source: تفکّر فی النّوم.
reference: Consider thy state when asleep.
hyps: Ponder awhile on sleep.
Consider sleep.
Consider thy sleep.
Consider thy sleep.
Reflect upon sleep.
Consider sleep.
Consider thy sleep.
Consider thy sleep.

source: و انّه آیة الأعظم بین النّاس لو یکوننّ من المتفکّرین.
reference: Verily, I say, this phenomenon is the most mysterious of the signs of God amongst men, were they to ponder it in their hearts.
hyps: This, verily, is God's most mighty sign amidst men, could they but perceive it.
Verily I say, this is the most manifest sign amidst men, did they but ponder it.
Indeed this is the most mighty sign amidst men, did they ponder it.
Were men to ponder its import, it would be recognized as the greatest of signs amongst men.
This thing would be regarded by every man of thought and of insight as the most resplendent sign among men, could he but perceive it.
Surely this is the most great sign amongst men, could they but reflect upon it.
Indeed it is the greatest testimony amongst men should they but ponder it.
This, verily, is the most weighty of all His signs among men, could they but perceive it!

source: مثلاً انّک تری فی نومک امراً فی لیل و تجده بعینه بعد سنة او سنتین او ازید من ذلک او اقلّ.
reference: Behold how the thing which thou hast seen in thy dream is, after a considerable lapse of time, fully realized.
hyps: For instance thou seest in thy dream a personage, and after a lapse of one year, two years, or less or more, thou findest him unchanged in thy waking moments.
Or again thou mayest, while fast asleep, have beheld a certain person in a dream, and found him after one year, or two, or more, to be still the same person, nay, even to be in his original attire.

Consider thyself in thy dream in the night-time. At another time, perhaps after a year, a couple of years, more or less, thou findest thyself in precisely the same condition as the one thou didst see in thine early slumber.
It may be compared to thy dream at night, which thou beholdest again after a year or two years, or more, or less.
For instance, thou hast seen in thy dream a thing in the night, yet when the time cometh for it to happen, it occurreth after a year, or two years, or more, or less.
For instance, thou seest in thy dream a personage at night and meetest him again exactly the same after one, two or several years, and this despite all thy attempts to retain his image in thy mind.

If thou thinkest, for example, of going on a journey one night but find thyself, after a lapse of a year, or two years, or even longer, setting out on a journey at night, it would be wrong to assume that such a postponement implies any change in the original intention.
Consider the dream thou beholdest in thine sleep which, when the time fixed for its fulfillment draweth nigh, thou findest still identical with thy dream.

source: و لو یکون العالم الّذی انت رأیت فیه ما رأیت هذا العالم الّذی تکون فیه فیلزم ما رأیت فی نومک یکون موجوداً فی هذا العالم فی حین الّذی تراه فی النّوم.
reference: Had the world in which thou didst find thyself in thy dream been identical with the world in which thou livest, it would have been necessary for the event occurring in that dream to have transpired in this world at the very moment of its occurrence.
hyps: If that world within which thou didst live in thy dream be identical with this world wherein thou livest now, it would follow that whatever occurred in thine initial vision must have actually transpired in this present world at the very moment when thou hast perceived these events.
If he that liveth during thy dream be identical with him that liveth while awake, it would follow that his dream should occur simultaneously with this life.

If He Who created the world wherein thou dwellest be the same Creator Who hath been Thy Companion during the whole period of thy sleep, it followeth that whatever hath happened to thee during thy slumber must needs have been actually taking place in the physical world during the very instant when thou wert dreaming thereof.

Were the world wherein thou hast been to sleep and dream to be identical with this life, it would follow that he whom thou beholdest in thy dream must needs exist at the very moment thou beholdest Him.

Were the world wherein thou hast experienced this dream to be identical with this present world, it would follow that the dream itself must have taken place within this same world at the very time of its occurrence.

If the world wherein thou beholdest him who hath been thy vision during thy sleep be the same as this world, it followeth that the thing which in thy dream is in thy possession will have existed at the moment of thy waking.
If the world wherein thou didst find thyself be identical with this world, it must needs be true that the vision of thy dream is itself a reality.
If the world wherein thou wert born be identical with the world wherein thou now art, then the dream thou hast dreamed must needs, in its reality, be identical with this waking state.

source: و تکون من الشّاهدین.
reference: Were it so, you yourself would have borne witness unto it.
hyps: Thou shalt be one of His witnesses.
Such a man will be worthy to testify.
Such a person will have borne witness to this truth in his own soul.
This thou hast witnessed.
Then let it be thy witness.
Thou shalt be one of those who have borne witness to His truth.
Such a man would himself be regarded as having witnessed this testimony.
Such a person will be accounted among those who have borne witness.

source: مع انّک تری امراً لم یکن موجوداً فی العالم و یظهر من بعد اذاً حقّق بأنّ عالم الّذی انت رأیت فیه ما رأیت.
reference: This being not the case, however, it must necessarily follow that the world in which thou livest is different and apart from that which thou hast experienced in thy dream.
hyps: It would follow that the reality of which thou hast borne witness must needs be different from the one thou hast known all thy life.

Although thou dost witness to an action which was utterly impossible in thy world, yet when it occurreth, it must necessarily follow that the world in which thou livest hath itself been created in consequence thereof.
How can that which thou hast seen be true unless this world wherein it appeared be itself a creation and not reality.

Inasmuch as thou hast perceived an object which had never before come to thy notice, it becometh thee to conclude that the world wherein thou livest differeth essentially from the realm in which this new object hath appeared.
Though such an assertion be at variance with what thou hast observed, it nevertheless establisheth the truth that the world in which thou livest differeth essentially from the world to come.

Shouldst thou discover that such a state of affairs is impossible under any circumstances whatsoever, this would clearly indicate that the present world order which thou dost inhabit must needs have passed away.

And if thou art aware that such a thing hath never existed, nor been seen before, then thou must, of necessity, admit that the world in which thou livest is but a world of appearances, a world which is not what it seemeth to be.

Inasmuch as thou hast perceived a thing that was non-existent in thy world, it becometh thee to acknowledge that the world in which thou livest is different from that which is referred to in Thy Book.

source: یکون عالماً آخر الّذی لا له اوّل و لا آخر.
reference: This latter world hath neither beginning nor end.
hyps: He is but an exponent of that knowledge whose beginning none knoweth, neither can imagine its end.
It hath its own existence, entirely distinct and apart from all else.
He is God, beyond any beginning or end.
Such a knowledge must needs be endowed with life—a knowledge that hath neither beginning nor end.
This World hath neither beginning nor end.
This latter conception of time hath neither beginning nor end.
It should be known that these two are essentially one, yet each must be regarded separately, for they have neither beginning nor end.
The world of God hath neither beginning nor end.

source: و انّک ان تقول هذا العالم فی نفسک و مطویّ فیها بأمر من لدن عزیز قدیر لحقّ.
reference: It would be true if thou wert to contend that this same world is, as decreed by the All Glorious and Almighty God, within thy proper self and is wrapped up within thee.
hyps: If thou art moved to declare that within this world of being and within thyself lie imbedded, at the bidding of Him Who is the All-Glorious and Almighty, countless other universes, such an assertion would undoubtedly be true.

If anyone assert that the world within thee is, in truth, the same as thyself, and is wrapped up within thee at the bidding of One Who is the Almighty, the Most Powerful, verily such a statement would be correct.
It would be just as valid to maintain that this same world is, according to God's decree and through the potency of His might, created within thyself.

Shouldst thou declare this world to be thy real home and place of abode, and its denizens to have closed themselves up within its walls at the bidding of One Who is the Almighty, the Most Powerful, it would be true.
If thou hast ever believed that this world, as decreed by God, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, is a creation to last for ever, thy belief would have been correct.
And shouldst thou say that this same world is, as decreed by Him Who is the Mighty, the All-Glorious, within thy self and enfoldeth thee, verily this also would be true.
It would also be true to affirm that this same earth, within whose bowels Thou didst exist, was created by Thee through Thy behest of God, the Almighty, the Most Powerful.
It would be true for thee to contend that this world itself is in thy mind, and within thee, subject to thy behest, as decreed by Him Who is the Mighty, the Powerful.

source: و لو تقول بأن الرّوح لا تجرّد عن العلایق فی النّوم سیّره الله فی عالم الّذی یکون مستوراً فی سرّ هذا العالم لحقّ.
reference: It would equally be true to maintain that thy spirit, having transcended the limitations of sleep and having stripped itself of all earthly attachment, hath, by the act of God, been made to traverse a realm which lieth hidden in the innermost reality of this world.
hyps: And if thou wert to assert that in sleep this spirit could be regarded as having transcended its limitations, and hath been made to traverse the unseen world which lieth enshrined within this same world—such a belief would be in consonance with truth.

It would be true if thou wert to maintain that when the soul departs from its body, at the hour of death, its immaterial and spiritual realities may well be compared unto the spirit of God Himself—the Word of God, the Manifestation of His Divine Essence—whom men have never seen, neither do they know the time and manner of His appearance.

Werest thou to claim that, when the spirit leaveth the body at the moment of death, it will continue its existence in a world now hidden within God's secret, such an assertion would be in perfect harmony with the truth.

If thou believest that the soul, having freed itself from all attachments after death, hath been made to traverse a world which lieth hidden in the innermost reality of this world, thou hast truly spoken.
And if you say that the soul of man, upon awaking from sleep, hath been created by God to be detached from all earthly attachment and relationship, this too would be true.

Werest Thou to assert that the soul, after its separation from the body, hath been made to traverse a world which lieth hidden beyond the reach of the physical senses, such a statement would be wholly true.

If thou sayest that man's spirit, having transcended the limitations of this world, hath been caused by God to traverse another world which lieth hid in the innermost reality of this world, thou speakest the truth.

And if it be said that when man sleepeth and his spirit escapeth from its corporeal prison, God surely will permit it to journey through a realm hidden in the innermost reality of this world, this too would be true.

source: و انّ لله عالم بعد عالم و خلق بعد خلق.
reference: Verily I say, the creation of God embraceth worlds besides this world, and creatures apart from these creatures.
hyps: To God belongeth the knowledge of another world, and other creatures.
Know thou that the world of God is not limited to this world, nor is His creation confined to this creation.
Verily God hath created other worlds besides this world, and other peoples besides this people.
By God, there is a world besides this world, and a creation beside this creation.
Indeed God hath created worlds beyond this world, and peoples other than this people.
Verily there is a world beyond this world, and a creation besides the present creation.
By God, there is another world besides this world, another people besides this people.
Know thou for a certainty that there is no limit to God's creation, nor any cessation to His revelation.

source: و قدّر فی کلّ عالم ما لا یحصیه احد الّا نفسه المحصی العلیم.
reference: In each of these worlds He hath ordained things which none can search except Himself, the All Searching, the All Wise.
hyps: And for every world He hath ordained what none except Himself can reckon, nor comprehend, save God, the All Knowing, the Most Wise.
In every Dispensation He hath revealed what no one except Himself can ever conceive, let alone apprehend.
Unto each and every one of these worlds hath He revealed a mystery which none can unravel save its own Self, Him Who is the Resurrection, the All-Wise.
To each one He hath assigned a different station, a station which naught except His own Self can ever reckon or comprehend.
He hath ordained for every world what none can reckon except Himself, the All-Perceiving, the All-Wise.
In each of these worlds He hath ordained things which none can reckon save Him, Who is the Reckoner, the All-Knowing.
And in every world He hath decreed what none except His own Self, the Omnipotent Protector, the All Knowing can reckon.

In each of these Realms He hath preordained what none can unravel except Himself, Who is the One that comprehendeth all things, Whose knowledge embraceth all things, and His glory shall endure forever.

source: و انّک فکّر فیما القیناک لتعرف مراد الله ربّک و ربّ العالمین.
reference: Do thou meditate on that which We have revealed unto thee, that thou mayest discover the purpose of God, thy Lord, and the Lord of all worlds.
hyps: Ponder the things We have revealed unto thee that thou mayest perceive the purpose of God, thy Lord, and the Lord of all worlds.
Reflect upon that which We have sent down unto thee, that thou mayest grasp the intent of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.
Meditate upon that which We have revealed unto thee, that thou mayest apprehend God's purpose for thy Lord and the Lord of all worlds.
Do thou meditate upon that which We have imparted unto thee, that thou mayest understand the purpose of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.
Reflect, therefore, upon that which We have revealed unto thee, that thou mayest discover the purpose of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.
Meditate upon that which We have revealed unto thee that thou mayest discern the purpose of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.
Ponder what We have revealed unto thee, that thou mayest perceive the intent of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.
Reflect, then, upon that which We have revealed unto thee, that thou mayest understand the purpose of God, thy Lord, the Lord of all worlds.

source: و فیه کنز اسرار الحکمة.
reference: In these words the mysteries of Divine Wisdom have been treasured.
hyps: In it lies hidden the treasure of divine wisdom.
In this book are treasured the mysteries of Divine Wisdom.
It containeth the treasures of divine mysteries.
In it is enshrined the secret wisdom.
In it is enshrined the mystery of the soul of man.
In it is contained the secret essence of divine wisdom.
In it were treasured the secrets of divine wisdom.
In it lies hidden the treasure of My wisdom.

source: و انّا ما فصّلناه لحزن الّذی احاطنی من الّذین خلقوا بقولی ان انتم من السّامعین.
reference: We have refrained from dwelling upon this theme owing to the sorrow that hath encompassed Us from the actions of them that have been created through Our words, if ye be of them that will hearken unto Our Voice.
hyps: We have refrained from giving further details by reason of the anguish which hath afflicted Us at the attitude of those who have been born of Mine utterance, if ye be of them that hearken unto My Voice.

We have refrained to lay bare the inner workings of our Pen of Glory for We were weighed down by the woes which We have suffered at the hands of those who, through Our Word, were created, if ye be of them that hearken unto Our voice.

We have refrained from expanding on this theme because of Our deep sadness that hath overwhelmed Us at the conduct of those who have been created through Our words if ye be of them that hearken unto Our Voice.
and yet We have refrained from dwelling upon it because of Our grief which hath seized Us at the state of those who were created through Our word—were ye to hearken.
And We have failed to expand thereon because the grief which hath seized Me from those who were begotten through My Word have encompassed Me, if ye be of them that hearken.
We did not lay it out in detail, for My sorrow that hath encompassed Me from those who have been created through My words hath reached your hearts, did ye but know it.

We have refrained from dwelling upon this theme because We are saddened by the thoughts that are instilled into the hearts of those who, as ordained by God, were created through a word of His mouth, if ye be of them that hearken unto His voice.

This We have not developed in detail, for We are filled with anguish at the complaints which surround Us from all sides, voiced by those who have been created through Our word, if ye be of those that hearken to My voice.

source: فهل من ناصر ینصرنی و یدفع عنّی سیوف هؤلآء المعرضین..
reference: Where is the one who can help Me and shield Me from the swords of these faithless souls
hyps: Who is there that will aid Me and protect Me from the swords of these froward souls
Where is he to be found who will assist Me and shield Me from the swords of these froward ones...
Is there to be found any helper who will come to My aid, and defend Me against the swords of these faithless ones.
is there anyone to help Me and shield Me against the swords of these froward ones
who is there to help me and defend me against the swords of these rebellious people..
Who is there to be My helper and protect Me against the swords of these froward hearts
Where is he to be found who will aid Me and protect Me from these swords that threaten Me on every side
Who, then, is there to help Me and protect Me from the swords of these rebellious ones.

source: و هل من ذی بصر ینظر کلمات الله ببصره و ینقطع عن نظر الخلایق اجمعین
reference: Where is the man of insight who will behold the Words of God with his own eyes and rid himself of the opinions and notions of the peoples of the earth
hyps: Wherethere be any endued with perception who regardeth the Words of God with his own eyes, or riddeth himself of the vision of all men?
Where is he to be found with vision clear To read the words of God and rid his mind Of every man's imaginings
is there any man of insight who will read the Words of God with his eyes and detach himself from the observation of all men,
Where is he to be found endued with insight who perceiveth the Word of God with his own eyes and rids himself of the opinions of all men.
is there among men any man of insight capable of regarding the Words of God with the eye of discernment, and entirely disregarding the opinions of mankind?
is there any man endued with discernment who can behold the words of God with his own eyes and detach himself from the opinions of men
Or is there to be found any man of insight who would behold the Word of God with his own eyes, and divest himself of the opinions of mankind?
Where can we find a man endued with keen insight who will perceive the Word of God with his own eyes, who is detached from the opinions of men?

source: نبّئ عباد الله بأن لا ینکروا ما لا یعقلوه.
reference: Warn thou the servants of God not to reject that which they do not comprehend.
hyps: Warn thou the people of God not to repudiate what they do not comprehend.
Tell, then, His servants not to reject that which they cannot comprehend.
Warn thou the servants of God against rejecting that which they do not comprehend.
Tell out unto His servants the Lord to disbelieve whatsoever they understand not.
Warn thou the servants of God against denying what they understand not.
Warn thou the people of God not to repudiate what they fail to comprehend.
Warn men not to repudiate that which they fail to understand.
Warn thou men not to repudiate things of which they cannot comprehend the reality.

source: قل فاسألوا الله بأن یفتح علی قلوبکم ابواب المعانی لتعرفوا ما لا عرفه احد.
reference: Say, implore God to open to your hearts the portals of true understanding that ye may be apprised of that of which no one is apprised.
hyps: Say, entreat God to grant that He may open unto your hearts the door of true understanding, so that ye may be made aware of that of which none is aware.
Say: Beg God then to unlock for your hearts the portals of true understanding that ye may apprehend that which none can apprehend.
Say: Ask ye God to open unto your hearts the portals of divine mysteries that ye may know that which none hath known.
Say: Pray ye that God will open to your hearts the gates of mysteries, that ye may be apprised of that which none hath known.
Say: Implore God to open to your hearts the doors of true understanding, that ye may apprehend what none hath apprehended.
Say: Beseech God to open, through His grace, the doors of divine wisdom that ye may know what none hath known.
Say, implore God to open to your hearts the portals of divine mysteries, that ye may know what none hath known.
Say, implore God that He will open unto your hearts the portals of understanding, that ye may comprehend what none hath comprehended.

source: و انّه لهو المعطی الغفور الرّحیم.
reference: Verily, He is the Giver, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.
hyps: He, verily, is the Great Giver, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
He, verily, is the All-Bounteous, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
He, verily, is the Beneficent, the Pardoner, the Compassionate.
He is, verily, the Great Giver, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
He, verily, is the Great Giver, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
He, verily, is the Great Giver, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.
He, verily, is the Great Giver, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.
He, verily, is the Beneficent, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

source: و امّا ما سألت فی اوامر الله.
reference: Thou hast moreover asked Me concerning the ordinances of God.
hyps: Thou hast also inquired about the laws and ordinances of God.
Thou hast, moreover, asked Me concerning the ordinances of God.
And now regarding thy question about the ordinances of God.
And now concerning thy question regarding the ordinances of God.
And now concerning thy question about the laws and ordinances of God.
And now concerning thy question regarding the laws and ordinances of God.
Thou hast, moreover, asked Me concerning the ordinances of God.
Now as for thy question regarding the ordinances of God.

source: فاعلم بأنّ کلّ ما حدّد فی الکتاب حقّ لا ریب فیه و علی الکلّ فرض بأن یعملوا بما نزل من لدن منزل علیم.
reference: Know thou of a truth that whatsoever hath been prescribed in the Book is indeed the truth, no doubt is there about it, and it is incumbent upon everyone to observe that which hath been sent down by Him Who is the Revealer, the All Knowing.
hyps: Know thou assuredly that whatever hath been prescribed in Our Book is indeed the truth, no doubt is there about it, and unto all a duty hath been enjoined to observe that which hath been sent down by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou of a truth that whatever hath been laid down in the Book is verily the truth and no doubt is there about it, and upon all is imposed the duty to observe that which hath come down from Him Who is the Revealer, the All Knowing.

Know thou that whatsoever hath been prescribed in the Book is the truth, no doubt is there about it, and upon everyone is imposed the obligation of observing that which hath been sent down by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou that whatever hath been prescribed in the Book is, verily, the truth, no doubt is there about it, and unto all it is incumbent to observe that which hath come down from Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou that whatsoever hath been fixed in the Book is irrevocable and there can be no doubt thereof and it behooveth everyone to observe that which hath been sent down by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou that whatsoever hath been prescribed in the Book is indeed truth, there can be no doubt thereof, and it is incumbent upon everyone to observe that which hath been sent down by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou that whatsoever hath been prescribed in the Book is the truth, no doubt is there about it, and it is incumbent upon everyone to observe whatever hath been revealed by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

Know thou of a truth that whatever hath been clearly enjoined in Our Book is verily irrevocable and beyond any doubt. It is incumbent upon all to hold fast that which hath been revealed by Him Who is the Revealer, the All-Knowing.

source: و من یترکه بعد علمه به انّ الله بریء عنه و نحن برآء منه لأنّ اثمار الشّجرة هی اوامره و لن یتجاوز عنه الّا کلّ غافل بعید.
reference: Were a man to put them away despite his being aware thereof, God would truly be clear of such a one and We too would be clear of him, inasmuch as His ordinances constitute the fruits of the divine Tree and none other than the heedless and the wayward will deviate therefrom.
hyps: Were anyone to disregard them after he had become aware thereof, God would certainly have dissociated Himself from him, and likewise We would have dissociated Ourself from such a person.

And if any one follow him, although aware that it is God Who is Free from such vices, this is because he himself is a sinner, and God is not his protector, since these actions form the fruits of the tree of His Revelation, and no one can transgress therefrom except those who are heedless, and who have strayed far from the Path of God.

Whoso abandoneth Him after having recognized Him, verily God hath purged him therefrom, and We too have purged Ourself from him; for the fruit of the tree is His commandment, and none shall deviate therefrom except him that hath been heedless and is far from Him.

Should anyone abandon Him when He hath clearly recognized Him, such a one shall be regarded as a man who hath made a clean breast of it as to God, for We too shall have nothing to say.
