For the fruits of the Tree are His ordinances, while all that deviates therefrom is naught but the action of one who erreth far away from God.

And should anyone depart therefrom, knowing this, God would truly be clear of him and likewise We clear. For His commandments constitute the fruits of the tree and none but the heedless that have gone astray can ever deviate therefrom.

Were he to desert it after having become aware thereof, he verily would be absolved of his duty towards God, and we likewise shall be absolved from our duty towards him, inasmuch as the fruits of the tree are His commands which none is permitted to exceed save him who hath strayed far from God and who is heedless of this truth.

Should anyone after having known this abandon Him, God will, verily, be clear of him and We too, shall be clear of him, for His Commandments constitute the fruits of the tree and none but the heedless and foolish can transgress therefrom.

And should anyone desert His truth after it hath been revealed to him, God will assuredly be free from his obligations towards him, and We shall likewise be free from that which he desireth; for His commandments constitute the fruits of this Tree, while none other than such as have strayed far from Him will depart therefrom.

source: و امّا الجنّة حقّ لا ریب فیه و هی الیوم فی هذا العالم حبّی و رضائی.
reference: As to Paradise: It is a reality and there can be no doubt about it, and now in this world it is realized through love of Me and My good pleasure.
hyps: As for Paradise, this is its meaning in the world of reality, that is to say, to love Me, and abide in My good pleasure.
As to Paradise, it is verily the truth, nor is there any doubt thereof, and it is in this life, in this world, through My love and My good pleasure.
As to Paradise, it is true and there is no doubt about it, and it is to be found today on this earth through love of Me and My good pleasure.
Hell hath indeed been true and certain. As to Paradise, it is the truth, and no doubt is there about it, and now it hath come to pass in this world through My love and good pleasure.
As to Paradise, it is verily the truth, no doubt is there about it: it existeth at present, in this world, through My love for you, and My good pleasure.
However Paradise is indeed a reality and there is no doubt about it. It is manifested in this world through My love and My good pleasure.
However, Paradise is real and cannot be doubted; it is, in this Day, to be found in My love and My good-pleasure.
And Paradise is the truth, no doubt is there about it, and it is now in this world the love and good pleasure of My Will.

source: و من فاز به لینصره الله فی الدّنیا و بعد الموت یدخله فی جنّة عرضها کعرض السّموات و الأرض.
reference: Whosoever attaineth unto it God will aid him in this world below, and after death He will enable him to gain admittance into Paradise whose vastness is as that of heaven and earth.
hyps: Whosoever attaineth unto it God will assist him in the world to come after death He will cause him to enter into Paradise whose extent is as that of heaven and earth.
Whosoever attaining thereunto be assisted by God in this world, and after death he shall enter into Paradise whose area is as that of heaven and earth.
Whoso attaineth to this knowledge shall be aided by God in this world, and after death shall be led unto Paradise whose breadth is as that of heaven and earth.
And he who attains unto it shall be helped by God in this world, and after death shall be admitted into Paradise whose expanse is as that of heaven and earth.
Whoso attaineth it God will aid him in this world, and after death He will cause him to gain admittance into Paradise whose vastness shall equal that of heaven and earth.
Whoso attaineth unto this station God will aid him in this world, and after death he will enter a garden whose width is that of heaven and earth.
Whoso attaineth thereunto shall be aided by God in this world, and after death he will enter Paradise whose extent is as that of heaven and earth.
Whosoever reacheth this station God shall assist him on earth, and after death He shall cause him to enter Paradise whose expanse is as that of heaven and earth.

source: و یخدمنّه حوریّات العزّ و التّقدیس فی کلّ بکور و اصیل و یستشرق علیه فی کلّ حین شمس جمال ربّه و یستضیء منها علی شأن لن یقدر احد ان ینظر الیه.
reference: Therein the Maids of glory and holiness will wait upon him in the daytime and in the night season, while the daystar of the unfading beauty of his Lord will at all times shed its radiance upon him and he will shine so brightly that no one shall bear to gaze at him.
hyps: The maids of holiness and glory shall serve him, at even and at morn, and the Daystar of the beauty of his Lord shall continually shed its radiance upon him, and he shall shine so brightly that none will be able to gaze upon him.

And fairies of glory and holiness shall attend him at even and at morn, and the radiance of the beauty of his Lord shall continually shine over him, and he shall shine so brightly that no man can look upon him.

In every morn and eventide hour these maids of celestial glory will serve him, and the radiance of the countenance of his Lord will everlastingly shine upon him, and he will be so illumined thereby that none shall endure to gaze on him.

Maids of honor shall wait on him, and at eventide and at dawn they shall minister unto him, and at every moment of his life the Daystar of the Beauty of his Lord shall shine upon him, and through that radiance he will be so illumined that no man will be able to gaze upon him.

In the morning and in the evening He would be waited upon by maidens of incomparable beauty, whilst every instant of His life would be illumined with the light of the beauteous Face of His Lord, and His brightness would so dazzle men's eyes that none could look at Him.

Such a man will be attended, at all times and under all conditions, by maids of holiness and honor, and will shine, at every moment, like the daystar of the beauty of his Lord, with such brightness that none can look on him.

Verily, his maids of glory and holiness will wait upon him day and night, whilst, on every side, the Daystar of the beauty of his Lord sheddeth its radiance upon him, and from this radiance he gloweth so intensely that none can look at him.

and they should serve him in all times and under all conditions. Maidens of splendor and sanctity should, each day and night, be waiting at his door, and the beauty of his Lord should continually shine forth upon him, and he should shine with such brightness that none can bear to look on him.

source: کذلک کان الأمر ولکنّ النّاس هم فی حجاب عظیم.
reference: Such is the dispensation of Providence, yet the people are shut out by a grievous veil.
hyps: Such is God's decree, but the people have drawn around themselves a grievous veil.
Such is God's decree, yet men wear a grievous veil before their eyes.
Thus hath it been decreed, yet the peoples of the world are shut out by a grievous veil from this Revelation.
Such is God's decree, yet most men have shut themselves out from Him behind an impenetrable veil.
Thus hath it been decreed, but most people are indeed wrapt in a thick veil.
Such is God's decree, yet the peoples are wrapped in a grievous veil.
Such is God's decree. yet mankind is wrapped in a grievous veil.
Thus hath it been decreed, yet men have shut themselves out from this light.

source: و کذلک فاعرف النّار و کن من الموقنین.
reference: Likewise apprehend thou the nature of hell fire and be of them that truly believe.
hyps: In like manner, apprehend thou the nature of Hell-Fire, and be of them that truly believe.
Likewise apprehend thou the nature of hell-fire, and be of them that truly believe.
Likewise apprehend thou the nature of hell-fire, and be thou of them that believe with certainty.
Likewise appreciate thou the fire and be of them who truly believe.
So understand thou its nature, and be of them that truly believe.
Likewise acquaint thyself with hell-fire, and be thou of them that truly believe.
Likewise recognize thou the Fire of God, and be thou of them that truly believe.
Likewise apprehend thou the nature of hell fire and be thou well assured thereabout.

source: و لکلّ عمل جزآء عند ربّک و یشهد بذلک نفس امر الله و نهیه.
reference: For every act performed there shall be a recompense according to the estimate of God, and unto this the very ordinances and prohibitions prescribed by the Almighty amply bear witness.
hyps: Know thou that for every action committed by man there is recompense from thy Lord.
For every act of theirs a recompense is provided by their Lord, and this the revelation which their God, the Ordainer, hath uttered can well bear witness.
For every act a recompense shall be given by thy Lord, and this, verily, is testified unto by Him Who is the Ordainer and the Taboo-Drawer.
and unto every deed is a recompense ordained by thy Lord, and this Testimony beareth witness to it.
For every act there shall be a reward according to the judgment of thy Lord, and to this bear witness the commandment and the prohibition of God.
Each act will receive its due reward from thy Lord and unto this beareth witness He Who is the Revealer of God's commandments and prohibitions.
Every action, whether good or bad, will receive its recompense at the hand of thy Lord, and to this beareth witness the same Spirit Who is the Revealer of the commandments and prohibitions of God.
Every action will, verily, receive its recompense with thy Lord; and unto this beareth witness He Who is the Revealer of His own Commandment and Prohibition.

source: و لو لم یکن للأعمال جزآء و ثمر لیکون امره تعالی لغواً.
reference: For surely if deeds were not rewarded and yielded no fruit, then the Cause of God—exalted is He—would prove futile.
hyps: Forasmuch as no fruit or reward could be expected for good works, the Faith of God—exalted be His name—would thus prove vain and purposeless.
And if deeds would bring no reward nor fruit, the Cause of God would be vain.
and if deeds had no recompense nor fruit there would be vain the Cause exalted is He.
If there were no reward for men's deeds, this Revelation would be vain and fruitless.
If deeds have no reward, if there be no harvest following the sowing, then would it all be vain.
Were deeds to have no recompense or reward there would be no point whatever in acting according to His Cause, exalted is He.
And were it not for recompense or reward, deeds would bear no fruit and the Cause of God—exalted be He—would prove vain.
If deeds yield no result and were not rewarded, then it would be vain for man to carry out Gods bidding.

source: فتعالی عن ذلک علوّاً کبیر.
reference: Immeasurably high is He exalted above such blasphemies.
hyps: Far be it, therefore, from Our glory and loftiness.
High is He exalted above such vain imaginings.
Far is He above such things.
Exalted is He above such absurdities.
Exalted is He above such vain imaginings.
How far, how immeasurably, is God exalted above all such vain and idle fancies.
Far is He above such vain imaginings.
Immeasurably high, therefore, must be the exaltation of such an One.

source: ولکنّ المنقطعین لن یشهدنّ العمل الّا نفس الجزآء.
reference: However, unto them that are rid of all attachments a deed is, verily, its own reward.
hyps: As to those who are rid of earthly cares, however, every action will entail its own punishment or reward.
Those that have detached themselves from all except God shall not fear any retribution for their deeds.
They that have rid themselves of all attachment to any one save God will be able, however, to recognize the truth of this statement.
As for the separated ones, to them will be given only that measure of reward which their deeds shall deserve.
They that lead a life detached from earthly things will find it impossible to believe in this principle.
They that have detached themselves from the world of existence are verily accounted in this Cause as naught but their own punishment.
They that have rid themselves of all attachment to anyone but God shall be assured that their good works will everlastingly reward their doers.
The separated however shall know that every act they perform will be its own punishment.

source: و انّا لو نفصّل ذلک ینبغی ان نکتب الواحاً عدید.
reference: Were We to enlarge upon this theme numerous Tablets would need to be written.
hyps: Were We to set forth in detail these things it would be meet and seemly that several Tablets should be devoted to this theme.
Were We to expatiate on this theme, it would befit Us to set down many Tablets.
But were We to set forth these details We would have to write lengthy epistles.
Should We set forth these details, it would behoove Us to write long epistles.
And were We to elucidate this matter more fully, numerous Tablets would need to be written.
If We choose to set forth a detailed exposition of this theme, We would have to write several Tablets.
Should We unfold the details of this theme We must write many Tablets.
Were We to dwell on this theme, it would behoove Us to write many epistles.

source: تالله الحقّ.
reference: I swear by the righteousness of the One true God.
hyps: I swear by God, the True One.
By God, the True One.
To this God, the True One, shall testify.
To this beareth Me witness, I swear by God, the True One!
I swear by God, the True One.
by God, the True One!
By God, the True One.
By God, the True One.

source: انّ القلم لن یحرّک بما ورد علی صاحبه و یبکی و ابکی ثمّ تبکی عین العظمة خلف سرادق الأسمآء علی عرش اسمه العظیم
reference: The Pen is unable to move by reason of that which hath befallen its Lord, and it weepeth sore, and so do I weep, and likewise weepeth the eye of Him Who is the Essence of Grandeur behind the Tabernacle of Names while seated on the Throne of His glorious Name.
hyps: My Pen, verily, can move naught that hath befallen its Lord, while tears stream down My own face, and My tears mingle with the tears which flow from the eye of Him Who is the Incomparable One, behind the tabernacle of Names, upon the throne of His name, the Mighty.

My Pen is moved by what hath befallen Its Lord, and We weep with a great weeping, and so doth the Eye of Him Who is the Manifestation of Glory weep behind the Tabernacle of Names before the throne of His Name, the Most Great.

My pen can move no more at what hath befallen Him Who is its Lord, and it weepeth sore, as We weep, and Weep likewise is the eye of greatness behind the Tabernacle of Names upon the throne of His exalted Name.

My Pen is well-nigh powerless to depict what hath befallen its Lord. it weepeth sore, and so do I weep, and thereafter We all weep, behind the Tabernacle of Names, upon the Throne of His Most Great Name.

The Pen itself is well-nigh motionless by reason of that which hath befallen Him Whose Companion it is, and is moved to weep, as are Mine own eyes, and as are the tears which shed the Eye of Glory behind the Tabernacle of His Names, upon His throne of great glory.
My Pen is moved not by what hath befallen its Lord; it weepeth sore and I also weep, and the eye of God's glory weepeth behind the tabernacle of His names while on the throne of His mighty name.

This Pen, however, shall refuse to move by reason of what hath befallen Its Lord, and shall weep, Weep, and again Weep with the eye of greatness, behind the Tabernacle of His names, upon the Throne of His Name, the Mighty.

My Pen moveth not by reason of what hath befallen Him Who is its Author, but rather doth it weep, and so do I weep, and likewise weepeth the eye of the All-Glorious, which lieth concealed behind the Tabernacle of Names, from His throne that beareth His name, the Mighty.

source: و انّک صفّ قلبک انّا نفجّر منه ینابیع الحکمة و البیان لتنطق بها بین العالمین.
reference: Purge thou thy heart that We may cause fountains of wisdom and utterance to gush out therefrom, thus enabling thee to raise thy voice among all mankind.
hyps: Purify thou thy heart that We may fathom, through it, the ocean of Our wisdom and utterance, that thou mayest speak forth the truth amongst all peoples.
Purify thou thine heart, for We will cause fountains of wisdom and eloquence to flow out of it, that thou mayest unloose thy tongue to proclaim them before all men.
Purge out thy heart that We may spring from it fountains of wisdom and utterance with which thou wilt be enabled to declare thy faith unto all mankind.
Purge thou thy heart that We may cause springs of wisdom and of eloquence to gush out therefrom so that thou mayest speak forth with great eloquence before all mankind.
Purge thou thy heart, for We will cause fountains of wisdom and eloquence to gush therefrom, that thou mayest speak forthwith unto all peoples.
Purify thou thy heart, that We may cause fountains of wisdom and utterance to gush forth therefrom, that thou mayest cry out with this voice before the face of the world.
Purge thou thy heart that We may cause fountains of wisdom and utterance to gush out therefrom so that thou mayest unloose thy tongue amongst mankind.
Purge thou the corruption out of thy heart that we may cause fountains of wisdom and of utterance to gush therefrom, and enable thee to speak forth with all the people of the world hearing.

source: ان افتح اللّسان علی البیان فی ذکر ربّک الرّحمن.
reference: Unloose thy tongue and proclaim the truth for the sake of the remembrance of thy merciful Lord.
hyps: Open thy mouth to utter the words of My praise in glorification of thy Lord, the Most Merciful.
Open then thy tongue to discourse concerning Him Who is the Best-Beloved of thy Lord, the All-Merciful.
Unloose thy tongue to declare unto men the truth concerning Him Who is the Lord, the Most Compassionate, Thy Lord.
Unloose thy tongue, and speak out in His praise, the All-Merciful, Who is thy Lord.
Unloose thy tongue to speak forth in praise of Him Who is the Lord of thy soul and heart.
Unloose thy tongue to speak forth for Him that will make known the truth of the words of Him Who is the Lord of all lords, the All-Merciful.
Unloose thy tongue and speak forth in praise of Him Who is the Lord of thy being, the Compassionate, the Beneficent.
Unloose thy tongue and speak forth to elucidate the Cause of thy Lord, the Most Merciful.

source: و لا تخف من احد فتوکّل علی الله العزیز الحکیم.
reference: Be not afraid of anyone, place thy whole trust in God, the Almighty, the All Knowing.
hyps: Be thou not afraid of anyone, put thy trust in God, the Omnipotent, the All-Wise.
Fear not anyone and put thy confidence in God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fear not any one except God, the Mighty, the Wise.
Fear naught save God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fear Thou no one but God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fear no one but God, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fear no one, however, except God, the All-Powerful, the All-Wise.
Fear naught except God, and rely on God, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

source: قل یا قوم ان اعملوا ما عرفتم فی البیان الفارسی و ما لا عرفتموه فاسألوا من هذا الذّکر الحکیم لیبیّن لکم ما اراد الله فی کتابه و انّ عنده ما کنز فی البیان من لدن مقتدر قدیر.
reference: Say, O people, fulfill whatever ye understand of the Persian Bayán and whatever ye understand not ask this unerring Remembrance that He may set forth clearly that which God hath intended in His Book, for in truth He knoweth that which is enshrined in the Bayán by virtue of the Will of Him Who is the Omnipotent, the Powerful.
hyps: Say: Observe your conduct after what ye understand in the Persian Bayán, and ask this wise Remembrance concerning that wherein ye are deficient, that He may expound to you that which God hath desired in His Book, for in Him are contained the things concealed in the Persian Bayán, at the bidding of One Who is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

Say: O people! Act ye according to that which ye understand of the Persian Bayán. as for that which ye understand not, ask it of this Reminder, that He may interpret for you that which God hath willed in His Book, and verily in Him is all that which hath been deposited in the Persian Bayán by Him Who is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

Say: Do what ye understand of the Persian Bayán, and as to that which ye understand not, ask from this all-wise Reminder, that He may clearly set forth for you what God hath ordained in His Book, and lo! in Him are preserved things of the Bayán which have come down from One Who is powerful and mighty.

Say, O people, observe ye that which ye understand in the Persian Bayán and ask ye of this Wise Mention what ye understand not, so that He may make clear unto you that which God hath purposed in His Book, and verily He possesseth the Treasure in the Persian Bayán, vouchsafed unto Him by Him Who is the Potent, the Powerful.

Say, O people, perform that which ye understand of the Persian Bayán, and what ye understand not ask this allusion, that He may set forth clearly for you that which God hath purposed in His Book, for in truth He holdeth within Himself whatsoever lay hid in the Bayán, as decreed by Him Who is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

Say: "Act ye according to that which ye understand of the Persian Bayán, and whatsoever ye fail to comprehend ask this All-Wise Recital, that He may explain unto you what God hath willed in His Book, for He is acquainted with all that is enshrined in the Bayán, by virtue of God's power and might."

Say: 'O people! Do ye practice that which ye understand of the Persian Bayán, and ask this all-wise Reminder to explain to you that which ye understand not in the Book of God, for He possesseth within Himself what hath been treasured up by Him Who is the Omnipotent, the Powerful, in this Bayán.

Say: O people, act ye according to what ye have comprehended in His Persian Bayán, and whatever ye fail to grasp ask Him Who is the Source of wisdom for He will clearly set forth for you that which God hath purposed in His Book and verily within Him is treasured all that hath been recorded in the Bayán at the behest of Him Who is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

source: و امّا ما سألت فیما اخبرنا العباد حین الخروج من العراق فی انّ الشّمس اذا غابت تتحرّک طیور اللّیل و ترفع رایات السّامریّ.
reference: Thou hast inquired about the warning We gave to the people at the time of Our departure from 'Iráq to the effect that when the Sun disappeareth from sight, birds of darkness will be in motion and the standards of Samírí will be reared high.
hyps: As to thine inquiry regarding the statement We made when leaving 'Iráq to the effect that 'When the sun shall be eclipsed, the birds of the night will stir, and the Standard of Samír will be uplifted,'

As to thy question concerning the announcement We made, at the time We departed from 'Iráq, unto Our servants that when the Sun hath set the birds of the night will fly, and the standards of Samírí will be unfurled.

As to thy question regarding the passage We revealed concerning the appearance of certain signs after sunset, at the time of Our departure from 'Iráq—verily, We shall raise up the standard of the Samírus when the Sun hath set, that night birds may stir in the sky—is intended as an allusion to the events following upon Our arrival in this Holy Land.

Concerning thy question whether the disappearance of the Sun portends the approach of night or the appearance of birds or the hoisting of the Samaritan standard— We have revealed unto men that when thou leavest Tihrán thou wilt witness the disappearance of the Sun, and the birds will be seen to fly in the air, and the standard to be hoisted—know of a truth, this is Our guidance and wisdom, and neither should thou follow the ignorant who question Our signs.

Thou hast asked Us to clarify that which Thou didst reveal unto Thy servants at the time of Our departure from Tihrán concerning the birds that appear when the sun setteth and the ensigns of the Samírí will be raised.

As to thy question regarding Our statement concerning the bird of night, and the ensigns of Samírí which were revealed at the time of Our departure from 'Iráq: When the sun hath set, the birds of night will fly out, and the Samírí ensigns will be unfurled.
And now concerning thy question regarding Our statement that when the Sun ceaseth to shine, the Birds of Night will take flight and the Standards of Samíriyy will be unfurled.

Concerning thy question regarding Our statement, at the time of Our departure out of 'Iráq, that when the Sun disappeareth, birds of the night will be seen flying about, and the standards of Samírí will be lifted up—this referreth to the Day of Judgment, the exact nature of which is inscrutable to men, and the knowledge of which is confined to God, the All-Knowing.

source: قد تحرّکت الطّیور فی تلک الأیّام و نادی السّامریّ.
reference: Those birds have stirred in these days and Samírí hath raised his clamor.
hyps: The birds have stirred up their wings in these days, and Samírí hath raised his clamor.
Indeed birds have been stirring in those days, and Samírí hath raised his clamor.
In those days birds have moved about, and the Samírí hath uttered his cry.
In these days birds have been stirring, and the Samírí is heard calling.
In these days birds have been stirring, and the Samírí is voicing His clamor.
Verily, birds have been stirred up in these days, and the Samírí hath raised his clamor.
Verily, birds have stirred up their wings, and Samírí hath lifted up his voice.
Birds have been stirring in those days, and Samírí hath raised his clamour.

source: فطوبی لمن عرف و کان من العارفین.
reference: Well is it with him who recognizeth and is numbered with men of understanding.
hyps: Happy is the man that hath recognized Him and been reckoned among such as have acknowledged His glory.
Great indeed is the blessedness awaiting him that apprehendeth this truth and is reckoned among them that have recognized it.
Blessed is he who apprehendeth this truth and is reckoned with them that have recognized it.
Blessed that man who hath recognized this Truth and been reckoned with them that have acknowledged it.
Blessed are those who have recognized this reality, who are endued with understanding and discernment.
Happy, indeed, that one who hath perceived its nature, who hath understood its import.
Blessed is he that hath recognized and been accounted among those who have recognized it.
Blessed is that one who perceiveth this truth and is reckoned among them that understand its signification.

source: ثمّ اخبرناهم بالعجل.
reference: We have also warned them against the appearance of the calf.
hyps: And furthermore We informed him that he had worshipped a calf.
Next We told them of the Ram.
Furthermore We have informed them of the She-Calf.
Then We told them of the Calf.
We also warned them of the Idol.
And further We warned them against the Idol.
We made clear to them the meaning of the calf.
We have also informed them about the calf.

source: کلّ ما اخبرناهم قد ظهر و لا مردّ له الّا بأن یظهر لأنّه جری من اصبع عزّ قدیر.
reference: All Our warnings have come to pass, as indeed, they are bound to, inasmuch as they have issued from the fingers of glory and might.
hyps: Every thing We informed them concerning would be made manifest, and to this there is no denial except that it be realized, inasmuch as it hath flowed out from the fingers of glory and might.
All that We have predicted hath come to pass, and naught can divert its course.
All that We have predicted hath been fulfilled, while its like can be expected from none except Him Who is the Source of strength and power.
Everything We had announced hath proved to be true, and will continue to be fulfilled so long as the stream of glory proceedeth from the fingers of power and might.

Every prediction We have uttered hath been fulfilled, nor can it be gainsaid save by Him Whose Revelation the Pen of God, in its inmost spirit, hath written, inasmuch as the fulfillment thereof is divinely ordained and hath flowed out from the fingers of Glory and Might.
All that We have foretold hath been fulfilled, and none can alter His decree, inasmuch as it hath streamed from the fingers of glory and might.
All We have foretold hath come to pass, and no turning back is possible, for that which is prophesied must needs come to be, since it floweth out of the fingers of glorious power.
All the things We announced unto them have come to pass, and none can withstand them, for they proceed out of the fingers of glory and might.

source: فاشدد ظهرک لنصرة الأمر و لا تلتفت الی ما یخرج من افواه ملإ البیان لأنّهم لا یعرفون شیئاً و ما اطّلعوا بأصل الأمر فی هذا النّبإ الأعظم العظیم
reference: Strengthen thy loins then for the promotion of the Cause and pay no attention unto the words uttered by the people of the Bayán, for they are truly incapable of understanding and have failed to comprehend the essence of the Cause as is revealed in this august, this Most Great Announcement.
hyps: Strengthen thy loins for the promotion of My Cause, and turn not aside from what is said by them that hold the reins of Divine Utterance. they are indeed bereft of understanding and have failed to perceive the true nature of this Most Great Announcement, this supreme Revelation.

Strengthen, then, thy loins to help My Cause, and turn not to what the people of the Bayán may utter, for they truly understand not, and have failed to comprehend the essential purpose of this Most Great, this mighty Announcement.

Fortify, then, thy loins to help My Cause, and turn not heeding to the sayings uttered by the people of the Bayán, for they understand naught, nor have they perceived the essential nature of this most weighty and mighty announcement.

Strengthen, then, thy loins to further His Cause, and pay no attention unto that which the people of the Bayán utter, for they understand naught, and have failed to grasp the essence of this Most Great Announcement, this Most Mighty Revelation.

One of the verses revealed in the Tablet to Nabíl, the denizen of Qá'in is this: Were any man to attain unto the sweetness thereof he would truly apprehend the meaning of assistance.
In the Tablet to Nabíl-i-Aqayni, We revealed this verse: If anyone apprehendeth its significance, he will, verily, discover the meaning of assistance.

source: یا اسمی!
reference: O My Name!
hyps: O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!
O My Name!

source: بیان نفوذ میطلبد.
reference: Utterance must needs possess penetrating power.
hyps: Utterance should be characterized by forcefulness and emphasis.
Speech must be penetrating.
Every utterance must needs be characterized with influence.
Utterance requires clearness and penetrating power.
Utterance should have penetrating power.
The Bayán itself cries out for elucidation.
It must needs possess a power of attraction and magnetic influence.
Utterance must possess penetrating power.

source: چه اگر نافذ نباشد مؤثّر نخواهد بود.
reference: For if bereft of this quality it would fail to exert influence.
hyps: for if bereft of this power it could not exert any influence.
Were it otherwise, it could never succeed in penetrating the soul of man and transforming his character.
Were it not to be diffused through all created things it could have no effect upon them.
For were it unable to exert its influence, it would be unable to effect a change.
For if bereft of this capacity the Word of God could never have achieved its purpose.
If not penetrating, it would prove inefficient.
How can it have any influence if it be not penetrative?
For if they fail to penetrate it, how can they have any effect on that which is concealed within them.

source: و نفوذ ان معلّق بانفاس طیّبه و قلوب صافیه بوده.
reference: And this penetrating influence dependeth on the spirit being pure and the heart stainless.
hyps: And its influence depended upon breathing pure air and having a heart that was not sullied.
Its influence depended upon breathing pure air and beating true hearts.
The very breath with which the Word of God is breathed is sanctified by its contact with Him, and the pure hearts which hear it, partake of its holiness.
The influence of the Word of God must depend on the spirit being pure and the soul being stainless.
It is indeed breathed into it through the breaths of the righteous and is quickened by hearts that are pure.
It is through the power of God's holy Breath that its potency is exerted, and this Breath can be diffused through those who are wholly pure and detached.
Its potency dependeth upon this, that it should be wafted on pure and sanctified breaths, and carried by hearts cleansed from the dust and stains of the world.
Its influence depended on this that they should inhale pure air, and breathe in pure words.

source: و هم‌چنین اعتدال میطلبد چه اگر اعتدال نباشد سامع متحمّل نخواهد شد و در اوّل بر اعراض قیام نماید.
reference: Likewise it needeth moderation, without which the hearer would be unable to bear it, rather he would manifest opposition from the very outset.
hyps: Likewise it needeth temperance, for should this be lacking, he who heard would surely be unable to bear it, and would at first react against him.
So too moderation is needed, for if it be lacking he that will hear will be unable to bear it, and will resist at first;
It needs moderation, because if it be vehement it would overtake the hearer before he can endure it, and would provoke him to rise up and oppose it.
Moderation is likewise essential, for were this lacking, the hearer would find it intolerable, and would at first burst forth in denunciation against Us.
Moderation is also required, for if it be lacking he will neither be able to bear what he hears, nor will his first reaction be one of acceptance.
It must needs also be tempered with moderation, for were it to lack this quality he who heard it would be unable to bear its weight, and would rise up in opposition to it from the very beginning.
The speaker also must exercise moderation, for should his tone be harsh the hearer will find it intolerable, and will refuse even to listen.
Likewise it needeth moderation for were its vehemence excessive the hearer would have no capacity to sustain it, and at first would rebel and reject it.

source: و اعتدال امتزاج بیان است بحکمتهائی که در زبر و الواح نازل شده.
reference: And moderation will be obtained by blending utterance with the tokens of divine wisdom which are recorded in the sacred Books and Tablets.
hyps: And moderation consists in blending utterance with wisdom drawn from that which hath been revealed in the Books and Tablets.
By moderation is meant to mingle ones utterance with those precepts which have been revealed in the Books and Tablets.
By moderation is meant intermixture of words, that they may agree with those which have been revealed in the Book and Tablets.
As to moderation, this referreth to blending ones utterance with words of Wisdom which have been revealed in the Books and Tablets.

The word 'imagination' which He used in His Tablet to the Bábís means here rather the blending of one's own inner understanding with that which the Pen of God hath revealed in its heavenly Scroll and Tablet.
Harmony consisteth in blending together utterances in such wise that they agree with what hath been revealed in the Holy Books and Tablets.
And moderation is blending utterance with those precepts which have been revealed in the Books and Tablets.
Moderation consists in mixing the language with the admonitions revealed in the Books and Tablets.

source: و چون جوهر دارای این دو شیء شد او است جوهر فاعل که علّت و سبب کلّیّه است از برای تقلیب وجود.
reference: Thus when the essence of one's utterance is endowed with these two requisites it will prove highly effective and will be the prime factor in transforming the souls of men.
hyps: This reality when so endowed hath acquired the power to exercise its volition and influence on all that exist, and become the instrument for the transformation of the world of being.
When this substance hath acquired these two attributes it will have become the quintessence of agency, which constitutes for all created things the immediate instrument of change.

When a thing is endowed with these two factors it acquireth the power to produce change in the substance wherein these two factors have been implanted. And such things as are endowed with this faculty constitute the essence of action, which is the effective cause of transformation within all created things.
That which hath been endowed with both these attributes is itself the essence of action, the prime mover, potent and pervasive for the transformation of all beings.
When the essence of this action is combined with faith, that essence itself becomes the quintessence of action and is the primary factor for changing man's condition.
But when this same essence acquired these two qualities it became what may be called the effective quintessence, the potent and transforming agency in the universe.
And when man hath acquired these two qualities he hath become a substance endued with will and power, that which effectually transformeth and realeth the world of existence.
When this soul acquires both these qualities he becomes the essence of action, the prime mover and prime cause that instigates change in the world of existence.

source: و اینست مقام نصرت کلّیّه و غلبهٴ الهیّه.
reference: This is the station of supreme victory and celestial dominion.
hyps: This would constitute universal assistance and celestial triumph.

This is the station which the Almighty hath destined for this Daystar of His Revelation—a station which would establish, once and for all, the ascendancy of God and His power and the complete and undivided victory of this new Cause over all the revealed Religions of the world.
This is the station of complete victory and God's supreme ascendancy.
This is indeed the seat of supreme victory, of God's overruling power.
This is God's all-pervasive victory, His all-conquering power.
Such a man would attain unto the supreme station of universal dominion and victory.
This would be the station of God's Universal victory and triumph.
This is the highest station attainable, and signifies universal victory and divine ascendancy.

source: هر نفسی بآن فائز شد او قادر بر تبلیغ امر الله و غالب بر افئده و عقول عباد خواهد بود.
reference: Whoso attaineth thereto is invested with the power to teach the Cause of God and to prevail over the hearts and minds of men.
hyps: Every man endued with this faculty will be empowered to teach God's Cause, and prevail over the hearts and minds of men.
Whoever acquireth it will become capable of teaching God's Faith and will triumph over the hearts and minds of men.
He that attaineth thereunto will be endowed with such persuasive power as to enable him to convey to men's hearts the Message of God, and overcome their minds.

Every man that hath attained thereunto will be endowed with a faculty with which to instruct others in the Faith of God, and will acquire such influence over their hearts and minds as none can resist.
Whoever attaineth unto it will assuredly become able to teach God's Faith and to gain the upper hand over the hearts and minds of men.
Everyone that attains thereunto is empowered to teach the Cause of God, and triumph over the souls and the minds of men.
He that attains unto it will prove himself capable of teaching the word of God and of subduing the hearts and minds of His servants.
Whosoever attaineth unto it can assuredly teach God's Cause and prevail against the hearts and minds of men.

source: شمس بیان از مطلع وحی رحمن بقسمی در زبر و الواح اشراق فرموده که ملکوت بیان و جبروت تبیان از او در انبساط و اهتزاز و اشراق است.
reference: The Daystar of utterance, shining resplendent from the dayspring of divine Revelation, hath so illumined the Scrolls and Tablets that the kingdom of utterance and the exalted dominion of understanding vibrate with joy and ecstasy and shine forth with the splendor of His light, yet the generali
hyps: The daystar of utterance which hath shed its radiance upon My heart from the dayspring of the divine revelation of God, the All-Merciful, hath so illumined the Scrolls and Tablets that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of understanding are filled with radiance, with movement and with gladness.

In such wise hath the Luminary of Utterance shed its radiance upon the Tablets and Scrolls that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of knowledge have been diffused by it in expansion and effulgence and splendor.

The Sun of Utterance that shineth from the dawning-place of divine Revelation hath cast such a radiant light upon the Books and Tablets that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of wisdom vibrate and shine as a result thereof.

The Sun of Utterance that hath risen above the Dayspring of divine Revelation shineth so brightly in the Scriptures and Tablets that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of interpretation resound and blaze with its glory and radiance.

So bright hath been the radiance of His utterance from the dayspring of divine revelation that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of exposition are incommensurate with its radiance, and cannot contain its splendor.

The Daystar of Utterance shining from the horizon of Revelation hath illumined the Scriptures and Tablets with such brightness that they cry out before all men: The Kingdom of Utterance is expanded, and the Exalted Realms of Revelation rejoice, and shine forth with light.

The Daystar of Utterance, shining from the dayspring of divine Revelation, hath revealed in the Books and Tablets of the Prophets, such effulgent splendors that the kingdom of utterance and the heaven of understanding vibrate at His summons, and are filled with joy and light.

The Sun of utterance hath so illumined the Tablet of Revelation from the dayspring of the inspiration of the All-Merciful, that He Who ruleth the Kingdom of Utterance hath become the King of splendor, and He Who is the Source of enlightenment hath shone resplendent and shed the radiance of His light upon all things.

source: ولکنّ النّاس اکثرهم لا یفقهون
reference: yet the generality of mankind comprehend not.
hyps: And yet most people do not understand this truth.
but most men understand not.
Yet most people fail to understand.
And yet the greater part of mankind comprehend it not.
And yet the people have understood it not.
Most people understand not.
Yet most men understand not.
Yet most men understand not.

source: اینکه مکرّر مقام نصر و انتصار از قلم قدر جاری شده و میشود مقصود آن است که مباد احبّآء الله باموری که منشأ فتن و فساد است قیام نمایند.
reference: The reason why the subject of aid and assistance hath time and again streamed and will continue to stream from the Pen of Providence is to warn the friends of God lest they engage in activities that would give rise to strife and turmoil.
hyps: It is our purpose, through these repeated allusions to victory and triumph, to indicate that our loved ones should shun all that could give rise to strife or dissension among them.

The many times hath Our Pen referred to this theme, and will continue so to refer, in order that the friends may arise against those who plot against the Cause of God, and not take part in any movement which would cause strife and turmoil among the believers.
That We have repeatedly exalted the station of victory is prompted by Our wish to safeguard against any action which would beget sedition and discord among the friends of God.

It is our purpose to emphasize the theme of victory and triumph that hath streamed from and will continue to stream from the Pen of Mercy, in order that the friends of God may not engage in any action which could cause trouble or commotion among His servants.
The reason for repeating the theme of victory, of triumph is to warn the lovers of God that they should not engage in actions which will bring on strife and sedition.

That every reference to victory and triumph which hath streamed forth and will continue to stream forth from this Pen hath for its purpose the prevention of trouble and strife among God's loved ones is attested by that which the Pen hath written.
The reason why we constantly urge upon all to strive for the triumph of Our Cause is to forestall the actions of certain persons which would create strife amongst men.

Our repeated reference to the theme of victory and triumph hath been intended to impress upon men this truth, that the friends of God should rise up and oppose that which is the cause of strife and disorder among the people.

source: جمیع باید در صدد نصرت امر الله برآیند بقسمی که ذکر شد.
reference: It is incumbent upon them, one and all, to diligently seek ways to help the Cause of God in such manner as We have explained.
hyps: It is incumbent upon everyone to further the Cause of God according to that which hath been mentioned.
It is incumbent upon all to exert their utmost endeavor to aid this Revelation, in such wise as hath been mentioned.
It is incumbent upon everyone to strive with all his heart for the triumph of Gods Cause, nay so much so that what hath been enjoined must be fully carried out.
It behooveth all men to arise to further the Cause of God in such wise as hath been described.
It is incumbent upon all to arise to render His Cause victorious in such wise as We have set forth.
It behooveth every one to make every effort towards the victory of this Cause, and to arise as it hath been ordained.
It behooveth everyone to exert his utmost endeavors for the furtherance of the Cause of God, in such wise as hath been explained.
It behooveth every one to bestir himself so that he may render the Cause of God victorious as was explained.

source: و این از فضل او است مخصوص احبّای او تا کلّ بمقامی که میفرماید من احیا نفساً فقد احیا النّاس جمیعاً فائز شوند.
reference: This is but a token of His grace especially conferred upon His loved ones that every one of them may attain the station characterized by the words: Whoso quickeneth a soul hath verily quickened all mankind.
hyps: This is, verily, His grace. It is especially directed to His beloved ones, that every one may attain unto the station wherewith He is pleased to invest Him, Who saith: He who quickeneth a soul hath truly quickened all men.
This is, verily, a bounteous favor of God, especially extended unto His loved ones, that every one may attain the station which He describes as he who would quicken a soul hath quickened all men.

This is a special favor conferred upon His loved ones that they all may attain unto the station which the Prophet hath described as the revival of a soul being equivalent to the revival of the entire human race.
This, however, is His grace to His loved ones, that all may attain unto such heights that, as He saith, Whoso giveth life to one soul hath verily given life to all mankind.
This He hath granted specially to His loved ones that each one may attain unto the station which beseemeth Him, that through restoring one soul to life all mankind may be regenerated and reborn.
This is His special gift, to all who love Him, so that all may attain unto this exalted station, as it is written: He that revealeth the life of one soul, hath truly revealed the life of all men.
This indeed is His special favor vouchsafed to His loved ones, that all may attain unto so exalted a station as He proclaimeth: Whoso reviveth a soul, hath verily revived all mankind.
This, assuredly, is a token of His mercy to His loved ones that all may attain the station which He hath ordained for every man, who, should he revive one soul, shall have revived all humanity.

source: و غلبهٴ ظاهره تحت این مقام بوده و خواهد بود.
reference: Temporal ascendancy hath been and will continue to be under the shadow of this station.
hyps: and external ascendency can never prevail against this station.
and outward subjection is subject unto it.
No earthly power can ever prevail against it.
Dominion hath always belonged, and will everlastingly belong, to none save Him.
Such dominion hath neither been nor will be superior to this station.
Such ascendancy is, and will remain for ever, under His control, while all else besides Him is subject to defeat and transience.
No external force can prevail against this station.
Such is its ascendancy that none can hope to prevail against it.

source: و از برای او وقتی است معیّن در کتاب الهی.
reference: Its appointed hour is preordained in the Book of God.
hyps: In the Book of God it hath been preordained that the duration of this Revelation should be nineteen years.
Its nature is of an essentially spiritual and transient character.
In the Book of God it hath been prescribed that there must be a specific length of time.
The hour of its revelation hath been fixed by God in His Book.
In the Book of God His advent hath been preordained by God Himself.
This Day hath been especially singled out by God in His Book.
Its hour is fixed in His Book.
In this connection, the Bible hath ordained a particular season.

source: انّه یعلم و یظهر بسلطانه.
reference: He is truly cognizant thereof and it will be manifested through the potency of His might.
hyps: He knoweth, and will manifest Himself through the power of His sovereign might.
He, verily, knoweth and shall manifest Himself through the power of His sovereignty.
Verily He knoweth and will manifest Himself through the power of His sovereign might.
He verily knoweth, and will reveal Himself through the power of His sovereign might.
Verily He knoweth, and will appear through the potency of His might.
Indeed He knoweth, and His dominion shall make Him manifest.
Verily He knoweth, and will be made manifest by His sovereign might.
He knoweth, and to none will He reveal His mystery save through His irresistible sovereignty.

source: انّه لهو القویّ الغالب المقتدر العلیم الحکیم.
reference: Verily He is the Powerful, the All-Subduing, the Omnipotent, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
hyps: He, verily, is the Potent, the All-Conquering, the Omnipotent, the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Compelling, the Omnipotent, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
He, verily, is the All Powerful, the All Conquering, the Mighty, the Knowing, the Wise.
He is the Potent, the All-Compelling, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
He is verily the Strong, the All-Conquering, the Omnipotent, the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
He is in truth the Powerful, the All-Subduing, the Most Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
He, verily, is the Strong, the All-Pervading, the Most Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
He is indeed the Strong, the All-Overwhelming, the Most Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

source: و باید نفوس مقدّسه تفکّر و تدبّر نمایند در کیفیّت تبلیغ.
reference: The sanctified souls should ponder and meditate in their hearts regarding the methods of teaching.
hyps: It behooveth every sanctified soul to ponder and meditate on the different means employed for the propagation of the Faith.
It behooveth the sanctified souls to ponder on this subject and to meditate how best they should teach it to people
It behooveth every sanctified soul to ponder and reflect upon this, how that Teaching hath been accomplished.
Sanctified souls should ponder this matter in their hearts concerning the nature of the ministry and service.

They that are sanctified in My sight should meditate upon the various aspects of this Revelation, and consider whether its object can possibly be the promotion of the interests of the people amongst whom it hath appeared.
It behooveth the pure in spirit to ponder how this testimony should be borne.
It behooveth the pure in heart to meditate upon, and ponder over, the question of teaching.
The sanctified souls should ponder on the various methods which have been adopted for the teaching of this Cause.

source: و از کتب بدیعهٴ الهیّه در هر مقام آیاتی و کلماتی حفظ نمایند تا در حین بیان در هر مقام که اقتضا نماید بآیات الهی ناطق شوند چه که او است اکسیر اعظم و طلسم اکبر افخم.
reference: From the texts of the wondrous, heavenly Scriptures they should memorize phrases and passages bearing on various instances, so that in the course of their speech they may recite divine verses whenever the occasion demandeth it, inasmuch as these holy verses are the most potent elixir, the greatest and mightiest talisman.
hyps: Let them preserve, from the wondrous and heavenly Scriptures, words and sentences for every situation so that whenever it be necessary He may quote verses from the Holy Books. For these are most efficacious amulets and mighty talismans.

From time to time they should recite a verse or two from any of these wondrous Books, so that whenever He is called upon to speak, He may readily quote passages from the Holy Text, for it is these passages which constitute the most powerful of medicines, the supreme talisman, and the sovereign remedy.

In order that thou mayest be able to quote whenever necessary passages and sentences from the wondrous Books which God hath revealed, it would be advantageous for thee to commit unto memory several passages in each of these Books, so that when expounding thou mayest, at whatever moment it might be required, refer to verses from the Sacred Text.

In every situation, from among the wondrous Books of God, let them select a verse or a word to quote, so that they may be enabled, at any moment, to speak out with the words of God, for He is the Most Great Elixir, the Most Mighty, Supreme Talisman.
It is also desirable that they should commit to memory certain passages from the wondrous Books of God, so that whenever circumstances demand, they may quote verses from the Holy Writ.

It behooveth everyone to gather together, out of the wondrous Books of God, verses and passages which can be utilized when addressing gatherings, that these may hear and comprehend, for they constitute the highest of all remedies, the supreme talisman, and the chief of all healing agents.

Also in any book of the wondrous writings of God they should guard themselves and keep a watchful eye, so that when He speaketh, He may be able to quote at any moment from the verses of God, for He is the Mighty Infallible Seal of all Books.

And in these wondrous and divinely revealed books, let them diligently preserve the verses and words of God, so that when speaking they may, at whatever time they judge necessary, cite the words of God Himself, for they are the supreme Elixir, the most great Talisman, the most mighty Key.

source: بشأنی که سامع را مجال توقّف نماند.
reference: So potent is their influence that the hearer will have no cause for vacillation.
hyps: So great is its sublimity that every hearer of Thy Voice hath been stirred to meditate its meaning.
Such are My words that no man may hesitate after hearing them.
So weighty are My words that they who hearken to My Call shall hesitate not.
Such is My speech that whoever listeneth to it will be sore perplexed.
Such is its force that the hearer hesitates at its ring.
Such is its character that it leaveth no room for the hearer to hesitate.
He it is Whose discourse hath left the listener without the least hesitation.
Such is its charm that no man hath failed to be stirred thereby.

source: این امر بشأنی ظاهر شده که مغناطیس کلّ ملل و وجود خواهد بود.
reference: This Revelation is endowed with such a power that it will act as the lodestone for all nations and kindreds of the earth.
hyps: Such is its power that it shall attract and captivate all the peoples of the earth.
This Cause hath been sent down for the benefit of all peoples and nations.
This Cause will be made manifest in such wise that the magnetic power of its influence will attract the souls of all nations and peoples.
This Revelation which hath been sent down is endowed with a virtue that will be the soul of all nations and will quicken the lives of all peoples.
Such is the influence which this Revelation hath exerted that every nation and individual on the face of the earth hath become its unwitting victim.
This Cause is invested with such a potency that the soul of every nation and individual will be stirred thereby.
So great is the transforming power released by this Revelation that its energizing influence will permeate the soul of every nation and kindred on earth.
This Revelation is characterized with a power so great that it will serve as the lodestone for the entire human race.

source: اگر نفسی درست تفکّر نماید مشاهده مینماید که از برای احدی مفرّی نبوده و نیست.
reference: Should one pause to meditate attentively he would recognize that no place is there, nor can there be, for anyone to flee to.
hyps: Should anyone pause to ponder this matter attentively he would readily admit that there is no place for anyone to flee to.
Should anyone meditate deeply on this matter he would perceive that there hath never been nor is now any place to which man can flee from the face of His wrath.
Were any one to meditate on this matter he would readily perceive that there has been nor is there now any refuge for anyone besides this Refuge.
If anyone will pause to ponder this matter he will readily discover that there is absolutely no place for anyone to flee to hide.
Were any man to reflect objectively he would be convinced that it is impossible for anyone to flee from His presence.
If any man reflect with his heart on that which hath been revealed in this Book, he will perceive that there is no place for any one to flee to.
Were anyone to ponder this question he would readily recognize that no refuge can ever be found for anyone but God Himself.
Were anyone to ponder this matter he would clearly perceive that there has been nor can there be any refuge for anyone.

source: و کتاب اقدس بشأنی نازل شده که جاذب و جامع جمیع شرایع الهیّه است.
reference: In such manner hath the Kitáb-i-Aqdas been revealed that it attracteth and embraceth all the divinely appointed Dispensations.
hyps: So profound is the teaching that hath been revealed in the Kitáb-i-Aqdas that it attracteth and embraceth all the divinely appointed Dispensations.
Concerning this the Most Holy Book of God hath been revealed to be the one which attracteth and embraceth all the divine laws.
And that which had been revealed concerning the Kitáb-i-Aqdas was in itself so potent that it attracted and embraced every other Divine law.
The Kitab-i-Aqdas which the Lord, the Ancient King hath revealed, is so endowed that it attracteth the souls of all men, and embraceth the essentials of all religions.
Such hath been revealed in the Kitab-i-Aqdas that it attracteth and embraceth all the divine Dispensations.
In this Book He hath revealed that which will embrace all the divine Dispensations that have gone before.
The Kitab-i-Aqdas is so revealed that it attracteth and embraceth all divinely appointed Dispensations.
The Kitab-i-Aqdas is revealed in such wise that it attracteth all the revealed Scriptures of God, and embraceth them all.

source: طوبی للقارئین.
reference: Blessed those who peruse it.
hyps: Blessed they that read it.
Blessed are those that peruse it.
Blessed those that peruse it.
Blessed those who peruse it.
Blessed are they that peruse it.
Happy those who peruse it.
Blessed those who peruse this Tablet.
Blessed those who peruse this Tablet.

source: طوبی للمتفکّرین.
reference: Blessed those who meditate upon it.
hyps: Blessed those who ponder it.
Blessed they that ponder it in their hearts.
Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
Happy those who reflect.
Blessed are those that reflect upon this theme.
Blessed those who ponder this.

source: طوبی للمتفرّسین.
reference: Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
hyps: Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
Happy they that ponder its significance.
Blessed those who ponder it in their hearts.
Blessed those who ponder its meanings.
Happy they that ponder its meaning.
Blessed those who ponder its meaning.
Happy those who ponder its meaning.
Blessed those who ponder its meaning.

source: و بانبساطی نازل شده که کلّ را قبل از اقبال احاطه فرموده.
reference: So vast is its range that it hath encompassed all men ere their recognition of it.
hyps: So vast is its range that all created things have been comprehended within its scope, before their actual appearance.

reference: We entreat God to make thy call a magnet which will attract the embodiments of names in the world of existence that all beings may spontaneously hasten to heed it.
